c4dc6336.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

984c2b7c.description:
**E T Consultant - Nature Based Solutions Specialist**

**Job #:**

req39138

  

**Organization:**

World Bank

  

**Sector:**

Environment

  

**Grade:**

EC3

  

**Term Duration:**

1 year 0 months

  

**Recruitment Type:**

New Delhi,India

  

**Required Language(s):**

English, Hindi

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

  

**Closing Date:**

11/26/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
India's 11,099-kilometer coastline is home to 250 million people and supports key blue economy sectors including fisheries, tourism, agriculture, and transport. Despite its ecological richness, India's coastal ecosystems face mounting pressure from climate-induced hazards, coastal erosion, pollution, and land-use change. One-third of India's coastline is reported as vulnerable to erosion, threatening livelihoods, settlements, and biodiversity of global significance.  
  
The SHORE MPA has begun implementation in the states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka under Phase 1 and will be expanded to other coastal states such as Goa, Maharashtra, Puducherry and West Bengal under subsequent phases. It aims to increase the resilience of targeted coastal communities and ecosystems, focusing on four components: (i) strengthening institutions for Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM); (ii) shoreline management, coastal protection and conservation; (iii) improving livelihoods for natural resource-dependent communities; and (iv) enhancing marine pollution management and plastic circularity.  
  
Nature-based solutions (NBS) are central to Component 2, which supports mangrove, seagrass and coral reef conservation management and restoration, along with shelter belts, bio-shields, and hybrid coastal erosion management measures such as beach nourishment, sand dune stabilization, artificial reefs, and others. Where relevant, NBS investments should be coordinated with livelihood activities such as eco-tourism and mangrove-friendly value chains to ensure that conservation-livelihood tradeoffs are managed. The project also involves establishment of Centers of Excellence for coastal ecosystem management, long-term biodiversity monitoring, and eco-tourism.  
  
The Environment (ENV) Department in South Asia seeks to recruit a highly skilled and motivated ET Consultant (Nature-based Solutions Specialist) to provide technical, operational, and analytical support to the World Bank task team and the state-level implementing agencies in planning, implementing, and monitoring nature-based solutions for coastal resilience under the SHORE MPA. The ET Consultant will report to the ENV Practice Manager for the South Asia Region (SAR) and work under the supervision of the SHORE Task Team Leaders.  
  
The South Asia Region comprises six countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka) that range in size from India (with a population of over 1 billion) to Maldives (with 0.3 million people). The region has experienced a long period of robust economic growth, averaging 6% a year over the past 20 years. It was the second-fastest growing region in the world in the aftermath of the global crisis. This strong growth has translated into declining poverty and impressive improvements in human development. The percentage of people living below the poverty line fell in South Asia from 56% to 16% between 1981 and 2013. Still, the region remains home to a third of the world’s poorest, with 216 million people living below $1.9/day.  
  
The South Asia Region: https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/sar

The Environment Department (ENV), located within the World Bank’s Planet Practice Group has been established to deliver on the opportunities, benefits and outcomes offered by enhanced management of the environment and natural resources. ENV provides expertise, technical assistance and financing to help countries manage land, sea and freshwater natural resources in a sustainable way to help create jobs, improve livelihoods, enhance ecosystem services, decrease pollution and increase resilience to climate change. Over 360 ENV staff working across the globe help set developing countries on a clean, green growth trajectory for resilient economies and healthy communities.  
  
The SSAE1 unit comprises around 30 staff, with 95 percent based in Country Offices. The rest of the team is based in Washington DC. Our Sri Lanka country office is a joint World Bank/International Finance Cooperation office, comprising approximately 100 staff, including an ETC working on environment, providing a vibrant, collegial working environment.  
  
**Duties and accountabilities:**  
  
The ET Consultant will have the following tasks:  
  
**1)Technical Advisory and Operational Support**  
  

* Provide technical guidance to the task team and clients on the design, siting, and implementation of NBS interventions including mangrove, coastal sandy-soil & cliff forests, seagrass and coral reef conservation and restoration, bio-shields and shelter belts, and hybrid erosion management.
* Support preparation and quality review of sub-project-level technical designs for NBS activities, including for e.g. Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs), and Biodiversity Management Plans (BMPs).
* Advise on screening of NBS sub-project sites to avoid ecologically sensitive areas, no-go zones, and areas with high biodiversity value in line with State Coastal Zone Management Plans (CZMP) and Shoreline Management Plans (SMP).
* Contribute to Implementation Support Missions and progress report reviews from implementing agencies related to NBS design and implementation.

  
**2)Global Knowledge and Technical Expertise**  
  

* Support the implementation of nature-based solutions-related advisory services and knowledge products, including through technical inputs, guidance materials, and planning for the timely delivery of analytical products.
* Generate and curate knowledge, such as by identifying best practices and lessons learned on NBS for coastal protection, and promote dissemination at the national and global levels.
* Support the team in technical assessments/analyses related to NBS e.g. cost-benefit analysis frameworks for NBS interventions, assessment of ecosystem services and livelihoods benefits.
* Support the design and operationalization of long-term NBS/ecosystem monitoring programs in line with project results frameworks.

  
**3)Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Building**  
  

* Contribute to the engagement and policy dialogue with government counterparts and other collaborators in the NBS space.
* Support capacity building and knowledge sharing activities for state officials, community groups, and technical staff on NBS principles, implementation, and adaptive management. This may include knowledge exchange between SHORE state teams, with national institutions (e.g., NCSCM, NIOT, NCCR, IIT-Madras, SDMRI), and with other countries that are implementing coastal NBS projects.
* Engage with local natural-resource dependent communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in the design of community-driven NBS interventions.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's (or higher) degree in marine ecology, coastal engineering, forestry, environmental science, natural resource management, geography, or a closely related field.

  

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience in nature-based solutions, forestry/mangroves, coastal ecosystem management, coastal resilience, natural resource management, and/or sustainable development fields with demonstrated experience in World Bank operations and analytics.

  

* Demonstrated knowledge and expertise on nature-based solutions, which may include mangrove restoration, coral reef rehabilitation, seagrass conservation, shelter belts, bio-shields, or green-grey hybrid coastal protection.

  

* Strong technical skills with remote sensing, coastal modeling tools, or GIS as applied to coastal ecosystem management.

  

* Strong analytical skills, ability to think strategically, analyze and synthesize diverse qualitative and quantitative data and information. Ability to develop, conduct, or review assessments of NBS design and implementation is an advantage.

  

* Excellent writing skills and ability to produce high-quality analytical and advisory outputs for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* Experience working on South Asia and familiarity with the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification framework and ICZM principles in the Indian context is an advantage.

  

* Good team player who can work as a member of a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural team, motivate and lead group efforts and network effectively across boundaries.

  

* A drive for results while working with limited supervision and under tight timelines.

  
**Additional Considerations:**  
  
**As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:**  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working on fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV)-related contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.

7d9e5bfc.title: Veeva CRM Solution Architect
7d9e5bfc.description:
**Introduction**
================

At Slipstream Life Sciences, we help pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations transform and manage their technology ecosystems through strategic consulting, implementation, and managed services.

Our Veeva Commercial practice supports clients across CRM implementations, migrations, integrations, and ongoing platform support. As the life sciences industry transitions from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Veeva Vault CRM, we are expanding our offshore delivery capabilities and investing in developing the next generation of Veeva CRM architects.

We are seeking experienced Veeva CRM professionals who can lead solution design and technical delivery while building their expertise in Vault CRM.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Slipstream is seeking an experienced **Veeva CRM Solution Architect** to join our offshore Veeva Commercial practice.

This is a hands-on solution architecture and technical leadership role responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering Veeva CRM solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience with Salesforce-based Veeva CRM, strong knowledge of life sciences commercial processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

The role requires someone who can independently own solution design, guide configuration teams, resolve complex technical challenges, and ensure that implementations follow established architectural standards and best practices.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.** Slipstream will provide training and practical exposure to support the transition from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Vault CRM. Candidates must demonstrate strong architectural fundamentals, technical depth, and the ability to learn and adapt to a new platform.

**Location:** Offshore – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Working Hours:** Standard offshore hours with flexibility for overlap with US teams  
**Practice:** Veeva Commercial

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Solution Architecture and Design**

* Lead the technical and solution architecture for Veeva CRM implementations, enhancements, and migration programs.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable solution designs aligned with Veeva CRM capabilities and life sciences commercial processes.
* Design CRM data models, object relationships, security frameworks, user access, automation, and configuration approaches.
* Define technical solutions for core Veeva CRM capabilities, including HCP/HCO management, call reporting, territory management, product management, sample management, and consent management.
* Provide solution guidance for Veeva commercial modules, including CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, Events Management, and multichannel capabilities.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend standard platform functionality wherever possible, minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Develop and review solution design documents, configuration specifications, technical design decisions, and architectural documentation.
* Identify technical dependencies, design constraints, integration considerations, and potential implementation risks.

### **Technical Leadership and Delivery**

* Provide technical leadership to Veeva CRM configurators, developers, and other delivery team members.
* Review configuration designs and technical solutions to ensure consistency with approved architecture and platform best practices.
* Remain hands-on with complex configurations, troubleshooting, technical assessments, and proof-of-concept activities.
* Guide teams on Salesforce and Veeva CRM configuration, including objects, fields, layouts, security, automation, validation rules, and administrative settings.
* Support technical estimation, work breakdown, and implementation planning.
* Establish configuration standards, reusable components, design patterns, and quality controls across delivery teams.
* Review technical deliverables and ensure that configuration activities meet project requirements and quality expectations.
* Support SIT, UAT, deployment planning, defect resolution, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and provide guidance on root cause analysis and resolution.

### **Integration and Data Architecture**

* Define CRM integration requirements and collaborate with integration architects and developers on interface design.
* Understand data flows between Veeva CRM and related enterprise systems, including MDM, data warehouses, consent platforms, and other commercial applications.
* Provide architectural guidance on data migration, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
* Support Veeva CRM integrations with products such as Veeva Network, Veeva Align, Vault PromoMats, and external enterprise systems.
* Review integration designs to ensure alignment with CRM data models, business processes, and technical constraints.
* Participate in migration assessments and identify configuration, data, and integration dependencies.

### **CRM Migration and Vault CRM Transition**

* Support assessments and migration planning for clients transitioning from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Veeva Vault CRM.
* Evaluate existing Veeva CRM configurations, customizations, integrations, and business processes to identify migration considerations.
* Participate in configuration rationalization, gap analysis, and future-state solution design.
* Develop an understanding of Vault CRM architecture, configuration capabilities, security, data models, and deployment approaches through structured training.
* Apply existing Veeva CRM commercial process knowledge and solution architecture experience to Vault CRM implementation programs.
* Collaborate with experienced Vault CRM architects and Veeva teams to understand platform differences and appropriate solution design approaches.
* Progressively assume architecture responsibilities on Vault CRM implementations as platform proficiency develops.

### **Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Project Managers, client stakeholders, and offshore delivery teams.
* Participate in technical design workshops and provide recommendations on solution options and trade-offs.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and design considerations clearly to both technical and functional audiences.
* Collaborate with onshore architects and delivery leadership to maintain consistency across implementation workstreams.
* Support technical reviews, solution walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer activities.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce-based Veeva CRM architecture, configuration, and administration.
* Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including data models, object relationships, security, profiles, permission sets, automation, and configuration.
* Strong understanding of Veeva CRM commercial functionality, including call reporting, account management, territory management, product setup, samples, and consent.
* Experience designing solutions involving Veeva CRM modules such as CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, and Events Management.
* Ability to develop solution architecture documents, technical designs, configuration specifications, and data flow diagrams.
* Strong understanding of CRM data architecture, integrations, APIs, and enterprise application dependencies.
* Experience evaluating technical requirements and recommending configuration versus customization approaches.
* Knowledge of Salesforce deployment practices, environment management, and release management.
* Ability to review complex configurations and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Understanding of life sciences commercial business processes, data governance, and regulatory considerations.
* Familiarity with data migration, data quality, reconciliation, and integration testing.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* **7+ years of CRM implementation, configuration, or technical consulting experience**, including at least **4+ years of hands-on Salesforce-based Veeva CRM experience**.
* Experience serving as a Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Senior Veeva CRM Consultant on implementation or major enhancement programs.
* Hands-on involvement in at least two Veeva CRM implementation or significant transformation projects.
* Demonstrated experience designing CRM solutions and translating business requirements into technical architecture.
* Experience leading or mentoring configurators and developers, including reviewing technical designs and configuration deliverables.
* Experience working across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Experience collaborating with integration, data migration, and enterprise architecture teams.
* Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently own assigned solution architecture workstreams and escalate risks or design decisions appropriately.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience supporting global or multi-country Veeva CRM implementations.
* Experience with Veeva Network, Veeva Align, Vault PromoMats, or other Veeva Commercial products.
* Exposure to Veeva Vault, Vault CRM, or Vault platform administration.
* Experience participating in Veeva CRM migration assessments or transformation programs.
* Salesforce certifications, including Administrator, Platform App Builder, or relevant architecture certifications.
* Veeva CRM or Vault platform certifications.
* Experience with CRM integrations, middleware platforms, and enterprise data architecture.
* Experience leading offshore technical delivery teams supporting US or global clients.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence.

**Vault CRM Training and Career Development**
---------------------------------------------

Slipstream recognizes that experienced Salesforce-based Veeva CRM architects bring valuable commercial domain knowledge, solution design experience, and technical leadership skills that can be applied to Vault CRM.

We will provide training and practical exposure to support the transition to Vault CRM, including:

* Vault platform architecture and core configuration concepts.
* Vault CRM data models, objects, relationships, and security architecture.
* Vault CRM commercial functionality and solution design.
* Vault workflows, lifecycles, business rules, and platform automation.
* Vault CRM integrations, APIs, and data management.
* Vault CRM deployment and environment management.
* Veeva CRM to Vault CRM migration approaches, configuration mapping, and design considerations.
* Hands-on participation in Vault CRM implementation and migration programs.

Candidates are not expected to have prior Vault CRM implementation experience or certification. However, they must be willing to invest in developing their Vault CRM architecture skills and progressively take ownership of Vault CRM solution design responsibilities.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunities to lead Veeva CRM implementation, migration, and transformation programs for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.
* Structured training and hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM.
* Technical leadership opportunities within a growing Veeva Commercial practice.
* Exposure to global life sciences clients and complex enterprise CRM ecosystems.
* Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to reusable architecture standards and delivery accelerators.
* Career progression toward Senior Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, and Practice Technical Leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Interested candidates should submit their resume highlighting their Veeva CRM architecture, configuration, technical leadership, and implementation experience.

Candidates should describe the Veeva CRM solutions they have designed, the modules and integrations they have supported, and their involvement in leading technical delivery teams.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.**

*Slipstream is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Slipstream IT makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

*This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the Employer.*

1dc59e01.title: AI Data Science Solutions Lead, Aladdin, Vice President
1dc59e01.description:
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R266890 Date posted: Nov. 14, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Your Team**

The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm.

  

**Your Role and Impact**

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

  

**Your Responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency.

* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams.

* Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value.

* Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness.

* Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions.

* Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards.

* Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively.
  

Your Experience

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments.

* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms.

* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.

* Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques.

* Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred.

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

2ca31f33.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
2ca31f33.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

3c69bf5b.title: Global IT Solution Architect Expert Senior Manager
3c69bf5b.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The hands-on Solution Architect is responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of cohesive technical solutions across BCG business, primarily focusing on implementation of new solutions, solution enhancements, and system/data integration. The Solution Architect likely will be aligned with one or more business area, such that they can develop a thorough understanding of the business and drive consistency and integration across solutions for that business area. They will also maintain awareness of emerging technologies relevant to their areas of expertise and responsibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly motivated strategic thinker, engaging collaborator, and effective influencer. Key objectives of the role are to drive digital transformation and the strategic and tactical use of technology to deliver business capabilities, while the organization with cutting edge technologies in a high paced environment. Critical to the Solution Architect’s success is their ability to drive projects and teams to deliver results for the business, balanced with adherence to standards and processes. They will coordinate and provide oversight to the solution/technical leads of multiple development squads.
  
  
The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. They will collaborate with multi-disciplinary architects and engineers across the Technology organization and within the business to develop strategy, technology roadmaps, and technical standards. They will also work as an interface point with strategic partners, determining where they may offer value to business partners and facilitating coordination on joint initiatives.
  
  

* Architect and deliver GenAI solutions (copilots, workflow automation, knowledge assistants) from prototype to production.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude code, Cursor, equivalents) to accelerate delivery with strong quality/security.
* Design and scale agentic systems; define standards for agent development, orchestration, deployment, and monitoring.
* Establish reusable MCP patterns/services for consistent tool integration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Define patterns for enterprise scaling (access control, guardrails, evaluation, observability, cost/latency, reliability).
* Build production-viable prototypes for emerging tech (incl. GenAI/agents) and validate feasibility, security, operability, and scale.
* Interpret business needs and requirements and design/develop technical solutions to deliver the desired business capabilities.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects and other Solution Architects and engineers to architect and design technical solutions that are aligned with enterprise technology standards and strategy, while also working to help develop and grow those standards and roadmaps.
* Work across multiple systems/solutions to ensure their consistency and alignment, as well as to determine how multiple systems/solutions can work together to serve a particular line of business and/or to ensure that a solution works across lines of business.
* Leverage experience and expertise across a wide variety of technology domains, including infrastructure, data management, systems integration, and application development, with a recent emphasis on technologies leveraged by BCG, such as FiveTrans, MuleSoft APIs, Infomatica, AWS, Azure, and SnowFlake.
* Employ and enforce system/solution develop processes, agile methodologies, DevOps principles and practices, and quality engineering best practices.
* Exercise concepts and best practices for designing system reliability/resilience, performance/scalability and maintainability/operability.
* Provide technical oversight to multiple project teams to ensure compliance with processes and standards. Ensure that solutions/systems developed in support of the business are aligned with BCG Enterprise Architecture, technical standards, and technology roadmaps.
* Organize Architecture and Design Reviews to ensure wider architecture peer group input is sought for robust design
* Conduct proof of concept exercises for emerging solutions and prove out potential enhancements to the design
* Ensure designs are implemented with target architecture and key design decisions are clearly communicated to leadership and all key stakeholders
* Review and consider prospective changes to the baseline solution that have been raised by process owners, projects, production support, continuous improvement initiatives and the business for architectural impact

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science
* 14 years of work experience + 10 years of experience designing and implementing business critical applications in multi-region environments +1 year of deep exposure to LLM based business applications

**Essential Experience & Job Requirements**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a software developer, preferably in multitenant/SaaS projects
* Work experience as a Solutions Architect in at least one project
* Demonstrated hands-on Solution Architect experience; able to build reference implementations and unblock teams.
* Strong experience with AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, equivalents) and safe enterprise usage.
* Familiarity with GenAI dev platforms (e.g., AI Studio, Replit, Devin, equivalents) for rapid prototyping.
* Deep expertise in agent patterns (RAG, tool use, planning, memory, guardrails, HITL) and production operations.
* Experience with agent orchestration/deployment (CI/CD, runtime, monitoring, incident response).
* Experience building/managing MCP ecosystems (registry, access, versioning, performance/cost controls).
* Critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex technical challenges
* Experience in conducting technical assessments and feasibility studies
* Advanced Expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and practices
* Proficiency in multiple programming languages (Python, Typescript)
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and methodologies
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and practices
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of distributed systems concepts
* Knowledge of current technical landscape and emerging trends
* Ability to document business processes and system architectures
* Experience with one or more application development languages and/or system integration platforms

ca69f5ad.title: Supply Chain Program Manager III
ca69f5ad.description:
Work Model: You’ll work in a hybrid model, onsite at your designated Regal Rexnord location, with flexibility to work remotely.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Position summary
  
  
Reporting to Director India Sourcing, this person will be a critical leader responsible for execution of sourcing Cost saving, VAVE, resourcing projects across all Regal Rexnord segments with a focus on
**RRX India region**
.
  
  
The Supply Chain Program Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional supply chain initiatives that improve supplier performance, cost, quality, delivery, inventory, and operational efficiency. This role partners with sourcing, procurement, operations, engineering, quality, logistics, finance, and IT teams to execute strategic programs and drive supply chain transformation initiatives.
  
  
SC Program Manager will lead projects spanning direct procurement, supply chain and operations optimization, and procurement synergy. In this role, the individual will lead multiple projects that can vary in complexity across the Regal Rexnord Enterprise. The program manager will oversee the work related to all functions over the duration of the projects. The ideal candidate will be self-driven, straightforward, able to handle multi projects at same time, and a good problem solver with common sense and a practical approach to problems.
  
  
You will bring your demonstrated history of getting quickly adapted to an unfamiliar working environment, building and leveraging relationships in a matrixed environment, working collaboratively to ensure team performance, and successfully influencing a variety of business stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
Monitor and mitigate risks with leveraging the key tasks on the critical path spanning overall project lifecycle. With priorities and sense of urgency, properly communicate and manage stakeholder’s expectations and team players’ concerns. A good problem solver to facilitate alignment when various issues that arise from stakeholders. Develop trust within the business so that where there are conflicting priorities or other issues you can ensure that all involved understand the issues and agree with the solutions put forward.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Leverages a high level of project management skills on supply chain related outsourcing, insourcing, VA/VE, supplier resourcing, large cost out initiatives and integration projects.
* Identify the project scope, objectives, schedule planning and new part qualification progress with category managers to build a healthy project pipeline for annual cost save goals by category and business unit.
* Responsible for assembling project team globally with category managers. Work with category managers to identify individual responsibilities, appropriate resources needed and develop schedules to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Acts as liaison between RRX India plants and enterprise sourcing team. Review the sourcing cost-out target attainability and new project pipeline with plants on a regular basis. Be a major window to identify any potential gaps to meet AOP cost save target and initiate new potential projects working with category managers and plant procurement managers.
* Implement robust communication strategies to report on program status, communicates critical issues to external and internal customers. Maintain a consistent way on project reporting-out, documentation, execution processes in line with regional supply chain management requirement.
* Identify the risks in terms of project execution from the pipeline management perspective and escalate the potential impact with mitigation plans. Demonstrate managerial courage and leadership to challenge project priorities, resource allocation and escalate project obstacles promptly based on 80/20 principles.

* Monitor and drive Open Purchase Order (PO) execution with India-based BVC suppliers supporting manufacturing plants across the USA, Mexico, Europe, and APAC regions. Proactively identify and resolve supply risks, material shortages, and delivery issues to ensure uninterrupted production and prevent line stoppages at global Regal Rexnord (RRX) facilities.
* Collaborate closely with Global Category Managers, RRX manufacturing plants, India Category Managers, and Supplier Quality & Development Engineers (SQDEs) to drive the successful execution of cost-out projects. Ensure on-time delivery, right-first-time implementation, and realization of targeted savings while maintaining quality, service, and supply continuity.
* Program & Project Management

+ Lead supply chain programs from planning through implementation.
+ Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk mitigation strategies.



* Track prog
* ram performance and communicate progress to leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure successful execution.
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reports.
* Utilize ERP, BI, and analytics tools to generate actionable insights.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and governance.
* Present findings and recommendations to management.
* Supplier & Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and suppliers to resolve issues.
* Support supplier performance reviews and improvement programs.
* Lead communication across global supply chain teams.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Process Improvement & Transformation
* Identify and implement productivity and cost-saving opportunities.
* Support sourcing, logistics, and supply chain transformation initiatives.
* Standardize processes, reporting methods, and performance metrics.
* Leverage best practices and digital tools to improve efficiency.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Cost savings and productivity improvements
* Supplier on-time delivery (OTD)
* Inventory turns and working capital improvements
* Supplier quality performance
* Program milestone achievement
* Process compliance and adoption rates
* undefined

**Professional Experience/Qualifications**
**‘Must’ Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 20 ~ 25 years of experience in direct material sourcing or procurement, project management or relevant experience in a manufacturing company, (project schedule, planning & execution);
* Strong negotiation skills and experience managing supplier contracts.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Proficiency in sourcing and procurement software, ERP systems, Oracle, Excel and PPT.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance standards.
* Knowledge of various Quality system methodologies 8D, Lean, 5 Why’s, Pareto Analysis, Six Sigma, PPAP, APQP, Poka-Yoke (Error Proofing), Measurement System Analysis is essential.
* Project Management Certification, Supply Chain Certifications will be a plus.
* Good presentation, verbal and written communication skills. Fluent in English.
* Demonstrated ability to drive productivity and compliance throughout a complex organization.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to communicate, interact, and influence at all levels of the organization to drive results.
* Excellence in generating accurate and understandable data and reports to analyze performance to make data-driven decisions.

**‘Nice To Have’ Requirements**

* Ability to think strategically, conceptually, and analytically to assess problems, identify and consider potential solutions, and make timely recommendations with data-driven analysis.
* Proven ability to develop trusted, respectful relationships internally and externally.
* Experience with development of sourcing processes or procurement is a plus. PMP certificate is a plus;
* High level of personal initiative, energy and ownership of business results.

**Travel:**
Up to 50%
  
  
**Language:**
English
  
  
**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
  
  
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
  
  
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
  
  
**Notification to Agencies**
: Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

50122245.title: Lead AI Solution Architect & Agentic Engineer

Join Aristocrat as a Lead AI Solution Architect & Agentic Engineer, where your expertise will invent the future of gaming technology! As a vital member of our AI Products & Enablement team, you will lead our India technical pod to build AI solutions that are secure, reliable, and reusable. This position offers an excellent opportunity to engage with world-class talent and modern technologies in a dynamic and ambitious environment!
  
  
**What You'll Do:-**

* Design end-to-end architecture for AI products, agents, and automations, including integrations with Salesforce, ERP, and enterprise data platforms.
* Build and lead hands-on development of agentic workflows, prompts, skills, retrieval patterns, and integration components.
* Define and maintain engineering standards, design patterns, and a library of reusable components that speed delivery across products.
* Establish evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, quality, latency, cost, and human-oversight effort, and use them to gate releases.
* Lead technical reviews and partner with Group IT on architecture standards, security, deployment, and production-readiness requirements.
* Lead, coach, and review the work of the India technical pod, including the Applied AI & Automation Engineer.
* Instrument solutions with telemetry for quality, cost, exceptions, and human overrides to support AgentOps and AI economics reviews.
* Provide technical input to business cases, estimates, and stage-gate decisions.

**What We're Looking For:-**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field; master's degree preferred.
* 8+years of software engineering or solution architecture experience, including at least 2 years building production LLM, generative AI, or agentic solutions.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, or Salesforce Agentforce. And other atlternative platform are acceptable i.e ChatGPT, Claude.
* Experience designing retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, and evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience integrating with CRM or ERP systems (Salesforce and SAP or Oracle preferred) and with integration platforms such as MuleSoft.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers and leading design reviews.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work across US and Australian time zones as required.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

e3c24698.title: Senior Director / Enterprise Solution Architect (Pharmacy & Cloud Platforms)
e3c24698.description:
Location: Bengaluru Millenia
  
  
Duration: 12 Months
  
  
Experience Range: 6 to 15 Years (15+ years of progressive engineering/architecture experience preferred)
  
  
Minimum Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. / MCA
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Senior Director / Enterprise Solution Architect with extensive experience in software engineering, enterprise platforms, and cloud implementations. In this leadership role, you will define target architectures, lead large-scale multi-year enterprise implementations, and drive cloud/legacy modernization for complex healthcare and pharmacy (PBM) platforms.You will lead, mentor, and grow teams of engineering managers, solution architects, and technical experts while championing next-generation engineering practices—including AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and robust DevSecOps governance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities & Scope
  
  

* Enterprise Leadership & Architecture Strategy
* Lead end-to-end technical execution of large-scale, multi-year enterprise transformations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migrations, and production cutovers.
* Define target-state enterprise architectures, capability models, domain-driven designs, and microservices/event-driven patterns.
* Partner with strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining strict internal ownership of architecture, quality, and delivery outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence, technical debt reduction, architecture fitness functions, and security-by-design principles.
* Healthcare & Pharmacy (PBM) Domain Leadership
* Apply deep knowledge of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities (prescription/claims lifecycle, benefit configuration, formulary/utilization management, eligibility, pricing, pharmacy networks, specialty/mail pharmacy, clinical programs, and rebates).
* Ensure solutions meet rigorous healthcare interoperability, data privacy, regulatory compliance, and audit requirements.
* AI-Assisted Engineering & Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
* Spearhead the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, and automated testing across the SDLC.
* Establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and responsible AI governance with appropriate human oversight.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Modernization
* Drive legacy system modernization using APIs, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), cloud-native platforms (Azure/AWS), CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Oversee resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, and robust SRE/observability practices.
* Talent Development & Global Collaboration
* Lead and scale high-performing engineering and architecture teams within a Global Capability Center (GCC) model.
* Build critical skill coverage, leadership bench strength, and clear technical succession paths across time zones.

Core Competencies & Requirements
  
  

* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and enterprise solution architecture, with 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams.
* Domain Expertise: Demonstrable understanding of healthcare, pharmacy, or Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) ecosystems.
* Technical Stack:
* Enterprise architecture, domain-driven design, microservices, API-first/event-driven patterns.
* Java / .NET engineering ecosystems, REST/GraphQL APIs, event-streaming, containers, and Kubernetes.
* Deep cloud experience (Azure and/or AWS), CI/CD, IaC, and SRE frameworks.
* Data architecture (master/reference data, data quality, lineage, and secure exchange).
* AI & SDD Capabilities: Proven track record with Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted engineering, agent orchestration, and responsible AI governance.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cloud Architecture Certification in Azure or AWS.
* AI, Machine Learning, Responsible AI, or Generative AI Certification.
* Healthcare or Pharmacy Domain Certification.
* SAFe Agilist or equivalent Agile Leadership Certification.

Key Success Measures
  
  

* Architecture: Target-state adoption, design conformance, technical debt reduction, and platform scalability.
* Implementation: Capability readiness, integration completeness, seamless migration/cutover, and production stability.
* AI & SDD: Specification coverage, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, and validated productivity benefits.
* Engineering: Cycle-time improvements, automation coverage, defect reduction, and developer experience.

**Position Summary :**
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior AWS Cloud Architect / Engineer with 6+ years of specialized expertise in designing, implementing, and operating innovative cloud solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will play a pivotal part in migrating and transforming legacy solutions to the cloud, building native cloud application architectures, and optimizing enterprise-scale environments.The ideal candidate possesses deep technical capabilities across core AWS services, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and Databricks on AWS, combined with strong Python development skills and a solid understanding of security, logging, and encryption protocols.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Architecture & Design: Design and implement robust, scalable AWS architectures and environments, ensuring alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Migration & Transformation: Play a key role in migrating and transforming legacy solutions into modern, cloud-native architectures.
* Hands-On Implementation: Provide 'hands-on keyboard' execution across a broad range of AWS services, including containerization (Docker, Amazon EKS), Serverless (Lambda), compute/storage (EC2, S3), and data warehousing (Amazon Redshift).
* Databricks Integration: Leverage strong hands-on experience with Databricks on AWS for practical implementation and platform expertise.
* Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Implement environment and application automation using CloudFormation or third-party automation tools. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitHub, Jenkins, and Artifactory.
* Core Platform & Network Architecture: Architect core AWS platforms including AWS Organizations, Account Design, VPCs, Subnets, network segmentation strategies, Direct Connect, and VPN connectivity.
* Resiliency & Cost Optimization: Design and implement comprehensive Backup and Disaster Recovery approaches, alongside proactive AWS Cost Management and Optimization strategies.
* Data Engineering & Web Services: Develop Web Services and data pipelines using Python, JSON, and essential Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas Dataframe). Implement REST/SOAP/JSON APIs.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure solutions adhere to proper Encryption, Logging, and Privacy/Security Protocols (e.g., TLS 1.2, ELK stack).
* Testing & Quality Assurance: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, baselines, and conduct end-to-end testing.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with executives, IT management, and developers through high-level presentations and consultative discussions.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Experience: 6+ years of dedicated experience in designing and implementing AWS architectures and environments.
* Core AWS & Infrastructure:
* In-depth development and operational experience with Docker, Amazon EKS, Lambda, EC2, S3, and Amazon Redshift.
* Strong expertise in core platform architecture: AWS Organizations, Account Design, VPC, Subnet, and segmentation strategies.
* Setting up AWS environment and application automation.
* Data & Analytics: Strong hands-on experience with Databricks on AWS.
* DevOps & Automation: Proficient with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Jenkins, Artifactory), scripting capabilities, and Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation / third-party tools).
* Development & Scripting: Skilled in Python, JSON, and Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas). Good knowledge of REST/SOAP/JSON web service API implementations.
* Security & Networking: Familiarity with encryption, logging, privacy/security protocols (TLS 1.2, ELK stack), network connectivity, Direct Connect, and VPN.
* Testing: Proven experience in developing test plans, test cases, baselines, and executing end-to-end testing.

**Preferred / Advantageous Skills**

* Understanding of performance tuning for Spark, Hive, and Redshift.
* Basic understanding of SSO, LDAP, OAuth, SAML, and Active Directory.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to emerging technologies in a fast-paced environment.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) / Master of Computer Applications (MCA).

d00309b7.title: Delivery Management Leader – AI productivity solutions
d00309b7.description:
We are seeking a **Delivery Management Leader** for AI productivity solutions to drive the successful delivery of high-impact AI programs across diverse industries.

This role requires a strong background in application development (Java/.Net), expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), and the ability to lead large cross-functional teams in delivering scalable, efficient AI solutions that accelerate time-to-market and business value.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance and post-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such as scope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Manage multi-project portfolios and large cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration across engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture and DevOps
* Own the program governance model, engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels and maintaining alignment on key deliverables, risks and financial health
* Take full accountability for client portfolio financials, including revenue recognition, profitability, margin improvement, budget forecasting and corrective action planning
* Identify and drive cost optimization and OPEX reduction through automation, resource optimization and enhanced delivery models
* Monitor resource utilization, productivity metrics and workforce optimization strategies to align resources with program outcomes
* Serve as the primary client liaison for senior-level relationships, translating business challenges into actionable delivery strategies and maintaining alignment with client objectives
* Conduct Steering Committee sessions and executive-level communications to provide delivery updates, propose innovations and manage escalations
* Build, lead and mentor large distributed teams, cultivating high performance and driving talent development through mentoring and coaching
* Mediate resource conflicts, resolve escalations and ensure delivery deadlines are met, planning for contingencies with robust mitigation actions
* Identify, assess and mitigate program risks to ensure delivery schedules and client KPIs are not impacted, ensuring continuity of services during high-pressure situations
* Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, develop strategies for expanding the organization’s footprint and partner with sales and pre-sales teams on RFPs, SOWs and business proposals
* Drive continuous innovation for client projects through automation, process enhancements and adoption of emerging technologies, promoting best practices in cloud-native applications, data platforms, AI/ML and DevOps pipelines
* Lead end-to-end AI program delivery, including execution of Agentic AI and AI productivity solutions, management of delivery roadmaps, implementation of AI accelerators, and establishment of KPIs to track and improve delivery efficiency

**Requirements**

* 13 to 15 years of IT experience, with 8+ years in delivery leadership roles and 3+ years in AI/ML projects
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise AI programs, including LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and automation use cases
* Deep understanding of cloud-native AI services on AWS or Azure
* Expertise in large-scale enterprise programs across industries such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail or Life Sciences
* Strong ability to influence and manage senior-level client stakeholders, including Directors, VPs and CXOs, while building trusted relationships
* Pragmatic leadership approach to resolve escalations, handle conflicts within delivery teams and overcome program challenges effectively
* Familiarity with modern engineering technologies and delivery methods, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices and DevOps, data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery) and automation frameworks like RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA-driven managed services delivery
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and traditional Waterfall-based delivery
* Exceptional leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills for managing high-pressure situations and improving delivery performance
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and deliver results under challenging timelines
* Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal abilities for fostering team and client collaboration
