8ce8ee49.title: IT Delivery Manager - Java/.NET
8ce8ee49.description:
We are looking for an outstanding, business-savvy, and technically skilled **IT Delivery Manager** with **14 to 18 years** of IT industry expertise to lead our enterprise software delivery portfolios.

Within this role, you will own the strategic delivery roadmap, operational execution, and engineering excellence across multiple, cross-functional teams building and modernizing large-scale systems on Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks. You will serve as a strategic bridge between executive business leaders, product management, and engineering teams, driving robust Agile delivery frameworks while upholding high standards of code quality, architecture scalability, and cloud governance.

Our ideal candidate has evolved from a strong technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of overseeing multi-million-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next-generation tech leaders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks
* Champion and scale Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple distributed product engineering teams, optimizing velocity, cycle time, and release predictability
* Manage and optimize the portfolio budget, forecasting resource needs, controlling operational expenses (OpEx/CapEx), and ensuring high ROI
* Establish robust delivery governance, spot systemic delivery risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans to safeguard critical business timelines and SLAs
* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications through Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to assess and optimize productivity gains realized through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, making sure development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Collaborate closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering on the Java Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET Ecosystem (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Drive continuous improvement across delivery pipelines, championing automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps; oversee strategic offshore/nearshore development partners, manage SOWs, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure third-party deliverables meet quality and security standards
* Mentor and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers (onshore, offshore, and hybrid), cultivating a culture of psychological safety, accountability, continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot), and innovation
* Set clear performance goals, share constructive feedback, and identify and nurture high-potential talent within the organization

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a business-related discipline
* 14 to 18 years of overall IT industry experience
* 6+ years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Director role overseeing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering, with hands-on experience across Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL solutions
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and automated testing frameworks
* Skills in vendor management, SOW negotiation, and executive stakeholder engagement

**Nice to have**

* MBA or equivalent advanced business credential
* Showcase of leading engineering transformations powered by GenAI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot)
* Capability to spearhead legacy monolithic-to-microservices modernization programs at enterprise scale
* Background in collaborating with Enterprise Architects on cloud-native migration strategies

6f2f25da.title: Value Architect, Consultant(2-4Yrs)
6f2f25da.description:
### **Description**

As a key part of the Infor cloud sales initiative, the mission of the CloudHub team is to support Infor sales teams in CloudSuite pursuits globally. Collaborating with the direct sales teams to shape deliverable CloudSuite infrastructure and solutions is a key driver of increased win rates, bigger deal sizes and lower discount rates. CloudHub validates every CloudSuite deal through a team-built, rule-driven validation and architecture pipeline that does the first pass and keeps evolving. Value Architects own the judgment layer: they interpret the results, shape the deal position, and lead the conversation with sales and product teams. The goal is to ensure a seamless customer experience during onboarding and implementation.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

Quickly build a point of view on each deal from system-generated validation and architecture context, and take it into sales and customer conversations  

* Review generated outputs critically, question the gaps, and add the context automation cannot
* Lead due-diligence discussions with Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Services and Customer Success on product readiness, deployment availability, integrations, localizations and cloud operability
* Bring clear, well-reasoned positions to difficult deal discussions, and handle them with composure and good judgment
* Keep validation rules and mappings current as products evolve release to release, and suggest improvements to the pipeline
* Communicate clearly and confidently with internal stakeholders and customers

Experience in a SaaS or software product company, ideally in product management (APM/associate PM) or presales, with exposure to continuous release cycles

9198f033.title: Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)
9198f033.description:
**Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)**

Sajal Tech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Bhopal (On-site) | Full-time | 1 to 4 years experience

**About Us**

Sajal Tech Solutions is an AI-first software development company based in Bhopal. We build SaaS products, AI/ML solutions, mobile apps and automation for clients in India, the US, the UK and the UAE. We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 certifications, and we are a DPIIT-recognised startup and MSME.

**Role Summary**

You will run our government and enterprise IT bidding from start to finish. That means finding opportunities, understanding the technical scope, writing the proposal and submitting a compliant bid on time. You will work closely with our Head of Business Development and the technical team, and you need to know software well enough to write about it convincingly.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Tenders & Bids*

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

* Understands the SDLC and Agile, and how web, mobile, ERP and SaaS projects are scoped, built and maintained
* Can read and break down technical scope covering portals, ERP, mobile apps, APIs and integrations, cloud hosting, AI/ML and AMC/O&M
* Familiar with cloud basics (AWS, Azure, GCP), MeitY-empanelled cloud, hosting, backup and DR
* Knows common government IT requirements: GIGW and accessibility, CERT-In security audits, STQC, data localisation, SLA/uptime and penalty clauses, ISO 27001
* Can prepare effort and manpower estimates with the tech team and sanity-check a BOQ

**Good to Have**

* Background as a developer, business analyst or pre-sales engineer
* Experience with international RFPs (Middle East, UK, US)
* Can create basic architecture diagrams (draw.io, Lucidchart or similar)
* Uses AI tools to draft and review documents faster

**What We Offer**

* Salary:
  **₹2.5 to ₹6**
  **LPA**
  , plus an incentive on won bids
* Work directly with the founders, the BD head and the engineering team
* Clear path to a Bid Manager / Pre-Sales Lead role
* A fast-growing AI-first company with international clients

is seeking a Solutions Engineer who will work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment as a trusted advisor for the field sales force and a product advocate for our products. The individual will be responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process. The Solutions Engineer must be able to articulate technology and product positioning to both business and technical users. The position is ideal for an individual with prior testing (
*Manual or Automated*
) experience and who looks forward with interfacing with customers.
  
  
Lexington Soft partners with some of the world’s best DevOps solution providers and are constantly working with the world’s most recognized organizations, providing software testing tools that help shape the future of software.

0626083a.description:
**Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**

  

**Role:**

As a **Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**, you will lead an engineering pod (stream) building features for an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own the technical design of your stream within the clients architecture governance, break the backlog into deliverable work, and make sure every sprint ships production-ready, well-tested code. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines solution design, code and design reviews, and day-to-day guidance of a team of backend, data/AI, frontend and quality engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical design and solution architecture for your stream, aligned with the clients architecture governance, standards and review processes.
* Break down epics and features into well-defined user stories and technical tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates.
* Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done.
* Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards.
* Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms.
* Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation & deployment sign-off.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions.

**What Youll Bring:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years as a Tech Lead or Solution Architect.
* Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management.
* Exp. with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira & Confluence.
* Good understanding of secure coding, OAuth2/SSO and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building connectors or integrations with SaaS, cloud or data platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Exposure to GenAI/LLM-based applications and agentic AI frameworks.
* Domain knowledge of data privacy, data governance, security or AI governance products.
* Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

  

**Why join us?**

* Build enterprise-grade products in data privacy, AI governance that are used worldwide.
* Work hands-on technologies across GenAI, agentic AI, cloud (AWS and Azure), full-stack engineering.
* Learn from experienced architects, engineering leaders through mentorship, design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Grow your career with twice-yearly appraisals, certification support and a promote-from-within culture.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits as a full-time employee.
* Be part of an award-winning, CMMI Level 3 appraised data and AI company.

cc447711.title: Senior Architect - GCI
cc447711.description:
Senior Solutions Architect — Governance, Compliance, & Insights
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
The interesting work in enterprise security has moved inside the organization. AI agents are creating new insider risk and compliance obligations every day. Data is sprawling faster than the controls around it. At Mimecast, our product lines sit where all of that converges.
  
  
This is an architecture role reporting directly to an Enterprise Architect (EA). You’ll work alongside other Solutions Architects on the team to shape how the product evolves, how it integrates with the rest of Mimecast, and how it stays ahead of where the market is going.
  
  
The Solutions Architect role at Mimecast sits closer to the product problem. Discovery, shaping, and contract design now drive more of the value than detailed component design. If you primarily want to be a heads-down individual contributor, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to shape what gets built and own the structural decisions that make a product line move fast with quality, it is.
  
  
AI-First Architecture at Mimecast
  
  
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. We expect this role to use AI development tools daily — for design exploration, prototyping, documentation, code review, and analysis. This is not optional and it is not bolt-on; it is how we work.
  
  
You will also be designing systems that incorporate AI directly. This product line is actively building agent-aware detections and AI-driven enrichment, and contributing to Mimecast’s broader AI-powered risk products. Comfort designing with — and for — LLMs, agents, and modern AI architectures is core to this job, not a side interest.
  
  
We treat architecture artifacts — ADRs, AGENTS.md files (agent-readable repo context), and data contracts — as machine-readable context, not documentation. They’re the substrate that humans and agents both operate inside, and they capture the reasoning behind design decisions — the why, not just the what.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a leadership role shaping the future of Mimecast's Governance, Compliance & Insight (GCI) suite. GCI helps organizations manage data governance, retention, and compliance at scale. Our products include email & collaboration archiving, eDiscovery, compliance management, data retention, audit capabilities, and analytics, alongside our new AI-powered governance and compliance tools.
  
  
You will be the connective tissue across product management, user experience, and engineering to translate real customer problems into effective, efficient solutions. You will help the team unlock value across Mimecast’s entire portfolio to help customers navigate the human and agentic risks they face every day.
  
  
We operate with a sense of urgency. Cyber threats don't wait, and neither do we. You'll lead teams that move fast, make decisions with conviction, and deliver results. We expect leaders who thrive in this environment and inspire the same urgency in the teams around you.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Shape problems with product partners: Contribute at the problem-framing stage, not just after requirements land. Run and facilitate workshops with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and subject matter experts to surface user needs, constraints, and opportunities. Define what “good” looks like in customer and business terms before settling on a technical shape.
* Own integration contracts as product artifacts: Help define how the product line touches the rest of the Mimecast platform. You’ll own the durable interfaces — APIs, events, and data contracts. You’ll also do the coordination work that makes integrations actually land.
* Build the architectural context engineering teams operate inside: ADRs, data contracts, and service interaction patterns. These are how architecture decisions get propagated and enforced at scale across humans and agents — they’re part of the build system, not the wiki.
* Set NFR and evaluability targets: Performance, availability, security, cost — help define the targets with real numbers. For AI features, extend that to eval coverage, agent boundary safety, and prompt/data-contract stability.
* Coordinate across teams and organizations: A lot of the impact in this role comes from getting the right people in the room, gathering stakeholder buy-in, and shepherding decisions to closure.
* Engage Enterprise Architecture bidirectionally: Bring cross-product and platform-level decisions to the EA for alignment. Pull EA-level constraints into product shaping early. Push back when standards don’t fit your situation, with a clear case.
* Estimate and monitor cost and unit economics: Provide cost projections for new architecture work; flag unexpected spend and propose remediation. Reason about cost per outcome — per protected user, per investigated incident, per inference — not just AWS spend.
* Wear a technical-architect hat when it adds value: Default mode is solution and product shaping. Drop into detailed technical design when the problem warrants it or when you’re unblocking a team — and know when to step back out. With agentic engineering practices in place, more of the detailed implementation work is carried by engineers with AI assistance.
* Propose technical debt work: Identify and prioritize debt reduction with Product Management partners.

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* Architecture experience at scale: 8+ years building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams.
* Cloud-native depth: Strong working knowledge of AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC), Kafka, and the ability to reason about distributed systems at high volume. You don’t need deeper AWS internals knowledge than the senior engineers — you need to reason about system shape and trade-offs.
* Contract-first integration thinking: A track record of designing clean contracts between systems and teams — async messaging, event streaming, REST/gRPC APIs, data contracts — and a clear point of view on when to reach for which.
* Product partnership: Comfortable working with PMs on problem definition, customer research synthesis, jobs-to-be-done framing, and outcome hypotheses. You have a point of view on what makes a good product bet, not just a good technical bet.
* AI-First working style: You actively use AI development tools day-to-day and have a real opinion on where they help and where they don’t. You’re comfortable designing systems that include LLMs, agents, retrieval, or related components — or you’re hungry to get there fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication: Can write a one-page ADR that lands, draft a solution brief that holds up under EA review, and lead a whiteboard session that produces a decision. Equally comfortable with engineers, PMs, and designers.
* Stakeholder navigation: Good at building consensus across teams and organizations. Comfortable with ambiguity.
* Self-direction: Driven, accountable, and able to identify the right problems to work on without being told. The team is small and senior — you’ll be expected to lead, not wait for direction.
* Bonus points: Background in security, compliance, eDiscovery, identity, observability, or data platforms. Familiarity with agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or LLM application architecture. Experience with eval design for AI systems, product discovery practices, or data contract / data mesh approaches (e.g., ODCS).

What We Offer
  
  

* Impact: Your architecture decisions will shape one of Mimecast’s fastest-evolving product lines and protect data inside thousands of enterprises.
* Voice: Direct working relationship with senior architecture leadership and a real say in technology direction across the product line — and beyond, as opportunities present themselves.
* Modern stack and modern ways of working: AWS managed services, Kafka, modern Java and Kotlin services, a growing AI tooling footprint, and a team that defaults to ship-and-iterate over review-and-gate.
* Senior peers: A small architecture team where everyone is operating at a high level and trust runs deep.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of professional software engineering and architecture experience, with at least 2 years in a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or similar role with significant product-shaping responsibility.
* Willingness and drive to use AI development tools in a professional setting.

**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
  
  
*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

e2e5eef6.description: Role Summary Discovery, Preclinical, and Translational Solutions (DP&TS) sits at the center of Pfizer’s scientific software work, building the digital tools that help researchers move from target identification through clinical translation. We’re looking for a Solution Engineer to own data storage and registration for integrative biology research. This is a hands-on role: you’ll design, build, and maintain the capabilities that determine how biological research data gets stored, registered, and accessed. You’ll partner with the aligned capability lead to scope and prioritize what gets built, and work across scientific, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and useful for researchers. You’ll work hands-on in AWS and GCP, building storage and data services that span both clouds and hold large omics datasets (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging). You’ll need depth in large-scale data management and cross-cloud integration, plus enough scientific fluency to earn credibility with computational biologists and engineers alike. Reporting to the Principal Engineer, Integrative Biology Solutions, you’ll define the technical direction for data storage and registration within the Integrative Biology space, aligning with scientific strategy, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture. You’re expected to be hands-on writing and reviewing real code, not just directing while also setting the standards and patterns that guide contractors and cross-functional teams. You’ll lead contractor teams as needed to extend capacity. You’re the primary technical owner: individual engineering depth combined with cross-functional leadership. The problems are real, large-scale, heterogeneous scientific data with strict regulatory requirements, and the solutions need to hold up at research scale. Key Responsibilities Own and Lead Data Storage and Registration Solutions: own data storage and registration end-to-end: design, implementation, and maintenance. Work with the Capability Lead to prioritize and scope features. Lead contractors as needed to extend capacity. Set the storage, metadata, and stewardship standards that make Integrative Biology omics data trustworthy, reusable, and AI-ready across AWS and GCP. Define Standards and Best Practices: establish and maintain standards, architectural patterns, and governance frameworks for the capability area. Get them documented and adopted by delivery teams and contractors. Collaborate with Capability Lead and Business Stakeholders: work closely with the R&D capability lead to understand business needs, translate scientific requirements into technical solutions, and keep the backlog prioritized. Be the technical partner scientists and product stakeholders can rely on. Lead Contractor Teams and Drive Delivery: direct contractors as needed: provide technical guidance, review their work, and hold the line on quality, scope, and timelines. Provide Technical Guidance and Architecture Leadership: make and document key technical decisions, review designs and implementations, and guide technical direction for contractors and cross-functional partners in the capability area. Drive Innovation, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence: identify and address technical debt, performance issues, and security gaps. Keep the platform moving forward in line with changing research and business needs. Solve Highly Complex and Cross-Disciplinary Problems: solve complex data engineering and storage challenges: large-scale heterogeneous scientific data, demanding research workflows, and the compliance requirements that come with a regulated environment. Build and Operate Cross-Cloud Storage and Data Services: design and implement storage, registration, and data access capabilities across AWS and GCP. Own identity federation, network connectivity, data movement, and replication between clouds so researchers can work with data where it lives without duplicating it. Manage Data Lifecycle, Performance, and Cost at Scale: define storage tiering, retention, archival, and egress policies for very large omics datasets. Monitor storage and transfer costs and tune for throughput on high-volume analytical and pipeline workloads. Basic Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline) Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, or solution engineering roles, with demonstrated hands-on delivery of complex data storage, registration, or related platform capabilities. Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data storage and registration solutions in a scientific or regulated enterprise environment, including hands-on implementation accountability. Experience defining standards, best practices, and technical patterns within a capability or domain area, and driving their adoption across delivery teams. Strong technical background in data engineering, cloud-native platforms, and software development, with the ability to contribute individually and lead contractor teams toward delivery outcomes. Hands-on experience designing and operating storage and data services in both AWS and GCP, including at least one production system that integrates data or services across the two clouds. Experience managing very large scientific or research datasets (hundreds of terabytes to petabytes), including tiering, lifecycle management, performance tuning, and cost control. Technical Skills Proficiency in Python, Typescript, Java, or other modern high-level language Expertise in infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Helm) and CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) AWS: S3 (including storage classes and Glacier), IAM, Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, and high-throughput file storage such as FSx for Lustre. Cross-cloud integration: identity federation between AWS and GCP, private connectivity (Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, Cross-Cloud Interconnect), data transfer and replication tooling (e.g., Storage Transfer Service, DataSync), and egress cost management. Modern data architectures: lakehouse patterns and open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) that work across cloud engines. Omics data: working knowledge of common formats (FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, Parquet, HDF5/AnnData, Zarr) and how their size and access patterns affect storage design. Other Requirements Demonstrated experience in working with regulated data, compliance frameworks, and secure development practices Ability to lead complex engineering efforts across global, cross-functional teams Fluent in English; capable of clear technical communication across scientific and engineering disciplines Preferred Qualifications Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline) Domain Expertise Experience supporting pharmaceutical R&D, life sciences, or computational biology Familiarity with GA4GH standards for omics data (DRS, htsget, refget, Passports) and FAIR data principles Experience with scientific workflow platforms such as Nextflow, Snakemake, AWS HealthOmics, or Google Cloud Batch. AWS or GCP professional-level certifications, such as Solutions Architect Professional or Professional Cloud Architect. dd1d979a.title: Principal Program Manager, Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance
dd1d979a.description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a highly skilled program manager with strong understanding of Artificial intelligence technology and its transformative potential. With deep expertise in leading complex, cross-functional programs, you thrive in fast-paced environments where strategic thinking and execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executive leadership, and excel at aligning program objectives with organizational strategy.
  
  
You bring a proven track record of managing enterprise-scale AI initiatives, including the evaluation and integration of new models, tools, and third-party solutions. Your leadership style fosters a culture of continuous improvement, and you are adept at change management, ensuring smooth adoption of Gen/Agentic AI technologies across corporate functions. If you are energized by the challenge of shaping the future of AI at scale, Synopsys offers you the platform to make a lasting impact.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Lead and scale Synopsys' enterprise AI Governance operating model across GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, third-party AI solutions, and internal AI applications, establishing processes for intake, evaluation, approval, monitoring, risk management, and lifecycle oversight
* Partner with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Procurement, Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate AI technologies and use cases, ensuring alignment across risk, regulatory compliance, IP protection, privacy, and security requirements
* Operationalize governance frameworks including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and Responsible AI principles, translating them into practical workflows that balance innovation velocity with enterprise risk
* Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
* Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
* Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
* Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company-wide
* Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
* Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
* Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
* Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high-tech industry
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision-making
* Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* 12+ years of experience leading complex enterprise-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high-tech environments
* Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
* Experience coordinating cross-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
* Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
* Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc.
* Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
* You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow-through
* You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
* You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
* You manage multiple high-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
* You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

1e207941.description:
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring**
If you understand AI well enough to explain it in a customer meeting, and you get just as excited about solving a business problem as a technical one, these roles were written for you. Customers come to SAP with specific problems, a timeline, and a board asking questions. Your job is to understand what they're actually facing, work out what AI can genuinely do for them, and help them get there. With 400,000 customers across every industry, the scale and variety of what you'll be working on is unlike most roles in tech right now.
  
  
You independently engage customers throughout the sales cycle, delivering compelling demonstrations and solution stories that differentiate SAP. You combine strong commercial awareness with an
**AI-native advisory approach**
— bringing creativity and the genuine ability to make technology tangible
**for any customer, across any industry and any solution domain**
.
  
  

* Skilled at conducting thorough client needs assessments across varied industries and solution areas, translating complex customer requirements into tailored solution positioning built on business insight
* Strong command of AI value selling, positioning SAP's AI capabilities confidently and shaping how customers approach their AI investment decisions across their organisation
* Skilled in system-integrated vibe coding — applying AI-assisted development approaches within SAP's technology ecosystem to prototype and customise demonstration environments rapidly, driven by creativity and commercial instinct
* Demonstrated use of rapid field prototyping to build, iterate, and deliver high-impact demo content quickly across SAP's full solution portfolio in response to specific customer needs
* Skilled at developing and delivering customer value propositions that align SAP solution capabilities to measurable business outcomes across any industry or customer context
* Degree not required for this role.

We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
  
  
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
You will independently engage customers at critical points in the sales cycle — developing and delivering differentiated demonstrations, co-creating the SAP vision with customers and partners, and building adoption and revenue outcomes
**across SAP's full solution portfolio**
.
  
  

* Independently engage customers throughout the sales cycle, developing and delivering compelling stories and demonstrations across any SAP solution domain that illustrate differentiated business outcomes
* Lead client needs assessments, translating varied customer requirements into solution strategies that drive co-creation and adoption in any industry or solution context
* Apply AI value selling to position SAP's AI capabilities compellingly and shape how customers think about their AI investment decisions
* Use system-integrated vibe coding to prototype and customise demonstration environments within SAP's technology ecosystem, delivering tailored experiences that respond directly to any customer requirement
* Apply rapid field prototyping to build and iterate high-impact demo content at pace, tailored to specific customer contexts across SAP's full portfolio
* Build and deliver customer value propositions that position SAP solutions at the centre of measurable business outcomes for any customer, in any industry

**Where you belong**
You will be part of the Customer Value Group, a global solution advisory community that values customer engagement, solution expertise, and revenue growth through trusted relationships. At this level you operate with real independence — engaging customers with authority
**across SAP's full solution portfolio**
, building trusted relationships, and delivering advisory outcomes that influence purchase decisions. It is an environment for someone who
**thrives on variety**
, takes genuine pride in the quality and impact of their work,
**and brings the same energy and rigour to every customer regardless of industry or domain**
.
  
  
As we transform into the autonomous enterprise, we are proactively engaging with talent who will play a key role in building the capabilities required to deliver on our 2027 priorities.
  
  
**#SAPCVGCareers**
Additional Information
  
  
**About SAP**
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
  
  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
  
  
We win with inclusion
  
  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
  
  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
  
  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
  
  
Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
  
  
AI Usage in the Recruitment Process
  
  
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
  
  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

05d2ad7d.description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

c577b1ae.title: Solution Architect – Data & AI Solutions
c577b1ae.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Presales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client-ready demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business-outcome-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client conversations, highlighting differentiators of Data & AI Solutions.

Solution Architecture & Demo Environments
  
  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.
* Design abstraction layers for multi-model AI orchestration, including fallback logic, dynamic model switching, and cost control.
* Lead implementation of event-driven architectures using messaging frameworks (Kafka, Pulsar, SQS, etc.) and state machines.
* Build reusable, industry-specific demo environments leveraging hyperscaler services and data platforms.

Observability, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real-time alerting).
* Implement zero-trust security models (RBAC/ABAC, IAM, OAuth2, encryption, API gateways).
* Ensure all demo and client environments meet compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Innovation & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: - Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).

**Skills & Experience**
Must-Have Skills & Experience
  
  

* 15+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: - Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and client engagement skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and usage-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro-frontends, data visualizations).
* Experience building presales demo or sandbox environments.

Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM-based orchestration.

bd090ab6.title: Solution Architect
bd090ab6.description:
**Role overview**

EDMO is looking for a Solutions Architect to own how this will work for this customer across complex university implementations. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, engineering, and implementation, ensuring that what is promised to clients is technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with EDMOs core platform.

You will lead technical discovery, design endtoend solutions(especially integrations and configuration), and guide implementations so that each deployment is repeatable rather than a oneoff custom project.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery with universities
* Run deepdive sessions with client IT and admissions teams to understand systems (CRM/SIS/LMS), telephony/chat stack (e.g., Genesys), SSO, security/compliance, and dataflow requirements.
* Translate business and admissionsprocess needs into clear technical requirements,
* constraints, and nonfunctional expectations (performance, privacy, retention, observability).
* Design endtoend solutions and integrations
* Own the solution blueprint for each customer: integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, MCPs / connectors), data contracts, mapping to CRM/SIS, and event flows into EDMO.
* Decide what is configuration vs. product gap vs. true custom work, clearly articulating tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure solutions adhere to EDMOs architectural guardrails on security, multitenancy, scalability, and maintainability.
* Presales and scoping support
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success in latestage opportunities as the senior technical voice, especially where integrations and complex workflows are involved.
* Validate feasibility, effort, and risks before contracts/SOWs are signed, helping ensure EDMO does not commit to nonviable or nonscalable customizations.
* Contribute to RFP responses, solution summaries, and executivelevel technical presentations for key accounts.
* Implementation oversight and handoff
* Work closely with Implementation / Professional Services to turn the solution blueprint into a concrete plan: milestones, cutover strategy, environments, data migration, and UAT.Stay engaged through golive as an escalation point for scope changes, new technical risks, and critical design decisions that affect stability or timeline.
* Ensure a clean transition from project mode to steadystate Customer Success, with clear documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Architecture, standards, and product feedback
* Champion repeatability: push toward configuration, patterns, and reusable assets/templates instead of bespoke code on every project.
* Work with the CTO and Product to feed recurring client needs and integration patterns into the roadmap and reference architecture.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reference diagrams, and best practices for integrations, security reviews, and enterprise onboarding.

  

**What success looks like**

* Enterprise university implementations go live with stable, observable integrations and minimal postgolive firefighting.
* Deals are scoped realistically, with fewer we sold something we cannot or should not build situations.
* Over time, more of what you design becomes standardized features and implementation patterns, reducing custom effort per customer.

**Required experience**

* 10+ years in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, Integration Architect, Senior Engineer, or Solutions/PreSales Engineer in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong experience designing and implementing integrations between SaaS platforms and enterprise systems (CRM/SIS/ERP, telephony/contactcenter, identity providers, data platforms).
* Solid understanding of modern integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, eventdriven architecture, iPaaS/MCPstyle connectors, and data synchronization strategies.
* Handson familiarity with at least some of: Salesforce or other CRM, student information systems, contactcenter platforms (e.g., Genesys), and cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform. GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure is also acceptable.
* Working knowledge of serverless architectures and managed database services (e.g., Cloud SQL, Firestore, BigQuery, RDS, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Proven track record working directly with enterprise customers, leading technical workshops, and navigating between business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to create clear solution artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration specs, sequencing diagrams, and SOW inputs understandable by both engineers and nontechnical leaders

b1d1584a.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical consulting
* 3 years of experience in advanced AI/ML architecture, deploying generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions globally.
* Experience in Python including implementation and deployment of tiered microservices applications.
* Experience deploying production-grade cloud infrastructure or architecting and building cloud-based data solutions (e.g., enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, data pipelines, and associated technologies).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree, Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.
* Deep understanding and applied experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty).
* Excellence in architecting highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases.
* Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., patents, published research, keynotes) in Generative AI, agentic workflows, or large-scale cloud data infrastructure.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you'll play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You'll work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise-scale technical challenges.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 25e3ff27.title: HR Solution Architect
25e3ff27.description:
**Hiring: HR Solution Architect**

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**HR Solution Architect**
to bridge HR strategy, business processes, employee experience and enterprise technology architecture.

The ideal candidate will translate complex HR business requirements into scalable, secure and effective technology solutions. This role requires a problem-first approach, evaluating multiple solution options across HR platforms, process redesign, enterprise integrations, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

You will work closely with HR leadership, enterprise architects, technology teams, data, security and business stakeholders to define solution strategies, architecture roadmaps and technology recommendations that deliver measurable business value.

The role requires a combination of strong HR technology knowledge, enterprise solutioning capabilities, integration architecture understanding and awareness of emerging AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Solution Architecture & Process Design**

* Lead business discovery, requirement assessment, process mapping and solution design engagements.
* Evaluate existing HR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, digitisation and automation.
* Design end-to-end HR workflows covering recruitment, onboarding, core HR, employee services, performance, learning, compensation and workforce management.
* Evaluate technology options based on business value, scalability, complexity, security, cost and long-term sustainability.
* Develop solution blueprints, architecture recommendations, business cases and design documentation.

**2. HR Technology & AI Solutioning**

* Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation and AI agents across HR processes.
* Assess whether business requirements are best addressed through existing HCM platforms, enterprise AI solutions, third-party tools, custom applications or hybrid approaches.
* Contribute to the design of AI-enabled HR assistants, conversational solutions, intelligent workflows and agent-based applications.
* Define proof-of-concept approaches, success measures, validation criteria and deployment considerations.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, escalation mechanisms and accountability in AI-enabled HR workflows.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Architecture**

* Define integration approaches across HR applications, enterprise platforms, APIs, data services and automation solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance on REST APIs, event-driven integrations, middleware, data pipelines and system interoperability.
* Promote reusable integration patterns and scalable architecture while reducing fragmented systems and point-to-point dependencies.
* Partner with enterprise, cloud, security, data and infrastructure architects to ensure alignment with technology standards.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, solution governance and technical decision-making.

**4. HR Data Governance & Responsible AI**

* Ensure employee and candidate data is handled securely and in accordance with privacy, compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Incorporate data protection, access controls, data minimisation, retention, auditability and transparency into solution designs.
* Evaluate AI-related risks such as bias, inaccurate outputs, confidentiality, explainability and inappropriate automation.
* Ensure human review and appropriate controls for sensitive HR decisions involving recruitment, compensation, performance and employee matters.
* Collaborate with HR, IT, Cyber Security, Legal, Risk and Data Governance teams.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Technology Roadmaps**

* Work closely with HR leaders, business stakeholders, product managers, technology teams and external vendors.
* Translate business challenges and technical architecture decisions into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead solution workshops, design discussions and cross-functional alignment sessions.
* Develop current-state and future-state architecture roadmaps aligned with HR and enterprise technology strategy.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the HR technology landscape, improve employee experience and increase operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Experience & Education**

* 15+ years of experience in HR technology, enterprise technology, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting or a related field.
* At least 7 years of experience in solution architecture, technical roadmaps, enterprise solution design or cross-platform technology strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Relevant equivalent experience may also be considered.

**HR Technology & Functional Expertise**

* Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, including Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Core HCM, Workforce Management, Performance Management, Learning, Compensation and Employee Services.
* Experience with HR technology transformation, HRIS implementations, process redesign and enterprise HR platforms.
* Ability to identify business and process challenges before recommending technology solutions.

**Solution & Integration Architecture**

* Strong understanding of enterprise solution architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integration patterns and data architecture fundamentals.
* Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware, data pipelines, identity management and security principles.
* Ability to develop conceptual and logical solution architectures and assess technical trade-offs.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, prototyping and software development lifecycle practices.

**AI, Automation & Responsible AI**

* Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLM-based applications, AI agents, intelligent automation and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration, conversational solution design, prompt engineering or agent interoperability.
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, including fairness, bias mitigation, reliability, transparency, explainability, privacy and human oversight.
* Ability to assess AI use cases and identify appropriate governance, controls and monitoring requirements.

**Stakeholder & Consulting Skills**

* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior HR and IT leaders and communicate complex technical concepts in business language.
* Strong consulting, facilitation, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with HR platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, ServiceNow HRSD, UKG, Phenom or similar enterprise solutions.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture and application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks, conversational AI or enterprise AI solution design.
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and HR data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business problems are clearly understood and process improvements are considered before technology selection.
* HR technology recommendations are scalable, secure, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise architecture.
* AI-enabled HR solutions are designed with appropriate governance, transparency and human oversight.
* HR applications, integrations, data services and AI capabilities work together as a connected ecosystem.
* Architecture recommendations enable informed decisions and measurable improvements in employee experience and HR operations.

**Additional Information**

* Primary work location: Gurugram, India.
* Work model: Hybrid.
* Working hours: Regular business hours, with flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.

* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
