**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

928669c5.title: Builder - Program Manager
928669c5.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a Program Manager to lead the rollout and ongoing improvement of calling and contact-center technology across business units. The role sits at the intersection of business operations, product, engineering, and external technology partners.

The person will translate business workflows into scalable dialer and lead-management solutions, coordinate integrations and launches, monitor service health, and resolve operational issues. Hands-on contact center and dialer experience is a must.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•
**Lead program discovery and delivery:**
Work with business units to understand customer journeys, calling workflows, agent needs, and operational requirements. Convert these into clear BRDs and PRDs, scoped plans, milestones, owners, and launch criteria.

•
**Implement dialer programs across business units:**
Coordinate end-to-end setup of campaigns, queues, agent centers, routing and assignment logic, call dispositions, retries, callbacks, recordings, and virtual numbers.

•
**Bridge business, product, and technology:**
Translate operational needs into clear requirements for product, engineering, CRM, and vendor teams. Coordinate API, webhook, CRM, and other system integrations, and track delivery through testing and launch.

•
**Manage lead orchestration**
: Define how leads are created, deduplicated, assigned, routed, attempted, followed up, and closed. Ensure call outcomes and lead status sync correctly with source systems.

•
**Own testing, go-live, and stabilization:**
Coordinate UAT, agent readiness, launch communications, issue triage, and post-launch monitoring for new campaigns and workflows.

•
**Manage platform and infrastructure readiness:**
Coordinate agent IDs, tenant and user setup, channel and license allocation, number provisioning, and capacity planning across campaigns.

•
**Monitor operational health and governance:**
Track lead volumes, lead-to-attempt conversion, call connectivity, call drops, campaign activity, and critical bot or missed-call flows. Identify anomalies and coordinate timely resolution.

•
**Lead incident triage and root-cause analysis:**
Be a first point of coordination when dialer, telephony, CRM, or lead-flow issues occur. Determine whether the issue relates to configuration, data, platform, network, or a vendor, and drive it to resolution.

•
**Manage external partners:**
Coordinate requirements, integrations, escalations, service issues, and operational changes with dialer and telecom vendors.

•
**Support compliance and number governance:**
Coordinate NDNC/DNC complaint investigation and suppression workflows, and maintain oversight of number allocation, whitelisting, and number lifecycle.

•
**Enable reporting and conversation intelligence:**
Coordinate business-unit onboarding to call analytics tools, including access, call-data pipelines, reporting, dashboards, and use-case configuration.

•
**Track program outcomes:**
Maintain clear status reporting, risks, dependencies, decisions, and measurable outcomes for stakeholders across business, product, technology, finance, and operations.

**PREREQUISITES**

• Prior contact center (CC) experience is mandatory. Candidates must understand contact-center operations, agent workflows, campaign execution, and the practical challenges of running high-volume calling.

• Hands-on experience with dialers or contact-center platforms is mandatory, including autodialers such as predictive, preview, or progressive dialing. Experience with platforms such as Ameyo, Ozonetel, Exotel, Servetel, or similar is relevant.

• Strong program management skills: able to structure work across multiple teams, manage dependencies and risks, and drive delivery through launch and stabilization.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including comfort with operational dashboards, funnel metrics, and incident investigation.

**Share your resume at mitansha.aggarwal@cars24.com**

d31319b1.title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
d31319b1.description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on propose, design, deploy network infrastructure and Campus LAN and integration with cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Design and lead enterprise networking solutions**
across Campus LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-LAN/SD-Access, Internet connectivity, and cloud networking integration.
  
  
**Own the end-to-end technical solution lifecycle**
, from opportunity qualification and requirement discovery through high-level design, solution validation, proposal development, customer presentation, and handover to delivery teams.
  
  
**Drive Intent-Based Networking (IBN) and network automation solutions**
, leveraging technologies such as Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco SD-Access, Aruba Central, APIs, telemetry, assurance, and policy-based network management.
  
  
**Develop secure network architectures**
incorporating next-generation firewalls, segmentation, NAC, Zero Trust, SASE, SSE, ZTNA, SWG, CASB, and other network-security capabilities.
  
  
**Translate customer business and technical requirements into compelling solution architectures**
, clearly articulating business value, technical benefits, operational improvements, scalability, resiliency, and security.
  
  
**Lead technical discovery workshops and customer presentations**
, engaging effectively with network architects, security teams, IT leadership, procurement teams, and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* CCIE or equivalent certifications.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Commercial Acumen

**What We Offer**
SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚
**Flex-day:**
You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-location:**
Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽
**Competitive benefits**
according to the local market
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process*

da35f5d6.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
  
  
The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI-First Delivery Leadership**

* Embed AI-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.

**Engineering Excellence**
Promote high-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
  
  
**Innovation & Thought Leadership**
Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
  
  
**Client Engagement & Solutioning**
Apply design thinking to develop user-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs-of-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
  
  
**Team Management & Mentorship**
Lead cross-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
  
  
**Quality & Compliance**
Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 16+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure environments with C-Level customer stakeholders

**Personal Attributes**

* Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
* Strong decision-making skills and a consultative mindset.
* Flexibility to manage in a fast-moving, ambiguous consulting environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. **Overview**
Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.
  
  
As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

c33c1441.title: AI Data Science Solutions Lead, Aladdin, Vice President
c33c1441.description:
**About This Role**
**Your Team**
The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams.
* Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value.
* Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness.
* Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions.
* Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards.
* Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively.

Your Experience
  
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments.
* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms.
* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
* Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques.
* Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

3c011fa8.title: Program Manager II, Global Catalog Operations
3c011fa8.description:
**Description**
Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
  
  
The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
  
  
The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection & Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
  
  
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Program Manager to join our rapidly growing team. The role is centered on developing insights and eliminating defects in quality that affects business metrics. As part of this role, you will work on 1) Creating mechanisms to identify, investigate, and solve quality issues impacting the business metrics, 2) Working collaboratively across our partner teams (ex: Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) to combine efforts to solve problems, 3) Developing data-driven approaches alongside our SWOT/BA teams to rapidly identify opportunity areas, and trends at scale, 4) You will take complex opportunities and break them down into manageable pieces, then ensure timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**As a Program Manager II You Will**

* Drive appropriate data-oriented analysis, adoption of technology solutions and process improvement projects to achieve operational and business goal
* Communicate and take the lead role in identifying Gaps in process areas and work with all stakeholders to resolve the gaps
* Be a SME for the process and a referral point for in-house and customer team
* Has the ability to drive business/operational metrics through quantitative decision making, and adoption of different tools and resources
* Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment driven by complex software systems and processes
* Ability to perform deep dive in the process and come up with process improvement solutions
* Shall collaborate effectively with customers (Science, Engineering, Product, etc.) to bring in improvements to the business metrics
* Provide regular updates on project progress and performance, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals.
* Exercise discretion in prioritizing process improvements, aligning them with broader business objectives.
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained. Implement corrective actions and maintain commitment to goals, ensuring on-time project completion and minimized losses.
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices to promote long-term solutions in dynamic environments.
* Drive continuous improvement and decision-making strategies.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. #SAPCVGCareers

ac687320.title: Senior Business Solutions Consultant
ac687320.description:
We're an Australia-based custom software company building bespoke solutions for Australian businesses. We're a global, remote team of talented people who enjoy solving hard problems together. Every project we build is custom, so our Solution Consultants work directly with real clients to turn complex, sometimes messy requirements into working solutions, not just configure an off-the-shelf product.

We're looking for an experienced Business Solutions Consultant who can independently lead client discovery, elicit and challenge business requirements, and translate them into practical functional solution designs for bespoke software applications. You'll work directly with Australian clients and collaborate closely with our development teams to design solutions within our established technical framework. Drawing on experience across different clients and industries, you'll quickly understand unfamiliar business processes, identify underlying issues, and confidently guide clients towards practical solutions.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Client Advisory & Leadership**

* **Trusted Advisor:**
  Analyse client issues from a holistic business lens, not just a software perspective.
* **Lead Requirements:**
  Run discovery sessions across multiple concurrent projects with little ramp-up time.
* **Senior Voice:**
  Challenge client assumptions and proposed solutions confidently when needed.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Manage expectations, align clients, and resolve conflicting requirements.

**Solution Design & Delivery**

* **Problem Solving:**
  Translate complex business requirements into practical functional software solutions within our established technical framework.
* **End-to-End BA Deliverables:**
  Own process maps, user stories, functional specs, prototypes, and acceptance criteria.
* **UI/UX Validation:**
  Design and validate flows and prototypes alongside developers and clients.
* **Trade-Off Analysis:**
  Weigh scope, technical feasibility, timeline, and budget to support design decisions.
* **Risk Management:**
  Spot scope risks, requirement gaps, and ambiguity early to prevent delivery issues.
* **Evaluate Solutions:**
  Measure proposed software against business requirements and technical constraints.

**Innovation & Team Growth**

* **AI Tool Productivity:**
  Use AI thoughtfully to improve solution design, documentation, and prototyping.
* **Mentorship:**
  Review the work of junior and mid-level BAs to raise the quality bar.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Improve requirements gathering, functional solution design, and documentation practices across the team.

**REQUIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Experience & Consulting Skills**

* **Senior Expertise:**
  7 to 10 years of experience in business analysis and functional solution design, preferably within custom software development or IT services companies.
* **Rapid Adaptability:**
  Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar business processes, elicit requirements, identify gaps, and propose practical software solutions.
* **Multi-Project Management:**
  Experience owning requirements across several concurrent, diverse projects.
* **English Fluency:**
  Excellent written and spoken English with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.

**Technical & Design Capabilities**

* **AI Literacy:**
  Hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis, prototyping, and requirement reviews.
* **Technical Grounding:**
  Basic understanding of data models, APIs, integrations, and tech trade-offs.
* **UI/UX Mockups:**
  Strong skills in wireframing, prototyping, and turning designs into developer specs.
* **Functional Solution Design:**
  Proven ability to independently translate client requirements into end-to-end functional designs, including workflows, business rules, user interactions, and exception handling.

**Mindset & Culture**

* **Proactive Ownership:**
  Independent worker who identifies next steps without waiting for direction.
* **Accountability:**
  Strong sense of ownership over the quality, accuracy, and outcomes of your work.
* **Collaboration:**
  Influence and guide peers while remaining open to feedback and continuous learning.
* **Culture Builder:**
  Active contributor to team connection, including our virtual Fun Fridays.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* **Consulting Background:**
  Experience in IT consulting or custom software development companies, working directly with clients across multiple projects and industries.
* **Technical Depth:**
  Familiarity with API and integration design.
* **Leadership:**
  Prior experience reviewing the work of junior and mid-level BAs.
* **Certifications:**
  CBAP or PMI-PBA credentials (a plus, not a must).

**Perks and Benefits**

* **100% Remote:**
  Full-time remote role within a globally connected team.
* **Growth:**
  Real opportunities for training, career advancement, and skill development.

ce4f8faf.title: Digital Engineering Solutions Specialist
ce4f8faf.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute technical assignments. Each day, you will deliver technical solutions as per agreed timeline and standards using established solutions. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting the development of technical expertise solutions and services.

  

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries based in Bangalore, India

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Design and implement project-specific system, network, and security architectures, delivering sustainable services to maintain cybersecurity standards.
* Ensure that project and service deliveries comply with defined cybersecurity levels
* Develop and introduce cybersecurity-related policies, standards, and practices and actively identify, manage, and mitigate cybersecurity risks.
* Stay ahead of current and emerging technologies and trends in cybersecurity and Represent ABB as a cybersecurity expert in customer engagements.
* Maintain and share an in-depth understanding of global cybersecurity risks, market requirements, regulations, and standards.

  

You will join a highly talented team, where you will be able to thrive

  

**Qualifications for the role:**

* 8-12 Years of experience in hands-on knowledge of domains in Active Directory, WSUS, ePO, system and network hardening, and application whitelisting and experience in CND activities (Protect, Detect, Respond, and Sustain) within a Computer Incident Response organization.
* Thorough understanding of the lifecycle of network threats, attack vectors, and exploitation methods, including intrusion tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, networking protocols, traffic flow, system administration, OSI model, defense-in-depth, and security elements and hands-on experience analyzing logs, network data (e.g., NetFlow, Full Packet Capture), and other attack artifacts for incident investigations
* Expertise in at least one enterprise SIEM platform (e.g., QRadar, Splunk, McAfee Enterprise Security Manager, or LogRhythm).
* Engineering degree with at least 4 years of experience in networking or cybersecurity and willingness to travel as required.

  

**More about us:**

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, reduce energy consumption and waste.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

8ae2c0e3.title: Lead Software Architect
8ae2c0e3.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

**Boeing Digital Services org** is currently looking for **Lead Software Architect** to join their team in Bengaluru, KA. As a Software Architect, you will be part of the Boeing Global Services, which develops software applications and products for that create direct value to its customers. We provide re-vamped work environments focused on delivering data-driven solutions at a rapidly increased pace over traditional development. Be a part of our

passionate and motivated team who are excited to use the latest in software technologies for modern web and mobile application development. Through our products we deliver innovative solutions to our global customer base at an accelerated pace.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to clearly communicate with other team members

* Demonstrated ability to create positive impact on customer by developing polished, cohesive, effective, and user-friendly applications for large and complex aviation related systems

* Candidate must be a self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, and strong analytical and creative problem-Solving skills and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment

* Able to communicate with others on the team virtually

* Experience in understanding and interacting with multiple data formats

* Ability to rapidly learn and understand software from source code

* Knowledge and/or experience of SAFe projects and processes desirable

* Organization skills to manage a workload of various tasks, which may be interrupted by high priority system issues or requests.

* Estimate user stories/features (story point estimation) and tasks in hours with the required level of accuracy and commit them as part of Sprint Planning

* Contributes to the Backlog refinement meetings by promptly asking relevant questions to ensure requirements achieve the right level of DOR

* Works with the Product Owner to confirm that the code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality

* Raise any impediments/risks (technical/operational/personal) they come across accordingly to arrive at a solution

* Update the status and the remaining efforts for their tasks on a daily basis

* Ensures change requests are treated correctly and tracked in the system, impact analysis done and risks/timelines are appropriately communicated

* Develops working software towards committed Team PI Objectives and Iteration plans

* Delivers working software in accordance with expected quality standards

* Designs for testability: Design and evolve the system to support testability and test automation

* Works on prototyping and evaluating technical feasibility

* Own and drive the end-to-end solution and technical architecture for complex, mission-critical aviation systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business goals.

* Define and govern architectural guidelines, design patterns, coding standards, and best practices across multiple development teams.

* Lead design reviews and architecture governance, making and clearly documenting key technical decisions and trade-offs (performance, cost, scalability, security).

* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to Lead and Senior Engineers, guiding them through complex design and implementation challenges.

* Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and tools; drive proofs-of-concept to validate architectural approaches before adoption.

* Define non-functional requirements and ensure the architecture delivers the required scalability, availability, resiliency, security, and observability.

* Partner with Product Management, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into a scalable and maintainable technical roadmap.

* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to define CI/CD, deployment, and cloud infrastructure strategy on Microsoft Azure.

* Identify and mitigate architectural risks and technical debt, and drive continuous improvement of the system landscape.

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for the program, communicating architecture and technical direction to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Define the architecture for integrating AI, ML, and LLM capabilities into products - agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, model APIs, and intelligent automation - and set the standards for building and operating them in production.

* Establish responsible-AI and governance practices, and guide teams on adopting AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot) effectively and responsibly.

* Own the modernization strategy for legacy / brownfield systems, selecting appropriate approaches (strangler fig, lift-and-refactor, incremental modernization) and sequencing the transition.

* Define the full-stack and API architecture (REST and GraphQL) and the integration patterns across distributed, multi-cloud enterprise environments.

* Evaluate AI/ML feature quality, reliability, and operational readiness, and define the testability, observability, and metrics needed to support them in production.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.

* Full stack developer who has excellent programming skills in the latest tools & technology frameworks like Java 8+ (Core and Advanced), Spring Boot 3.x, Angular 12, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS

* Must have hands-on experience with message brokers; knowledge of either Kafka or RabbitMQ is a mandatory requirement for designing reliable asynchronous workflows, event-driven integrations, and ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

* Experience with cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure

* Proficient in writing unit and integration tests using tools like Jest

* Asynchronous Programming: Proficiency in asynchronous programming concepts, including callbacks, promises, and async/await,

* Debugging and Testing: Being able to effectively debug and test JavaScript code using tools like browser developer tools and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest or Mocha)

* Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems like Git is important for collaborating with other developers and managing code changes.

* Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills are crucial for a JavaScript developer to be able to analyze and solve complex programming challenges.

* Knowledge of Web APIs: Understanding how to interact with various web APIs, such as fetching data from a server or integrating with third-party services

* Good experience on Database technologies like SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL

* Hands-on experience with Build and Deployment tools and languages. Experience in best practices and Tools around CI/CD.

* Knowledge of integrating with Maven, Gradle and Shell scripting.

* Experience with Azure Cloud is highly preferrable

* Proven experience as a Software Architect or Technical Lead defining end-to-end solution architecture for large-scale, enterprise Java applications.

* Deep expertise in architecting microservices and distributed systems using Java 8+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/GraphQL API design.

* Strong command of software architecture patterns and principles - Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven architecture, CQRS, SOLID, and the 12-factor app methodology.

* Hands-on experience designing cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure (AKS, App Services, Functions, API Management, Event Hubs) including containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.

* Expertise in defining non-functional requirements - scalability, performance, high availability, resiliency, and observability - and designing systems to meet them.

**Job Description: Cloud Infrastructure Solution Architect – Pre-sales and Practice**

**Function:**
Enterprise Infrastructure Services / Cloud & Infrastructure Practice

**Location:**
Chennai / Remote / Hybrid

**Suggested experience:**
16+ years

**Role orientation:**
~60–70% Solution Architecture & Presales | ~30–40% Practice Development

**Role Summary**

The Cloud Infrastructure Solution Architect will be responsible for designing secure, scalable, resilient and cost-effective cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions for enterprise customers.

The role will provide technical leadership across customer pursuits, cloud transformation programs, infrastructure modernization and managed services solutions spanning
**Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, hybrid cloud, data center, networking, security, observability, automation and platform operations**
.

In addition to solutioning responsibilities, the architect will play a key role in
**developing and scaling the Cloud & Infrastructure Practice**
, including creating service offerings, reference architectures, accelerators, reusable solution assets, estimation models, technical standards and capability development programs.

The role supports the broader infrastructure practice direction already established around Cloud Services, Hybrid Infrastructure, Data Center Operations, Network Services, Cybersecurity Operations, Workplace Services, DevOps/Platform Engineering and Infrastructure Automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Presales & Solutioning**

* Lead technical solutioning for infrastructure and cloud opportunities.
* Participate in customer discovery and requirement workshops.
* Translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures and service models.
* Lead technical responses for
  **RFPs, RFIs and proposals**
  .
* Develop:
* Solution architectures
* Scope and assumptions
* Effort estimates
* Resource models
* Transition plans
* Technical risks and dependencies
* Pricing inputs
* Present proposed solutions to customer architects, CIO/CTO organizations and infrastructure leadership.
* Support technical due diligence and solution defense sessions.
* Work with Sales, Delivery and Commercial teams to create competitive and commercially viable solutions.

**2. Cloud Practice Development**

The architect will have a specific charter to help
**industrialize and scale the practice**
, rather than working only opportunity by opportunity.

* Help define the Cloud & Infrastructure
  **service portfolio and practice roadmap**
  .
* Develop packaged offerings such as:
* Cloud Readiness & Assessment
* Cloud Migration Factory
* Azure/AWS Landing Zone
* Cloud Infrastructure Managed Services
* Hybrid Cloud Management
* Cloud FinOps & Cost Optimization
* Cloud Security & Compliance
* Infrastructure Automation
* Observability & AIOps
* Backup and Disaster Recovery as a Service
* Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, templates and solution blueprints.
* Build
  **estimators, sizing models, pricing templates and reusable proposal assets**
  .
* Develop Proofs of Concept and demonstrable solution accelerators.
* Establish architecture standards and technical governance.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend additions to the practice portfolio.

**3. Technology Partnerships & Alliances**

* Develop solution capabilities around strategic cloud ecosystem partners.
* Work with
  **Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Oracle**
  and leading infrastructure/security technology vendors.
* Support partner competency and certification requirements.
* Identify opportunities for joint solutions, marketplace offerings and co-sell motions.
* Evaluate new ISV/platform partnerships relevant to the infrastructure portfolio.

**Required Technical Competencies Area**

**Expected capability**

Cloud: Deep expertise in Azure and/or AWS; good multi-cloud understanding

Hybrid Cloud: Azure Arc, VMware, hybrid connectivity and migration architectures

IaC: Terraform, Bicep, ARM and/or CloudFormation

Containers: Kubernetes, AKS/EKS/GKE

Networking: VNet/VPC, VPN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, DNS, load balancing, firewalls

Security: IAM, Zero Trust concepts, encryption, secrets, CSPM/cloud security

Observability: Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus and related platforms

DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab/Jenkins or equivalent

DR/BCP: Multi-region architecture, backup, replication and recovery patterns

FinOps: Cloud cost modelling, optimization, tagging and consumption governance

ITSM: Understanding of ITIL processes and managed infrastructure operations

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.
* **12–16+ years of overall IT infrastructure experience**
  , including at least
  **5–7 years in cloud architecture/solutioning**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience designing enterprise-scale Azure/AWS cloud solutions.
* Experience with cloud migration and infrastructure transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience in
  **presales, RFP solutioning, estimation and customer presentations**
  .
* Experience creating reusable architectures, solution assets or service offerings.
* Exposure to infrastructure managed services and global delivery models.
* Ability to balance
  **technology, delivery feasibility and commercial viability**
  .

**Preferred Certifications**

At least one senior-level cloud architecture certification would be desirable:

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
* Google Professional Cloud Architect
* TOGAF
* ITIL 4

**Success Measures / KPIs**

**Solutioning**

* Solution win rate and technical acceptance
* Accuracy of solution estimates
* Architecture/design quality
* Reduction in solution turnaround time

**Practice Development**

* 3–5 standardized offerings/solution blueprints developed annually
* Reusable accelerators and reference architectures created
* Increase in Cloud & Infrastructure pipeline influenced
* Certifications and capability improvement across the practice
* New partner-led solutions or competencies established

**Business Impact**

* Cloud/infrastructure revenue influenced
* Cross-sell/up-sell opportunities identified
* Customer transformation outcomes and solution CSAT

59d5e8b0.description:
Job Description Template

Job Title:
**AI Solution Architect**

**Must have skills: FDE (Forward deployed engineering)**

**Job Summary**

As an AI Architect, you will guide the strategy and delivery for interoperable, compliant, and economically viable modern AI solutions. You will architectures across a Hybrid AI landscape, blending. Frontier Models (Azure OpenAI/Gemini) with Cost-Efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) and Edge Inference. You will craft solutions based on advanced AI technologies from OpenAI, NVIDIA, Google, Microsoft and AWS. This role has a focus on enabling advanced Agentic AI solutions that transform core business functions and enable the future hybrid workforce. Working at the highest levels, you will engage AI, Technology and Business leaders in the world’s most successful organizations. You will lead architectural design, establish best practices, for our most complex AI initiatives. This role requires a combination of deep hands-on technical expertise in advanced AI with strategic business acumen, serving as both a technical authority and a trusted advisor to clients

**Key Responsibilities**

What you’ll do Multi-Agent Architecture Patterns:

• Define and govern reference architecture for multi-agent systems, covering hierarchical, peer-to peer, and sequential (ReAct) orchestration models.

• Guide teams on pattern selection based on client use cases.

• Memory System Design: Architect the standards for integrated memory systems, including short term session state, long-term knowledge via vector databases and knowledge graphs, and episodic/audit memory.

• Ensure coherent retrieval strategies across layers. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and CAG (Cache Augmented) Architecture: Define architectural patterns for end-to-end RAG pipelines, including chunking, embedding, vector search (e.g., Azure Cognitive Search, pgvector), and reranking.

• Ensure designs include standards for lineage, observability, and evaluation (e.g., RAGAS). Cross Cloud & Vendor Integration: Create and maintain decision frameworks for platform selection (e.g., Copilot Studio for Teams integration, Vertex AI for GCP workloads).

• Advise clients on balancing vendor lock-in risks with integration benefits.

• GenAIOps & Observability: Define the architectural standards for GenAIOps, including CI/CD, IaC, and observability. Establish standard metrics to track agent decision traces, latency, token consumption, hallucination, and cost.

• Safety, Security & Governance: Architect enterprise-wide guardrails for safety (hallucination mitigation), security (prompt injection defense, PII masking), and fairness (bias detection). Apply governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and design human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows.

• Enterprise Integration & Scalability: Architect scalable integration patterns for agentic systems with enterprise platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Teams, Dynamics/Salesforce, ERPs) and compute (Kubernetes). Ensure patterns address security, data residency, and compliance.

• 1 Technical Leadership & Client Advisory: Combine technical architecture with strategic guidance. Lead C-level workshops on Agentic AI adoption, advise on roadmaps, and shape technology strategy. Mentor other architects and contribute to industry thought leadership. Thought leadership and public speaking: Present at industry events and publish articles that advance the AI industry.

**Classification: Internal**

Core Qualifications (The Bar)

• Enterprise Experience: 8–10+ years in technical leadership, with a strong background in both software engineering and enterprise-scale cloud architecture.

• Cloud Expertise: Architectural expertise with one primary cloud platform (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and hands-on familiarity with at least one other.

• GenAI & LLM Depth: Demonstrated experience architecting and guiding solutions using GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or AWS Bedrock).

• RAG & Orchestration: Proven experience designing complex RAG pipelines.

• Model Fine-tuning: Experience with instruction tuning or fine-tuning strategies for LLMs.

• Leadership & Advisory Skills: Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated experience advising senior stakeholders (Director/C-Level) on technical strategy, roadmaps, and governance.

**Skill Requirements**

**Preferred Qualifications (The Differentiators)**

• Multi-Agent Systems: Deep understanding of, and experience designing or prototyping, advanced multi-agent systems (e.g., task decomposition, collaborative agents).

• Multi-Cloud Experience: hands-on architectural expertise across all three major clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• GenAI Ops & Governance: Hands-on experience with GenAI Ops tooling. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and their practical application. And AI FinOps & Model Routing

• Framework Expertise: Hands-on development experience with one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).

• Thought Leadership & Open Source: Published work (whitepapers, patents), conference speaking engagements, or active contributions to relevant open-source projects.

• Certifications: Professional-level cloud certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).

**Must Have Skills**

• Python

Good to have Skills
**Other Requirements**

• Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies

• We are looking for professionals who combine deep technical expertise with strong interpersonal and leadership abilities.

**Specifically:**

• Clear, Multi-Level Communication

• Strategic Thinking & Advisory Mindset

• Cross-Functional & Cross-Vendor Collaboration

• Pragmatic Problem-Solving

• Ownership & Accountability

• Continuous Learning & Adaptability

• Customer Obsession & Trust-Building

• Leadership & Mentorship

digital experience, portal/mobile/web app, UX with 12+years of experience

e7034c9a.title: Lead Architect / Solution Architect
e7034c9a.description:
Telecom Architect Autonomous Networks

**Job Title:** Telecom Architect (Network & OSS Integration)

**Location:** Gurgaon | **Department:** Network Digitization | **Level:** GM

  

Role Summary

We need a Telecom Architect who owns the end-to-end architecture across mobility, transport and core networks and the OSS/IT systems that run them, and who leads the move from automation to autonomous networks (TM Forum AN Levels 0–5).

You will define target architectures, integration interfaces and roadmaps that connect network elements, EMS/NMS and domain tools to orchestration, assurance, inventory and BSS. You are the bridge between Network Engineering, Transport and Planning teams, IT/OSS teams and vendors, turning operational needs into standards-based designs that deliver zero-touch provisioning, closed-loop assurance and AI-driven operations.

  

Key Responsibilities

Network & Solution Architecture

* Lead integration of OSS with elements managers across RAN, transport and core (4G EPC, 5G NSA/SA, 5G-Advanced readiness), including target-state designs, transition plans and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure designs adhere to TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, SID, ODA, Open APIs), 3GPP, O-RAN, ETSI and MEF standards.
* Translate complex network and operational requirements from NOC, Planning, Deployment and B2B teams into robust network and IT architecture.
* Run architecture reviews, technical assessments and proofs of concept for new technologies, vendors and COTS/SaaS platforms.

Service Fulfilment & Domain Tools

* Architect Service and Resource Order Management, service decomposition, orchestration and fall-out handling across multi-vendor, multi-domain networks (FTTx, MPLS, ILL, SD-WAN, Optical, mobile).
* Design Network and Service Inventory (active and passive) to give one real-time view of assets and topology, and Resource/Service Catalogs that drive zero-touch provisioning.
* Set the architecture for transport domain tools: inventory and topology, performance management, planning, service assurance, provisioning, and reporting and analytics, keeping them aligned and reliable at 24x7 scale.
* Define tool operating requirements: availability, data accuracy, SLAs and KPIs, and operational readiness.

Service Assurance & Autonomous Operations

* Architect end-to-end assurance: Fault, Performance and Service Quality Management, with topology-driven root-cause and service-impact analysis.
* Design closed-loop automation for proactive monitoring, self-healing and automated remediation, with SLA/SLO monitoring and streaming telemetry.
* Assess maturity against TM Forum Autonomous Networks and define the staged roadmap from automation to Level 3 and Level 4 and beyond.
* Define intent-based operations (TMF921), policy guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls for AI/ML models and agents.
* Build the data foundation (telemetry, topology, digital twin) that supports AIOps, predictive monitoring and agentic AI use cases such as self-healing, energy optimisation and capacity planning.

Integration & Technical Leadership

* Define integration patterns and API strategy: REST and event-driven (Kafka, RabbitMQ) for northbound links to CRM, billing and BSS, and southbound links to EMS/NMS, controllers and network elements.
* Guide development and integration teams through implementation, resolve complex technical blockers and ensure architectural compliance.
* Modernise legacy tools toward cloud-native, microservices and API-led platforms with low-touch operations.
* Evaluate and select vendors and COTS products, and support RFI/RFP and technical due diligence.

  

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* 15+ years in telecom, including 5+ years as an architect spanning network and OSS/IT domains.
* Proven delivery of large-scale OSS/BSS integration or transformation programmes at an operator, vendor or system integrator.
* Demonstrated experience defining or executing an automation or autonomous-network roadmap.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability in complex, distributed systems.
* Stakeholder management that bridges IT and Network Engineering, NOC, Planning and Deployment teams.
* Leadership: mentors technical teams and chairs design-authority forums.
* Clear communicator to executives and engineers; vendor-neutral and standards-first.

The ideal candidate will combine strong consulting and business acumen with experience in managing complex client engagements, leading cross-functional teams and translating business challenges into actionable, data-driven solutions. **Strategic Client & Engagement Management**

* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and ownership of client outcomes.

**Delivery Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement in engagement management processes, delivery frameworks and execution standards.
* Promote reuse of methodologies, best practices, analytical frameworks and lessons learned across client engagements.

* Exposure to account management, solution consulting, commercial proposals, cross-selling or account expansion.

* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and senior stakeholder management skills.
