71275b21.title: Delivery Manager, Software Development, AI & Digital Health
71275b21.description:
**JOB TITLE: Delivery Manager, Software Development, AI & Digital Health**

**LOCATION: Noida / Delhi India (Relocation package available for outstation candidate)**

Cancard Inc and Advaa Health are seeking an experienced, engaged, and hands-on, delivery head to with expert level understanding of software development lifecycle and proven background of delivering multiple products from conception to scale after launch. We would prefer candidates with hands on programming experience in Java (Spring Boot), Angular, and MERN stack.

Cancard Inc has been a multi-technology company based in Markham (Toronto) since 1989. Both Cancard and its sister company, Advaa Health, are at the forefront of transforming primary healthcare through technological innovation. Our mission is to empower primary care physicians with state-of-the-art digital tools and solutions that streamline their practices and significantly reduce administrative burdens and operational costs. Amidst increasing paperwork and complex administrative tasks faced by healthcare professionals, we serve as a key partner, enabling physicians to focus on patient care.

Our healthcare product portfolio leverages cutting-edge technologies in data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to offer seamless, intuitive, and cost-effective solutions. By integrating our systems, primary care practices can enhance patient engagement, optimize appointment scheduling, automate billing and coding processes, and access comprehensive patient health records in real-time. These advancements not only improve the quality of care provided but also contribute to a significant reduction in overhead costs.

This position offers a unique opportunity for senior engineers who are passionate about solving critical healthcare challenges by developing and delivering innovative products. The role provides direct experience and exposure to customers in the US, Canada, and other global markets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**1.     End-to-End Project Ownership:**

Oversee the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement gathering to deployment and post-launch support, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

**2.     Client & Stakeholder Management:**

Act as the primary point of contact for clients and business stakeholders. Translate business needs into technical deliverables, manage expectations, and maintain strong, trust-based relationships.

**3.     Technical Leadership:**

Provide strategic and tactical guidance to developers and technical leads working in Java, Angular, and MERN. Review architecture, design patterns, and provide hands-on support when needed.

**4.     Team Management & Development:**

Lead cross-functional agile teams, including backend/frontend developers, QA, UX, DevOps, and business analysts. Facilitate performance reviews, mentoring, skill development, and team engagement.

**5.     Agile Project Management:**

Champion Agile best practices including Scrum or Kanban methodologies. Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and ensure proper story estimation and prioritization.

**6.     Quality Assurance:**

Ensure robust testing practices (unit, integration, regression) are in place. Collaborate with QA teams to maintain high code quality and reliable delivery.

**7.     Delivery Governance & Reporting:**

Track key metrics such as sprint velocity, burn-down charts, code quality, and defect rates. Provide detailed progress reports, timelines, and status updates to internal and external stakeholders.

**8.     Risk Identification & Mitigation:**

Proactively identify delivery risks, technical constraints, or resource bottlenecks and work with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies.

**9.     Resource Planning:**

Assess project workload and align resources accordingly. Handle onboarding of new team members and coordinate with HR/Recruitment for staffing needs.

**10. DevOps and Release Management:**

Work closely with DevOps teams to ensure smooth CI/CD pipeline execution, environment management, version control, and secure release processes.

**11. Process Optimization:**

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery workflows. Analyze retrospectives to identify process inefficiencies and implement corrective actions.

**12. Documentation & Knowledge Management:**

Ensure proper documentation of technical specifications, user stories, and deployment guidelines. Promote knowledge sharing and reusability of components.

**13. Innovation & Technology Road-mapping:**

Stay up to date with industry trends, evaluate new tools and frameworks, and contribute to the technical roadmap and architecture decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

·       Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required. Master’s degree (MBA, M.Tech, or equivalent) is a strong plus.

·       Proven track record of building multiple product from design to deployment is a mandatory requirement.

·       Strong development background with hands-on coding experience in Java (Spring Boot), Angular, and the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).

·       Deep understanding of architectural patterns (monolith, microservices, serverless) and design principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS, etc.).

·       Proven track record of successfully managing end-to-end delivery of complex software solutions in an Agile or hybrid environment.

·       Strong experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and relevant tools (JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, etc.).

·       PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum certifications (CSM, PSM, SAFe Agilist).

·       Technical certifications in Java, AWS/Azure/GCP, or Full Stack Development (e.g., MongoDB Certified Developer, Oracle Java Programmer, etc.).

·       Excellent leadership, team-building, and conflict-resolution skills.

·       Strong communication abilities, with fluency in explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·       Experience managing distributed/remote teams across time zones is a plus.

·       Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes) and modern version control systems (Git, Bitbucket).

·       Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response tools (e.g., ELK Stack, Grafana, Splunk, New Relic) is advantageous.

·       Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

·       Adaptability and resilience in dynamic environments.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

·       Competitive salary and benefits package.

·       Flexible working hours and remote work options.

·       A dynamic and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

·       The chance to work on meaningful projects that have a real impact on healthcare.

Please submit yo

ur resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or project portfolios to pooja@cancard.com. In your cover letter, explain why you're interested in this role and how your background and experience make you a perfect fit for our team.

2075612a.description:
**About Beroe And MAX**
Beroe is a procurement intelligence company. Global enterprises rely on our market, supplier and category insight to make better sourcing decisions.
  
  
MAX is Beroe’s AI-powered decision engine for procurement, built in partnership with Kearney. It turns market signals, supplier risk and spend data into recommendations that CPOs and category leaders can act on.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You’ll be the hands-on demo specialist for MAX in APAC and Europe. You will deliver sharp, client-specific demonstrations to senior procurement and supply chain leaders, and you’ll build the collateral that makes those demos land.
  
  
You’ll work under the direction of the Presales & Solutions lead. Your job is to make every client conversation look polished, relevant and credible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Demonstrations**

* Deliver MAX demos to CPOs, CFOs, heads of category and supply chain leaders at enterprise accounts across APAC and Europe
* Tailor each demo to the client’s categories, spend profile, regional context and business priorities, using discovery notes from the account team
* Tie each demo to a clear value story (savings, risk reduction, speed to decision) and agree a concrete next step with the account executive
* Handle client questions on product, data and integration with confidence. Build a working understanding of AI and security topics (e.g., how MAX models work, data handling, access controls) so you can respond credibly, and escalate deeper technical questions to Product or the Director

**Collateral and demo assets**

* Build and maintain client-facing materials: tailored demo decks, one-pagers, use-case stories, ROI and business-case templates, and leave-behinds
* Create demo scripts and storylines by industry (e.g., pharma, chemicals, food & beverage, CPG), following the narrative standards set by the Director
* Work with Product to keep demo environments, sample data and sandboxes current and realistic
* Keep a clean, versioned library of assets that account teams can reuse

**Deal and event support**

* Support account executives with pre-demo preparation and follow-up materials
* Contribute to RFP and RFI responses on MAX (a regular part of the role, though not its core focus)
* Contribute to pilot design and success criteria, and help prepare pilot results readouts
* Represent MAX at industry events, client workshops and joint sessions with Kearney
* Capture client reactions and objections after each demo and share them with the Director, Product and Marketing

**Qualifications**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years in B2B software, consulting or procurement/supply chain, including 3+ years in presales, solution consulting, product specialist or demo roles
* Proven ability to deliver polished, client-specific demos to senior business audiences
* Working knowledge of procurement, sourcing or supply chain, from practice, consulting or selling into those functions
* Strong storytelling and visual communication skills, with a track record of building high-quality decks and collateral
* Comfort explaining AI and analytics platforms in plain business terms, or the curiosity and ability to build that quickly
* Excellent written and spoken English, and experience working with clients across multiple cultures and regions

**Nice-to-have**

* Background in procurement tech (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer) or procurement intelligence
* Consulting experience in operations or procurement
* Industry exposure to pharma/life sciences/chemicals or CPG

e32553ce.title: Senior Manager – Pre-Sales & Solutioning
e32553ce.description:
Who are we?
  
  
Kapture CX is an AI-native customer experience platform helping enterprises turn their messiest service operations into seamless, intelligent experiences. We build cutting-edge AI (agentic automation, voice AI, real-time intelligence) for industries where complexity is the default: banking, financial services, retail, e-commerce and beyond.
  
  
Headquartered in Bangalore with a growing presence in the US and Dubai, we serve 1,000+ enterprise clients across 18+ countries. We've raised $20M to date, we're profitable, and we're growing 100% year on year, a combination that's rare at the intersection of AI and SaaS.
  
  
Today we're a 400+ strong team, and we're looking for people who want to build AI that actually ships, scales and solves real problems.
  
  
What is this role about?
  
  
As a
**Senior Manager – Pre-Sales & Solutioning**
, you will work closely with the Sales team and enterprise customers to understand business requirements and design technology-driven solutions using Kapture's products and AI capabilities.
  
  
You will play a key role in managing solution discovery, product demonstrations, technical presentations, RFPs, POCs and proposals. This role requires a combination of strong product and technology understanding, consultative selling skills and the ability to translate complex customer requirements into scalable business solutions.
  
  
You will collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to ensure the proposed solutions align with customer expectations and business objectives.
  
  
Sounds interesting?
  
  
Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
  
  

* Understand customer business requirements, challenges and workflows, and translate them into effective technology solutions.
* Conduct solution discovery sessions and engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer needs.
* Drive product demonstrations, technical presentations, solution walkthroughs and proof of concepts (POCs).
* Design and present solution architectures covering product capabilities, integrations, APIs, workflows and implementation approaches.
* Work closely with Sales teams to support enterprise sales opportunities and develop compelling solution proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFI responses, technical documentation, solution presentations and commercial proposals in collaboration with internal teams.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to evaluate technical feasibility and address complex customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities to position AI, automation, CRM and customer experience solutions based on customer business needs.
* Support Sales teams in handling technical objections, customer queries and solution-related discussions.
* Develop solution documents, reusable demo environments, presentations and knowledge resources to strengthen sales enablement.

This is a
**Bangalore-based**
role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
  
  
What does success look like in this role?
  
  
You successfully support enterprise sales opportunities by delivering impactful product demonstrations, designing scalable solutions, understanding customer requirements and positioning Kapture's AI-led technology effectively. You act as a strong bridge between Sales, Product and Engineering teams, contributing to improved customer engagement and business conversions.
  
  
What would make you a good fit for this role?
  
  
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have 4–7 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture or similar technology-facing roles.
* You have experience working with Enterprise SaaS, B2B technology products, CRM, AI or automation platforms.
* You possess a strong understanding of technology products, APIs, integrations, cloud-based solutions and enterprise applications.
* You have hands-on experience conducting product demonstrations, solution presentations, POCs and technical discussions.
* You can understand complex business requirements and translate them into practical technology solutions.
* You have experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with business and technical stakeholders.
* You have strong communication, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and supporting multiple sales opportunities.

What are the most critical skills for this role?
  
  

* Strong product and technology understanding.
* Enterprise solutioning and consultative selling.
* Product demonstrations and technical presentations.
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud and SaaS platforms.
* Customer requirement gathering and solution discovery.
* RFP/RFI management and POC execution.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in simple business language.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have experience in AI, Customer Experience, CRM, Contact Centre Solutions, Automation or Enterprise SaaS.
* Have worked with enterprise customers across industries such as BFSI, Retail, E-commerce, Travel or Telecom.
* Have experience with omnichannel customer engagement platforms involving voice, chat, email and messaging channels.
* Understand AI/ML, Generative AI, conversational AI, chatbots, voicebots or agentic AI solutions.
* Have worked closely with Product, Engineering and Implementation teams on enterprise integrations and solution design.
* Have experience supporting international customers and complex enterprise sales cycles.

Why should you be interested?
  
  
**Here's What You Will Gain From This Role**

* Opportunity to work with an AI-first enterprise SaaS platform.
* Exposure to large enterprise customers across industries and international markets.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI, automation and customer experience solutions.
* High visibility and collaboration with Sales, Product and Engineering teams.
* Opportunity to influence enterprise deals through technology-led solutioning.
* A fast-paced environment with significant learning, ownership and career growth opportunities.

e4a7c68d.title: Senior Solutions Architect- Mumbai, India
e4a7c68d.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and solve our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be focused on excellence; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.
* Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.
* Creating and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.
* Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.
* Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.
* Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.
* Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.
* Creating collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.
* Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and enhancements to our engineering and leadership teams.
* Deepening both your sales and technical skills through self driven education while taking advantage of all the professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.

**What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of track record of success in a technical presales role (security background) — enough experience selling and implementing technology to earn your customer’s trust.
* A demonstrable ability to articulate and sell the benefits of modern platforms, software and technologies.
* A real passion for being curious and a continuous learner. You are someone that invests in yourself as much as you invest in your professional relationships.
* A history of successful customer relations where you developed an understanding of what made a difference, and devised architectures that helped meet a goal, tackle a problem, or outpace competitors.
* An ability to influence. Have you more than once convinced a team you worked for, of an idea, technology, or architectural pattern?
* The ability to inspire groups, both large and small.
* A willingness to travel within the region, as well as occasionally internationally where possible!

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
  
  
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate\_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
  
  
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws and can view the following posters linked below:

82613bf9.title: Solution Engineer
82613bf9.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

99cdb54b.description:
**Job Title: Director - Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Applications**

**Experience: 15+ Years on Oracle Sales Cloud (Cx)**

**Location:** **Hyderabad or Bengaluru**

**Working** **Hours:** **12:00pm** **to** **9.00pm**

  

**Role Summary:**

The Oracle Sales Cloud (CX) **Director** - Applications is responsible for leading the functional design, solution architecture, and delivery of Oracle Sales Cloud implementations, enhancements and support at Clean Harbors. This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT teams to ensure scalable, integrated, and business-aligned solutions that support revenue growth and customer engagement.

  

**Job Description:**

  

**Solution Architecture**

* Design and architect comprehensive Oracle Sales Cloud (CX) solutions leveraging Oracle-delivered best practices and latest features.
* **Define end-to-end functional solutions covering Oracle Sales CX (Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Forecasting), Oracle CX Service (Cases, Knowledge, Omnichannel) and Sales Analytics**
* Ensure seamless integration between Oracle Sales Cloud and Oracle Cloud ERP using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

Functional Leadership

* Lead functional design workshops (CRPs), requirement gathering, and fit-gap analysis.
* Translate business requirements into scalable functional designs and configuration approaches.
* Own functional solution design decisions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

Stakeholder Engagement

* Collaborate with Sales leadership, business users, and IT stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Oracle Sales Cloud capabilities and roadmap.
* Partner with Finance and SCM teams to ensure quote-to-cash process integrity.

Delivery & Governance

* Support Oracle Unified Method (OUM) based delivery across design, testing, and deployment phases.
* Review and approve functional design documents and test scenarios.

Continuous Improvement

* Stay current with Oracle Sales Cloud quarterly releases.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve adoption.
* Drive adoption of Oracle CX automation and analytics features.

Experience and Qualifications

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on experience in Oracle CX / Sales Cloud functional implementations, with proven experience in solution architecture and enterprise-scale implementations.
* Strong understanding of Lead-to-Opportunity and Quote-to-Cash business processes.
* Hands-on expertise in Oracle Sales Cloud modules including Leads, Opportunities, Forecasting, and Quotes.
* Experience integrating Oracle Sales Cloud with Oracle Cloud ERP.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

* Oracle Sales Cloud (CX) certification(s).
* Experience in large enterprise or multi-business-unit environments.
* Familiarity with Agile and hybrid delivery models, leveraging Jira, AHA and SNOW applications
* Exposure to Oracle CX analytics and AI-driven features.

Provide functional oversight to implementation partners and internal teams

  

**Education**

* Bachelors / Masters, degree in Costing and Supply Chain processes, Information Technology, or a related field.

  

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* Proven experience (15+ years) in Oracle Sales Cloud
* Strong understanding of Oracle Sales CX (Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Forecasting), Oracle CX Service (Cases, Knowledge, Omnichannel) and Sales Analytics applications and best practices applicable to supply chain operations and reporting aspects.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically.
* Demonstrated experience in leading large-scale projects and managing cross-functional teams.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders
* Oracle Cloud certification(s) in Sales Cloud modules is a plus.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with integrations between Oracle Cloud and other enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of sales regulations, reporting and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management frameworks.

bf863dc5.title: Walk-in || Presales Executive
bf863dc5.description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Presales Executive to handle incoming leads, connect with potential customers, understand their property requirements, and generate qualified leads for the sales team. The candidate should have excellent communication skills and a strong understanding of customer handling and lead management.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Handle incoming leads from digital marketing campaigns, property portals, social media, and other sources.
2. Make outbound calls to potential customers and explain project details.
3. Understand customer requirements, budget, location preferences, and investment objectives.
4. Share project information, brochures, pricing details, and other relevant property information.
5. Generate qualified leads and schedule site visits for the sales team.
6. Follow up with prospective customers through calls, WhatsApp, and emails.
7. Maintain and update customer information in CRM software.
8. Coordinate with the sales team to ensure smooth lead conversion.
9. Maintain daily call records, lead status, and follow-up reports.
10. Achieve assigned calling targets and lead qualification targets.

6dca0a7e.title: Solutions Engineer (Product  Services)
6dca0a7e.description:
At Vyn, we're reimagining how work gets done in the deskless world.
  
  
Our platform enriches expertly-curated short videos captured before, during, and after work with AI-powered automated workflows. We own the world's largest dataset of this kind, enabling field users and customers to make smarter, more efficient decisions about their assets and operations.
  
  
Our purpose is to deliver transformative commercial and environmental outcomes, helping global clients across utilities, telecoms, retail and energy improve pricing accuracy, speed up delivery, ensure safety, and maintain compliance.
  
  
Vyntelligence is a fast-growing SaaS company using Agentic Video Intelligence to transform field, asset and customer operations. Our customers are utilities, telecoms, energy and infrastructure organisations.
  
  
**The role**
As our customer base grows, so does the number of customers we take from first demo through trials, pilots and production. You'll understand their business problems, design solution options and configure our platform to solve them. You'll also work with Product and Engineering to turn what works for one customer into templates that make every future deployment faster.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Turn customer requirements and workflows into clear solution designs, storyboards and technical specs.
* Configure Vyntelligence for demos, trials, pilots and production, including workflow logic, data capture and integrations.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept using APIs and structured data.
* Support dashboards and reporting that give customers operational insight.
* Test new features and AI-enabled workflows before they reach customers, and troubleshoot configuration, data and integration issues.
* Document what you build and find ways to simplify, automate and reuse it.

**What You'll Need**

* 3 to 6 years in solution engineering, product implementation, technical consulting, business analysis or SaaS product solutions.
* Experience turning business requirements into technical or product solution designs.
* Hands-on knowledge of APIs, JSON, SQL, data flows and integrations.
* Experience supporting demos, prototypes, proofs of concept or customer-facing solutions on SaaS, cloud or workflow platforms.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and clear communication with customers and colleagues.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, MCA or similar.

**Nice to have:**
experience in utilities, telecoms, energy or field service; Python or JavaScript; AWS and dashboarding tools such as Amazon QuickSight; AI-enabled products or reusable solution templates.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.
  
  
We celebrate diversity in all forms and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
  
  
We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
If you need accommodations at any point in the hiring process, we’re here to support you.

**Job Description**
About Refold
  
  
Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.
  
  
Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.
  
  
Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.
  
  
Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.
  
  
We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technical win: Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* Build the proof, don't slide it: Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* Run crisp POCs: Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* Speak both languages: Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* Clear security and procurement: Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* Hand off clean: Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* Feed the platform: You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* Build the SE motion: Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information**

* Partners with: The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* Average deal size: $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* Average deal cycle: 3–6 months
* Technical buyers you'll face: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* Ideal customer: Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* Competitive set: iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* Current growth team: 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Proven SE: 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* Builder, not just a presenter: Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* Enterprise systems fluency: Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* Sales instinct: You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* Room-ready: You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* High ownership in ambiguity: No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

Nice to Have
  
  

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

54b75ae6.title: Lead ERP Product Architect - Cloud and SaaS Transformation
54b75ae6.description:
We're Hiring | Lead ERP Product Architect Cloud & SaaS Transformation

**Experience:** 17-25 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Remote  
**Location:** Remote (Occasional travel to Pune)  
**Notice Period:** Up to 60 Days

**Apply Here:** https://test.integraminds.in/imats/events/IMATS-06887/view

**Application Deadline: 19 November 2026**

  

Job Overview

We are hiring a **Lead ERP Product Architect** for a leading global enterprise software product organisation with a strong presence in manufacturing ERP solutions.

We are looking for an accomplished technology architect with extensive experience in enterprise ERP product engineering and architecture to lead the transformation of established ERP platforms into modern, cloud-native, SaaS and AI-ready enterprise solutions.

This is a strategic product architecture leadership opportunity involving close collaboration with senior Engineering and Product leadership to define the future architecture and technology roadmap of an established enterprise ERP platform.

  

**This is a product architecture role, not a traditional ERP implementation or solution consulting position.**

Key Responsibilities

* Define the target architecture and long-term technology roadmap for a large-scale ERP product.
* Lead the modernization of mature ERP platforms towards cloud-native and SaaS architectures.
* Drive architectural transformation across microservices, APIs, data architecture, integrations and extensibility.
* Establish scalable, secure and high-performance enterprise software architecture.
* Influence technical and architectural decisions across multiple engineering workstreams.
* Build technology foundations for intelligent and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with senior Engineering and Product leaders to translate product vision into scalable technology capabilities.
* Drive long-term platform evolution, modernization and architectural excellence.

  

Required Skills & Experience

* 17-25 years of experience in enterprise product engineering and architecture.
* **Mandatory experience in ERP product engineering or ERP product architecture.**
* Experience with ERP product companies such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, Epicor or comparable platforms.
* Strong expertise in ERP modernization and cloud/SaaS transformation.
* Strong technical grounding in AWS cloud infrastructure (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs, data architecture, extensibility and DevOps.
* Deep understanding of ERP product complexity, including customizations, integrations, upgrades and platform evolution.
* Ability to independently own architectural decisions and influence engineering teams.

  

Preferred Experience

* Manufacturing ERP product experience.
* Experience in enterprise AI applications.
* Experience transforming legacy ERP products into modern SaaS platforms.
* Exposure to large-scale enterprise software product development.

  

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

* ERP product engineering/architecture experience is mandatory.
* Candidates whose experience is exclusively in IT services, ERP implementation or consulting are not aligned with this opportunity.
* Candidates must have experience in enterprise ERP product development and architecture.

  

Educational Qualifications

BE / B.Sc. (IT) / MCA / M.Sc. / MS / ME

Additional Details

* **Work Location:** Remote, with occasional travel to Pune.
* **Notice Period:** Up to 60 days.
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent.

Apply Now

If you have extensive experience in enterprise ERP product architecture and are excited about shaping the next generation of cloud-native enterprise platforms, we would love to hear from you.

**Job Description**
About Refold
  
  
Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.
  
  
Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.
  
  
Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.
  
  
Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.
  
  
We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technical win: Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* Build the proof, don't slide it: Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* Run crisp POCs: Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* Speak both languages: Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* Clear security and procurement: Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* Hand off clean: Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* Feed the platform: You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* Build the SE motion: Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information**

* Partners with: The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* Average deal size: $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* Average deal cycle: 3–6 months
* Technical buyers you'll face: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* Ideal customer: Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* Competitive set: iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* Current growth team: 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Proven SE: 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* Builder, not just a presenter: Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* Enterprise systems fluency: Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* Sales instinct: You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* Room-ready: You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* High ownership in ambiguity: No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

Nice to Have
  
  

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

b7d79be3.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
b7d79be3.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A  

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

  

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

  

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

  

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

  

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

  

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

  

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

  

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

  

**More About Us**

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

045668e2.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Solution Architect for Global Partner Card, VP**

**Location: Pune - Magarpatta, India**

**Corporate Title: Vice President**

**Role Description**

* IT (Information Technology) Architects are responsible for a significant segment of the bank's architecture and ensuring it supports overall bank strategy; designing and overseeing the construction of complex IT systems and infrastructure, aligning technology solutions with business goals and requirements.

Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise and domain architects, engineers, QA, operations and vendors to align cross-domain dependencies and communicate architectural decisions; mentor teams and guide resolution of design and delivery trade-offs.  

**Your skills and experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in Java solution design and software development, with demonstrated experience owning end-to-end solution architecture and guiding enterprise application delivery.
* Strong experience translating business requirements into architectural designs, defining target states and transition roadmaps, and evaluating technology trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, maintainability and cost.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Spring Framework, supported by practical development experience; ability to assess design patterns, configuration, dependency management and transaction handling, and guide implementation teams.
* Proven experience designing microservices and REST APIs, including service boundaries, API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility and end-to-end integration; ability to evaluate synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Strong experience with Oracle-backed data architecture, including relational data modeling, data ownership, access patterns, transaction boundaries, consistency and schema evolution; sound knowledge of SQL performance, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and JDBC.
* Experience incorporating security, privacy and auditability into solution designs, including authentication, authorization, Spring Security, secrets management and sensitive-data protection; ability to work with security and control stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of distributed-system design and measurable non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, resilience and recoverability; experience evaluating failure scenarios, idempotency, retries and circuit breakers.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, documenting architectural decisions and managing design risks, dependencies and exceptions; ability to validate designs through prototypes and testing, and assess alignment with architecture principles and roadmaps.
* Sound knowledge of deployment and operational architecture, including CI/CD, environment configuration, observability and production readiness; familiarity with Spring Boot Actuator, metrics, logging and tracing, and experience resolving design-level production issues.
* Proven ability to influence business and technical stakeholders, collaborate with enterprise and domain architects and vendors, and mentor engineering teams; strong communication skills to explain complex designs, negotiate trade-offs and guide delivery in an Agile environment.
Desirable: experience with cards or payments applications and transaction processing, together with practical exposure to asynchronous messaging, container-based deployment and cloud architecture.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

32ea82ad.title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
32ea82ad.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)
* Experience designing generative AI, machine learning and data analytics solutions
* Experience with large-scale migration programs (1,000+ servers) using AWS migration tools and methods
* Software development experience in an object-oriented language

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra

43079463.title: AI Solution Architect – Presales & Technology Leadership
43079463.description:
About Antier Solutions

Antier Solutions is a technology company specialising in Blockchain, Web3 and emerging technologies, with a growing focus on Artificial Intelligence and enterprise AI solutions.

About the Role

Antier Solutions is looking for an accomplished
**AI Solution Architect**
with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI and enterprise technology architecture, combined with strong technical presales, solution consulting and engineering leadership experience.

The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering or AI engineering foundation, preferably developed within an
**AI-first organisation, AI product company or dedicated AI engineering business**
, where AI is central to its products and technology operations.

The role combines enterprise AI architecture, client-facing technical consulting, solution design and technology leadership. The individual will independently lead technical discovery, architect scalable AI solutions, guide engineering teams, handle enterprise presales engagements and translate complex business requirements into technically robust and commercially viable solutions.

The candidate will also contribute to strengthening AI engineering capabilities, evaluating emerging technologies and recommending architectural approaches that support long-term technology development.

Key Responsibilities1. AI Solution Architecture & Engineering

* Design end-to-end architectures for enterprise AI, ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
* Architect solutions involving LLMs, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI orchestration, APIs, vector databases, data pipelines and enterprise integrations.
* Evaluate AI models, frameworks, cloud platforms and infrastructure based on scalability, performance, security and cost.
* Define cloud, hybrid and on-premise deployment architectures.
* Guide engineering teams on technology selection, system design, implementation approaches and complex technical challenges.
* Establish architecture standards, review technical designs and ensure production readiness, reliability and maintainability.

2. Enterprise Presales & Technical Consulting

* Independently lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise clients, CTOs and business stakeholders.
* Understand business requirements, existing technology environments, data availability and operational challenges.
* Identify opportunities for AI, ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, technically feasible and commercially viable solutions.
* Lead technical solutioning from initial discovery through architecture definition, POCs and opportunity closure.
* Prepare and present technical proposals, architecture diagrams, solution documents and implementation approaches.
* Handle RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, solution demonstrations and technical negotiations.
* Defend architecture decisions, explain technology trade-offs and communicate AI solutions in terms of business value.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support enterprise client acquisition.

3. Technology Strategy & Innovation

* Evaluate existing AI capabilities, engineering practices and technology positioning.
* Recommend AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and architectural approaches for organisational development.
* Identify opportunities to build AI-powered products, reusable components, accelerators and enterprise solutions.
* Contribute to AI technology roadmaps, engineering standards and long-term architecture strategy.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for innovation and business growth.
* Advise on technology adoption, infrastructure investments, AI capabilities and engineering maturity.
* Explore potential technological convergence between AI, Blockchain, Web3 and decentralised systems.

4. Estimation, Delivery & Technical Leadership

* Assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, dependencies, risks and delivery requirements.
* Estimate project effort, resource requirements, team composition, infrastructure needs and timelines.
* Define project scope, assumptions, exclusions, milestones and deliverables.
* Align proposed architectures with engineering capabilities and delivery expectations.
* Facilitate technical handovers from presales to implementation teams.
* Guide and mentor senior engineers and technical leads.
* Drive architecture validation, technical experimentation, AI evaluation, deployment, monitoring, security and optimisation practices.

Required Experience & Technical Expertise

* 10+ years of overall experience across software engineering, AI engineering, solution architecture, enterprise consulting or technical leadership.
* Minimum 5 years of substantial experience in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, AI solution development or AI architecture.
* Strong preference for professionals from
  **AI-first companies, AI product organisations or dedicated AI engineering businesses**
  where AI is the primary technology and business focus.
* Strong software engineering foundation with expertise in system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, microservices and cloud architecture.
* Deep understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and enterprise AI applications.
* Practical experience with Python, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases and cloud AI services.
* Experience designing or architecting production-grade AI applications and scalable enterprise systems.
* Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, deployment, security, performance and optimisation.
* Proven experience in technical presales, enterprise solution consulting or client-facing architecture engagements.
* Ability to independently conduct technical discovery, design architectures, estimate implementation effort and present technical recommendations.
* Experience with technical proposals, POCs, RFPs/RFIs and enterprise client discussions.
* Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Significant experience in AI-first technology companies, AI product organisations or dedicated AI engineering businesses.
* Experience building AI-powered products or enterprise platforms from architecture through production deployment and scaling.
