We are expanding our Health Tech team and are looking for an experienced Account Manager & Pre-Sales Consultant to support the growth and adoption of our Healthcare RCM products. This role sits at the intersection of customer success, account management, and pre-sales, playing a critical role in driving customer confidence, product adoption, and revenue growth.

You will lead product demonstrations for prospective customers, partner with sales during the pre-sales cycle, and actively engage with existing clients to track account health, communicate KPIs, and clearly articulate value realization and ROI.

This is a fully remote role supporting US customers, requiring strong communication skills, customer-facing confidence, and a solid understanding of healthcare RCM workflows.

Key Responsibilities:

Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting:

· Lead and deliver compelling product demos tailored to customer workflows and pain points.

· Partner with Sales and Product teams during discovery, solution positioning, and proposal support.

· Understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities and value propositions.

· Support RFPs, pilots, and proof-of-concept discussions as needed.

Account Management & Customer Engagement:

· Act as a trusted partner for assigned customer accounts post-sale.

· Track customer health, usage trends, and adoption metrics.

· Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) and success check-ins with clients.

· Communicate KPIs, outcomes, and ROI clearly to customer stakeholders.

Value Realization & Retention:

· Articulate measurable business value delivered through the platform (e.g., efficiency gains, denial reduction, recovery improvements).

· Identify upsell and expansion opportunities in collaboration with Sales and Product teams.

· Proactively manage risks to customer satisfaction and retention.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

· Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams to relay customer feedback.

· Support smooth handoffs between sales, implementation, and ongoing account management.

· Help influence product roadmap through insights gathered from customers.

Required Qualifications:

· 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Pre-Sales roles.

· Prior exposure to Healthcare RCM workflows (Denials, AR, Payments, Eligibility, Coding, etc.) is strongly preferred.

· Experience presenting software solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to articulate business value, KPIs, and ROI confidently.

· Comfortable working in a US time zone in a fully remote setup.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience working with healthcare providers, billing companies, or health tech SaaS platforms.

· Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce or equivalent) and customer success metrics.

· Experience working with KPI, ROI evangelism and data reporting to customers.

· Experience supporting pilots, POCs, or solution evaluations.

Key Skills & Competencies

· Customer-centric mindset

· Solution selling and consultative approach

· Strong presentation and demo skills

· Analytical thinking with a focus on outcomes

· Cross-functional collaboration

· Ownership and accountability

Why Join Us?

· Be part of a fast-growing healthcare technology company building impactful RCM solutions.

· Work closely with innovative product and AI-driven teams.

· Fully remote role with exposure to US healthcare customers.

· Opportunity to grow into senior account management, solution consulting, or product-facing role

Interested candidates kindly send us your updated resume to careers@healthreconconnect.com

1e35e24a.title: Pre-Sales Executive
1e35e24a.description:
**Company Description**
Fusion Software Institute specializes in delivering industry-aligned IT training that supports fresh graduates and working professionals in launching or advancing their technology careers. The institute offers courses in areas such as Data Science, Data Analytics, Java Full Stack Development, AWS & DevOps, and Business Analysis, all led by experienced industry trainers. Programs emphasize practical learning through hands-on project work, interview preparation, and comprehensive placement support. Fusion Software Institute focuses on building real-world skills, confidence, and guidance to help learners secure high-paying, stable roles in the competitive IT job market. Applicants join a learner-centric organization committed to expert-led training and career growth.

**Role Description**
The Pre-Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division. In this role, the individual will engage prospective learners and corporate clients to understand their training needs, present tailored course offerings, and demonstrate how Fusion Software Institute’s programs address their career or organizational goals. Daily responsibilities include conducting product presentations and demos, responding to inquiries, preparing proposals, and coordinating with the sales and training teams to ensure accurate information sharing. The Pre-Sales Executive will qualify leads, maintain CRM records, follow up with prospects, and support the closure of training and enrollment deals. This role also involves contributing feedback from prospects to help improve course positioning and marketing materials.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with prospective learners and corporate clients.
* Solid understanding of IT training domains such as Data Science, Data Analytics, Full Stack Development, AWS & DevOps, and Business Analysis, or willingness to quickly learn these areas.
* Experience with lead qualification, CRM tools, and basic sales or pre-sales processes in education, IT training, or related industries.
* Ability to analyze client requirements and align them with appropriate training solutions and course offerings.
* Good organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple prospects and follow-ups simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a background in business, marketing, or IT is an advantage.
* Prior experience in pre-sales, counseling, business development, or inside sales is preferred but not mandatory.
* Comfort working in an on-site, target-driven environment and collaborating closely with sales and academic teams.

15c052b4.title: Consultant, Managed Services
15c052b4.description:
**We Breathe Life Into Data**

At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That's why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry's largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare's most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we're helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.

As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver "wow," and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

**Leadership At Komodo Health**

Mavens is a Komodo Health company focused on delivering Salesforce-based solutions that drive workflow and digital engagement across the life sciences industry. The Mavens Managed Services team partners closely with our customers post initial implementation to support long term success with our solutions. Our managed services team serves as trusted advisors who understand both the evolving technology and the business challenges our customers face.

Managed Services Consultants are the primary long-term partners for our customers, acting as a fully integrated extension of the customer's IT team. They balance day-to-day administrative support with complex release management, ensuring that applications are functioning properly to support business-critical processes. They play a strategic role in building and maintaining strong customer relationships and continuously seek opportunities to further assist customers with their evolving needs.

The ideal candidate is a goal-oriented and self-motivated individual who is comfortable working in fast-paced work environments. They demonstrate strong collaboration skills by working effectively across internal teams and with customers to drive shared outcomes. They hold themselves accountable to commitments and follow through with a high degree of ownership. They bring creativity and resourcefulness to problem-solving, finding practical solutions in ambiguous or complex situations. They approach interactions with empathy, fostering trust with both customers and colleagues.  
  

* This position involves rotational shifts.

**The Opportunity at Mavens**

**Key Activities - Dedicated Account Management**
-------------------------------------------------

**Ongoing Support & Maintenance**

* **User & Data Management:** Handle user lifecycle (creation, deactivation, permissions) and maintain data integrity (duplicate management, record updates).
* **Issue Management:** Investigate reported issues, monitor error reports, and triage/escalate problems as needed to ensure resolution.
* **Reporting:** Create and update reports and perform data extractions/exports for the customer.
* **Application Guidance & Training:** Deliver expert assistance, tips, and best practices for application usage, alongside support materials like Quick Reference Guides (QRGs).
* **Internal Collaboration:** Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal stakeholders to share customer context, coordinate delivery activities, and surface risks or escalations through the appropriate channels.

**Requirements & Build**

* **Analyze Business Needs:** Prepare for and participate in requirements gathering sessions.
* **Technical Implementation:** Assess Level of Effort (LOE) for functional items and complete configuration changes.
* **DevOps & Deployment:** Manage repositories and promote completed build to higher environments.
* **Maintain Documentation:** Manage requirements, test cases, functional and technical guides, integration specifications, and other application documentation.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* **Test Script Authoring:** Develop and maintain detailed test scripts encompassing functional, integration, and regression testing scenarios.
* **Validation:** Perform System Integration Testing (SIT) and provide guidance/support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* **Defect & Test Reporting:** Document, evaluate, and report test outcomes and defects clearly and with full contextual detail.
* **Spot Checks:** Validate deployments by checking changes in higher environments.

**Key Activities - Front-Line Operations**
------------------------------------------

**Product Support & Triage**

* **Support Case Triage:** Manage initial support case acknowledgement and triage, participating in a 24x5 shift rotation to cover off-hours intake.
* **Product How-To:** Assist users with functional questions, delivering clear advice and support on standard product capabilities and expected product behavior.
* **Product Defects:** Investigate reported product defects, reproducing in a Mavens base environment, triaging internally for resolution, and providing potential workarounds.

**Competencies**
----------------

* **Platform Expertise:** Strong knack for understanding how applications work and envisioning solutions on the Force.com platform.
* **Functional Advisory:** Ability to provide "how-to" technical assistance and advise customers on product features and enhancements.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to seamlessly connect and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Documentation Mastery:** Experience authoring requirements, system specifications, and application guides.
* **Project Management:** Understanding of core project management concepts, including timeline management and LOE assessment.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical experience is a significant plus.
* **Education & Certification:** Bachelor's degree preferred; Salesforce Certification is required.  

  **Values**
  ----------

  If you are wondering if this is the right role for you, ask yourself if you are already a Maven:

  + A Maven is open to saying yes and shows good judgment in ambiguity
  + A Maven takes accountability and is constantly learning
  + A Maven is fearless, resourceful, and scrappy
  + A Maven communicates with integrity, empathy, and humility
  + A Maven brings energy into the room and gives more than they take
  + A Maven in an entrepreneur who creates opportunity and momentum
  + A Maven is a craftsman who uses technology to solve business problems
  + A Maven makes our customer the hero

* **Additional skills and experience we'd prioritize (nice to have)…**

  + Salesforce Certification and consulting experience a plus
  + Life Sciences experience, particularly Pharmaceutical is a plus
  + Experience interacting with, managing, or building with AI agentic workflows
  

**Komodo's AI Standard**

  

At Komodo, we're not just witnessing the AI revolution – we're leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We've already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn't optional; it's foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn't just about efficiency; it's about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success.

***Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence.***  
  
**Where You'll Work**

Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub-based Dragons, we're building intentional in-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that's core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Komodo Health provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understand Komodo Health's Privacy Notice for Employees and Contractors.

*This notice explains how we collect, use, and retain applicant data.*

465d4c63.title: Solution Architect – Integration (Pre-Sales & Delivery)
465d4c63.description:
**Solution Architect – Integration (Pre-Sales & Delivery)**
===========================================================

**Location:** Bangalore (Hybrid)

**Experience:** 10+ Years

**Build Solutions. Challenge Assumptions. Solve Real Business Problems.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

At **Twenty20 Systems**, we believe great technology starts with asking the right questions.

We are looking for a **Solution Architect – Integration** who brings a strong *“Why mindset”* — someone who is naturally curious, challenges assumptions and looks beyond what the client is asking for to understand what they actually need.

You should be able to understand business challenges, identify gaps in existing processes, uncover customer pain points and translate those insights into scalable integration solutions.

This role goes beyond technical design. You will be a trusted technical advisor to our customers, helping them make the right technology decisions while owning solutions from initial discovery and pre-sales conversations through architecture and successful delivery.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Understand the Why:** Go beyond stated requirements to uncover the real business problem, operational challenges and customer pain points.
* **Client Discovery & Consulting:** Lead customer conversations, ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* **Solution Architecture:** Design scalable, secure and reliable enterprise integration solutions using iPaaS platforms, APIs and modern integration patterns.
* **Pre-Sales & Solutioning:** Drive technical discussions, solution proposals, architecture diagrams, effort estimations, POCs and client presentations.
* **Integration Strategy:** Design and review API-led, event-driven and cloud-based integration architectures across enterprise applications.
* **Problem Solving:** Evaluate different approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability and long-term impact.
* **Delivery Leadership:** Work closely with engineering teams to ensure solutions are implemented as designed, following architecture standards and best practices.
* **Technical Ownership:** Guide teams through complex integration challenges, troubleshooting, governance and production issues.
* **Team Enablement:** Mentor engineers, build reusable frameworks and contribute to improving architecture and delivery practices.
* **Business Impact:** Partner with sales, product and engineering teams to strengthen customer relationships and support business growth through effective technical solutioning.

**What Your First 3 Months Will Look Like**
-------------------------------------------

* Understand our product, integration ecosystem, delivery approach and customer landscape.
* Get involved in active client discussions and start leading technical discovery and pre-sales conversations.
* Support ongoing delivery programs with architecture guidance and solution oversight.
* Build strong alignment across sales, product, engineering and customer teams.

**Where You'll Be in 6 Months**
-------------------------------

* Independently leading end-to-end integration solutioning for key customer opportunities.
* Acting as a trusted technical advisor and helping clients make informed technology decisions.
* Driving architecture best practices and providing technical direction across delivery programs.
* Building reusable frameworks, standards and delivery practices.
* Contributing to business growth through stronger solutioning and customer confidence.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10–12 years of experience in IT, with strong experience in enterprise integration and solution architecture.
* Hands-on experience with iPaaS platforms such as **Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO** or similar integration technologies.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-based integrations.
* Experience designing end-to-end integration solutions across enterprise applications.
* Exposure to pre-sales activities such as client discovery, solution proposals, technical presentations, POCs and effort estimation.
* Ability to understand business requirements, identify underlying challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a natural curiosity to understand the *why* behind business requirements.
* Confidence in challenging existing approaches and presenting alternative solutions to customers.
* Experience mentoring engineering teams and providing technical direction.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.

**What Matters Most**
---------------------

We are not looking for someone who simply builds what the client asks for.

**We are looking for someone who understands why they need it, identifies what will actually solve their problem, challenges the status quo when needed and takes ownership of making it happen.**

You will architect, code, and prove ideas through proofs of concept (POCs), and you will use AI-assisted development to deliver faster without compromising quality. You will also coach colleagues and project teams throughout each phase of delivery.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Architect and advise
  
  

* Work with executive and client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and expectations, and align technology strategy to business value.
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, the Salesforce Platform, Agentforce, and emerging clouds.
* Design scalable, secure architectures with a focus on data models, sharing and security, governance, large data volumes, and governor limits.
* Define the solution landscape, including multi-org strategies, and identify gaps between current and desired end states.
* Lead technical design sessions and workshops, and produce clear technical design documentation.

Lead delivery and governance
  
  

* Build and ship during delivery. Lead custom development, integrations, and data migration.
* Guide integration best practices (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Platform Events), Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment and release management.
* Define coding standards across Apex, LWC, and Flow, and lead code reviews.
* Identify and manage risks early, and see technical issues through to resolution.
* Work with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Salesforce product teams to deliver successful outcomes and strong customer satisfaction.
* Work with Product and Salesforce support team to resolve product related limitations.

Support pre-sales and the practice
  
  

* Build POCs hands-on.
* Support pre-sales and estimations across emerging clouds, including discovery sessions and technical deep-dives.
* Coach and guide colleagues and project team members through each project phase, as a technical lead.
* Contribute to practice initiatives and share patterns and lessons learned from delivery.

Deliver with AI
  
  

* Use AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor every day to speed up analysis, development, integration, documentation, and debugging.
* Use our AI delivery platform and its agents, tools, and workflows across the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an AI-first delivery approach, and help clients embed AI capabilities, including Agentforce, with simple ways to measure business value.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude, Cursor.
* Working knowledge of AI-enabled delivery platforms. This is important for the role.
* Quick to learn new platform capabilities and AI technologies.

What You Bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 15+ years of Salesforce and over all experience, with strong hands-on Salesforce delivery and architecture experience.
* Technical consulting and implementation experience in a major software domain (such as CRM), and coding experience in an object-oriented language.
* Experience designing system architecture landscapes and delivering solutions that achieve business outcomes.
* Ability to build and ship in delivery and to build POCs yourself.
* A collaborative approach to coaching and guiding others.

Salesforce and architecture expertise
  
  

* Expert knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and the Platform, and an understanding of Agentforce architecture.
* Strength in data architecture, sharing and visibility, platform security, and design patterns, including Apex design patterns.
* Knowledge of large data volume best practices, authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth), and platform security.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with other systems (ETL, middleware, CPQ, marketing automation, and legacy platforms).
* Strong skills in Apex, Triggers, Flow, and LWC, with an understanding of environment management, release management, CI/CD, and deployment methods.

Depth in at least two emerging or industry clouds
  
  
Hands-on delivery experience in
**at least two**
of the following:
  
  

* Revenue Cloud (RCA+RCB)
* Loyalty Management
* Automotive Cloud
* Manufacturing Cloud and Rebate Management
* Retail Cloud (PoS)
* Consumer Goods (Rex and TPM)
* Slack
* Spiff
* B2B and B2C Commerce

Communication
  
  

* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain complex ideas to both developers and business leaders.
* Ability to document solutions as system diagrams, data flows, and technical artifacts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Life Sciences domain experience is good to have.
* Experience building agentic or multi-agent AI applications, or working with MCP, RAG, or LLM evaluation.

Certifications (good to have)
  
  

* Salesforce Core 5: Sales Cloud, Administrator, Platform Developer, Service Cloud and App builder
* Application Architect: Data and Sharing & Visibility Architect
* System Architect: Integration Architect, Identity and Access Management Architect, and Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

Join Version 1's Oracle Cloud Managed Services practice as an **Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant**, specialising in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and Oracle Fusion Cloud technologies.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically driven consultant who enjoys designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-grade integrations while working with some of the UK's and Ireland's leading Oracle Cloud customers. You will play a key role in delivering robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions across Oracle ERP, HCM, SCM, and third-party business applications, ensuring customers maximise the value of their Oracle Cloud investments.

Alongside integration delivery and support, you will contribute to reporting and analytics initiatives using Oracle BI Publisher, OTBI, helping customers gain meaningful insights from their Oracle Cloud data.

Working within a collaborative Managed Services environment, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical expertise across Oracle SaaS, PaaS, and OCI technologies while working closely with customers, architects, and functional consultants to solve complex business challenges.

**Why Join Version 1?**

* Work with leading Oracle Cloud customers across a variety of industries.

* Be part of a highly experienced Oracle Managed Services team delivering mission-critical solutions.
* Access ongoing training, Oracle certifications, and structured career development opportunities.
* Contribute to innovative cloud transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop your consulting, technical, and customer engagement skills while delivering business-critical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Oracle Integration Cloud**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, interface specifications, support procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in Oracle quarterly release reviews and assess impacts to integration solutions and technical components.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Design, develop, and support reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher (BIP), OTBI and related Oracle reporting technologies.
* Develop data extracts and reporting solutions across Oracle ERP, HCM, and SCM Cloud applications.
* Support reporting-related incidents, service requests, and enhancement activities within customer environments.
* Assist customers in translating reporting requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Ensure reporting solutions are accurate, performant, and aligned to business requirements through testing and validation.

**Managed Services & Customer Support**

* Provide high-quality support for Oracle Cloud integrations and reporting solutions within a Managed Services environment.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers, providing guidance on Oracle Cloud integration best practices.
* Work within established service management processes, ensuring incidents, problems, changes, and enhancements are effectively managed.
* Contribute to continual service improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies.

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential Skills & Experience**

**Oracle Integration Cloud**

* 5-7 years of experience working with Oracle Cloud technologies, including significant hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Strong experience developing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud APIs, including REST and SOAP web services, security credentials, and integration frameworks.
* Experience integrating Oracle ERP, HCM, and SCM applications with Oracle and third-party platforms.
* Strong understanding of integration design patterns, fault handling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation.
* Experience working with Oracle SaaS data interfaces, including BICC, FBDI, HDL, and file-based integrations.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud data structures, interface tables, and business processes.
* Experience working with OIC connectivity frameworks and integration security concepts.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with:
  + REST and SOAP Web Services
  + XML, XSLT, XPath, and JSON
  + SQL and PL/SQL
  + Data mapping and transformation techniques
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and integration security concepts.
* Experience producing technical documentation and solution designs.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Experience developing and supporting reporting solutions using Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) and OTBI.
* Understanding of Oracle Fusion reporting subject areas, security models, and reporting best practices.
* Experience creating analytical reports, dashboards, and data extracts.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working directly with customers and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Desirable Skills**

* Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC).
* Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI).
* Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS).
* Oracle Process Automation / BPM.
* Experience with CI/CD practices, source control, and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services.
* ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-based support organisations.
* Oracle Cloud certifications in OIC, Oracle Cloud Platform, or Oracle Fusion Applications.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passionate about technology and continuous learning.
* Strong customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
* Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues.
* Able to balance technical delivery with customer engagement and business outcomes.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

4a3c4185.title: AI Architect (Product Architecture)
4a3c4185.description:
**Company Description**

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

 **Job Description**

Sia is building AI-powered products and a GenAI practice, and we are a privileged partner of OpenAI and Anthropic. We need a hands-on architect who will own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products, from system design to production scale.

You will be the hands-on leader and technical authority for our internal teams and the person client tech teams hold accountable for the architecture.

**What you will do**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products: system design, service boundaries, data flow, APIs and non-functional requirements
* Design microservice-based systems that scale, deploy on Kubernetes, and run reliably in production
* Architect LLM solutions: RAG pipelines, agents, tool use (including MCP), memory and context management, and prompt management
* Define evaluation approaches for prompts, models and agents, including regression testing
* Build observability and traceability for AI: tracing of prompts, tool calls and agent steps, plus monitoring of latency, quality and cost
* Control AI cost and performance through model selection, token budgets, caching and routing
* Design for security and compliance: data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection defences and Responsible AI
* Write production code, build reference implementations and review critical code
* Set the team's agentic coding practices: AI-assisted workflows, review standards and quality gates
* Be accountable to client tech teams for architecture reviews and answers on scalability and security
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across internal teams

  
**Qualifications**

**Must have**

* 10+ years in software engineering, with recent years as an architect of production systems
* Strong Python and the ability to work across the stack
* End-to-end design of distributed, microservice-based systems at scale
* Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure), including managed LLM platforms such as Bedrock, Azure OpenAI or Vertex AI
* Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes
* LLM application experience (OpenAI and Anthropic APIs): RAG, vector databases and agents
* Experience with observability, traceability LLM evaluation and guardrails for AI systems
* Secure design for AI systems (privacy, PII, compliance)
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) and experience setting team practices around them
* Clear communication with the CTO, client engineers and business stakeholders

**Good to have**

* Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design
* Model and vendor strategy: build vs buy, multi-model routing, avoiding lock-in
* Reliability engineering for AI systems: SLOs, failover, rate limits and fallback when a provider is down
* Architecture governance: decision records, reviews and reference architectures
* Translating business needs into non-functional requirements

  
**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**  
  
**Equal Opportunity**  
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Decisions on hiring, promotion, remuneration and discipline are made solely on performance, competence, conduct and business needs.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Calendar & executive office management: Own end-to-end management of the SVP's calendar — prioritising and scheduling meetings across global time zones, resolving conflicts, protecting time for strategic priorities, and ensuring the SVP is prepared with agendas, briefing notes, and pre-reads for every engagement. ff0376d0.description:
**About Us**

Zycus is a global leader in Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation.

At the core of Zycus’ platform is **Merlin AI**, an advanced AI-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real-time visibility and actionable insights.

Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as **Gartner, Forrester, and IDC** for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long-term business value.

With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement.

  
  

**We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced PreSales Solutions Consultant to join our PreSales team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SaaS solutions, a deep, hands-on understanding of AI and its application in enterprise business processes, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a PreSales Solutions Consultant, you will play a critical role in driving our sales efforts by providing technical and AI expertise, demonstrating our AI-powered solutions, and building strong relationships with potential clients.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and develop tailored solutions that use AI, AI agents and automation to address their needs.

* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations that showcase the value and capabilities of Zycus solutions, with a strong focus on Zycus’s AI capabilities, including Merlin AI agents and GenAI use cases.

* Translate AI capabilities into clear business outcomes, ROI and productivity gains for business and C-level audiences.

* Confidently address client questions on AI accuracy, data privacy, security, governance and responsible AI.

* Provide technical expertise and support during the sales process, including responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical inquiries, AI-specific sections included.

* Work closely with the product management and development teams to stay updated on the latest product features, enhancements and AI roadmap.

* Stay current on developments in AI and GenAI and on competitors’ AI offerings, and build a working understanding of the procurement industry, market trends and the competitive landscape.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, procurement professionals and IT teams.

* Assist in creating sales collateral, including presentations, case studies, whitepapers and AI use-case demos.

* Participate in industry events, conferences and webinars to promote Zycus solutions and generate leads.

**Skills & Experience Required:**

* 2–8 years of experience in a PreSales or Solutions Consulting role, preferably within the SaaS or enterprise software industry.

* Strong working knowledge of AI, including GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows, prompt engineering and RAG, and how they apply to enterprise business processes.

* Hands-on, regular use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini, with the ability to build and demonstrate practical AI use cases.

* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

* Proven track record of successfully supporting sales efforts and closing deals.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

**Good to Have:**

* Understanding of procurement processes and best practices, such as Source-to-Pay, Procure-to-Pay, Supply Chain or Finance.

* Experience with procurement or ERP platforms such as Zycus, SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Jaggaer or Oracle.

* AI certifications or coursework, such as AWS, Azure or Google AI certifications, or GenAI/ML courses.

* Exposure to automation, low-code tools, APIs or ERP integrations.

**Why Zycus?**

* **Recognized market leader:** Zycus was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Source-to-Pay Suites, and a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Source-to-Pay 2025 Vendor Assessment.
* **At the forefront of Agentic AI:** The platform runs on Merlin Agentic AI, with investments in intake technology, agentic AI (including autonomous negotiation for tail spend), and context-aware AI for security and control. You’ll be showing customers what’s next in enterprise AI, not just talking about it.
* **Shaping the future of procurement:** Zycus is moving beyond Source-to-Pay to Intake-to-Outcomes, defining the next generation of procurement.
* **Global exposure:** Work with large enterprise and Fortune 1000 customers across North America, Europe, the Middle East and APAC.
* **Customer-trusted:** Zycus was also recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2025 Gartner® Peer Insights™ “Voice of the Customer” for Source-to-Pay Suites.
* **Room to grow:** A fast-paced, innovation-driven environment where you’ll build deep AI and enterprise solutioning skills, with visible impact on deals and the product roadmap.

52210936.title: Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)
52210936.description:
**Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)**

Sajal Tech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Bhopal (On-site) | Full-time | 1 to 4 years experience

**About Us**

Sajal Tech Solutions is an AI-first software development company based in Bhopal. We build SaaS products, AI/ML solutions, mobile apps and automation for clients in India, the US, the UK and the UAE. We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 certifications, and we are a DPIIT-recognised startup and MSME.

**Role Summary**

You will run our government and enterprise IT bidding from start to finish. That means finding opportunities, understanding the technical scope, writing the proposal and submitting a compliant bid on time. You will work closely with our Head of Business Development and the technical team, and you need to know software well enough to write about it convincingly.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Tenders & Bids*

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

* Understands the SDLC and Agile, and how web, mobile, ERP and SaaS projects are scoped, built and maintained
* Can read and break down technical scope covering portals, ERP, mobile apps, APIs and integrations, cloud hosting, AI/ML and AMC/O&M
* Familiar with cloud basics (AWS, Azure, GCP), MeitY-empanelled cloud, hosting, backup and DR
* Knows common government IT requirements: GIGW and accessibility, CERT-In security audits, STQC, data localisation, SLA/uptime and penalty clauses, ISO 27001
* Can prepare effort and manpower estimates with the tech team and sanity-check a BOQ

**Good to Have**

* Background as a developer, business analyst or pre-sales engineer
* Experience with international RFPs (Middle East, UK, US)
* Can create basic architecture diagrams (draw.io, Lucidchart or similar)
* Uses AI tools to draft and review documents faster

**What We Offer**

* Salary:
  **₹2.5 to ₹6**
  **LPA**
  , plus an incentive on won bids
* Work directly with the founders, the BD head and the engineering team
* Clear path to a Bid Manager / Pre-Sales Lead role
* A fast-growing AI-first company with international clients

1292d25a.title: Partner Solutions Engineer (Mumbai)
1292d25a.description:
**Meet the Team**
The Solutions Engineering team is responsible for designing, implementing, and driving Cisco's Digital Resilience strategy for some of India's leading enterprises and strategic partners. We help organizations strengthen their cybersecurity posture by delivering innovative security architectures that enable secure connectivity, Zero Trust, cloud security, and cyber resilience.
  
  
As a trusted technical advisor, you'll work closely with Cisco Sales, channel partners, and customers to design, position, and implement Cisco's industry-leading Security portfolio while enabling partners to build long-term technical capabilities and deliver secure business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Partner Solutions Engineer – Security, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for strategic partners, driving technical strategy, solution development, and partner enablement across Cisco's Security portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Build and manage trusted technical relationships with strategic partners, serving as their primary security advisor.
* Design and present end-to-end Cisco Security architectures aligned with customer business and cybersecurity objectives.
* Lead technical workshops, customer presentations, demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on Cisco Security solutions.
* Develop Partner Technical Business Plans and drive technical readiness across Cisco's Security portfolio.
* Enable partners through technical training, architectural guidance, and best practices across Cisco Security technologies.
* Collaborate with Cisco Sales, Partner Account Managers, Channel Leaders, and Security Specialists to identify and drive strategic opportunities.
* Stay current on cybersecurity trends, competitive technologies, and emerging threats to influence partner strategy and customer security transformation.
* Support partners throughout the sales lifecycle, from opportunity qualification to post-sales technical guidance.
* Provide product and market feedback to Cisco Business Units to influence future product enhancements and solution positioning.
* Demonstrate business value and ROI by aligning Cisco Security solutions with customers' digital resilience and security transformation initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Security Consulting, Network Security, or Security Architecture.
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CCIE Security, or equivalent security certifications are highly preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise designing, positioning, and implementing Cisco Security solutions, including:
* Cisco Secure Firewall (Firepower/FTD)
* Cisco Secure Access (SASE)
* Cisco Umbrella
* Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* Cisco Duo
* Cisco Secure Endpoint
* Cisco Secure Email
* Cisco XDR
* Cisco Secure Network Analytics (Stealthwatch)
* Secure Service Edge (SSE)
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures, network security, cloud security, identity and access management, and secure access technologies.
* Experience working with Channel Partners, System Integrators, or Value-Added Resellers (VARs) to drive technical enablement and customer engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering executive presentations, customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on cybersecurity solutions.
* Strong understanding of Digital Resilience, Zero Trust, SASE, SSE, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and AI-driven Security architectures.
* Experience integrating Cisco Security solutions with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and security APIs using tools such as Python, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Excellent consultative selling, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and executive decision-makers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Experience in R/Python/Tableau will be an advantage
* Flexibility to travel as needed with Executive presence and assertiveness.
* Self-starter, ability to work independently, handle ambiguous situations and exercise judgement in variety of situations.
* Strong communication, organizational, verbal & written skills.
* High degree of responsibility and ownership, strong multitasking, coordination and tenaciously looking for ways to get results.

c320e015.description:

Pre-Sales (Data, Analytics & AI), you will make an impact by leading and scaling our proposal, pursuit, and partner engagement function for Data, Analytics, and AI across strategic and complex client opportunities. You will be a valued member of the AI & Analytics (AIA) practice team and work collaboratively with sales, solution, delivery, and practice leadership.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Experience in Pre-Sales, Business Development, Bid Management, or Proposal Management, with a proven track record leading large and complex RFP responses.
* Experience managing stakeholders up to senior leadership and client CXO levels, and owning solutioning narratives for Data, Analytics, AI, and Generative AI opportunities.
* Strong analytical, storytelling, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting to leadership.
* Exposure to partner ecosystems (such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and GCP) and funding or co-sell motions, plus the ability to manage and develop a small team of pre-sales professionals.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools, with exposure to CRM or pursuit-tracking platforms, and the ability to thrive and lead in a fast-paced, global environment.

**These will help you stand out**

* Hands-on experience designing or deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions to improve pursuit management, proposal development, research, knowledge management, and sales productivity.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

73c6ad59.title: Solution Engineer
73c6ad59.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  
  

* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
  
  

* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

8c7677ba.title: Technical Program Manager, Fleet and Supply Chain Intelligence
8c7677ba.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

 **Job Description**

Solution Architect – Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory & CyberArk PAM

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and drive the identity and privileged access management (PAM) architecture across a hybrid Microsoft Entra ID and On‑Prem Active Directory environment, with deep expertise in CyberArk PAM solutions.

This role owns the end‑to‑end design, integration, and governance of identity and privileged access controls, ensuring alignment with enterprise IAM strategy, Zero Trust principles, and regulatory requirements. The architect will work closely with IAM engineers, security teams, infrastructure, application owners, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Identity & Access Architecture (Entra ID & Active Directory)

* Define and own the hybrid identity architecture across Microsoft Entra ID and On‑Prem Active Directory
* Design secure authentication and authorization models:
  + Conditional Access
  + MFA and authentication strengths
  + Passwordless authentication (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business)
* Define hybrid identity patterns including Entra Connect and authentication models
* Establish identity standards and guardrails aligned with Zero Trust architecture

Privileged Access Management (CyberArk)

* Define and drive Privileged Access Management (PAM) architecture using CyberArk, aligned with the enterprise IAM strategy
* Lead the design and implementation of privileged access controls across:
  + Servers
  + Endpoints
  + Databases
  + Applications
* Integrate PAM with Access Management capabilities:
  + SSO
  + MFA
  + Microsoft Entra ID
* Integrate CyberArk with the broader enterprise security ecosystem, including:
  + SIEM platforms
  + ITSM tools
* Define and enforce least privilege and Zero Trust principles across infrastructure and endpoints
* Drive secrets management strategy for applications using:
  + CyberArk Conjur
  + CyberArk CCP
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to enable secure credential management and automation
* Provide architectural guidance for CyberArk EPM‑based endpoint privilege control

Solution Design & Integration

* Design secure integrations between:
  + Entra ID
  + Active Directory
  + CyberArk PAM platforms
  + On‑prem, cloud, and SaaS applications
* Define application onboarding patterns:
  + SSO and federation
  + Privileged access flows
  + Secrets consumption models
* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, and auditable

Architecture, Strategy & Governance

* Define the PAM roadmap and maturity model, aligned with IAM and enterprise security strategy
* Establish standards for:
  + Privileged account onboarding
  + Password rotation
  + Session recording and monitoring
* Drive risk reduction initiatives, including:
  + Removal of standing administrative access
  + Credential hardening
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance for privileged access:
  + SOX
  + ISO
  + GDPR
* Participate in threat modeling, security reviews, and risk assessments

Leadership & Collaboration

* Act as the design authority for identity and PAM solutions
* Partner with:
  + IAM and PAM engineering teams
  + Security architecture
  + Cloud and infrastructure teams
  + Application owners
* Review and approve technical designs and implementations
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to senior engineers

Required Skills & Expertise

CyberArk & PAM

* Strong expertise in CyberArk PAS, EPM, CCP, and Conjur
* Deep understanding of privileged access risks, controls, and governance models
* Hands‑on experience designing and integrating PAM solutions at enterprise scale

Microsoft Identity

* Microsoft Entra ID (P2)
* Conditional Access and Identity Protection
* Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
* Entra Connect and hybrid authentication
* Active Directory security and tiered admin models

Operating Systems & Platforms

* Strong knowledge of:
  + Windows privilege models
  + Unix/Linux privilege models
  + Active Directory security concepts

Automation & Integration

* Hands‑on experience with automation and integration using:
  + REST APIs
  + PowerShell
  + Python
* Experience integrating PAM into CI/CD and automated workflows

Security & Architecture

* Zero Trust architecture
* Least privilege enforcement
* Identity‑based and privileged access attack techniques and mitigations

Nice to Have

* Exposure to cloud PAM use cases across:
  + Azure
  + AWS
  + GCP
* Experience with DevOps and cloud‑native environments
* CyberArk certifications:
  + Sentry
  + CDE
* Microsoft security certifications (SC‑300, AZ‑500)
* CISSP or equivalent

 **Qualifications**

Graduation OR Post Graduation

You will lead the charge in defining how AI-orchestrated workflows and seamless integrations between Kantata and customers’ enterprise tech stack (ERP, CRM, HCM) drive unprecedented margins and scale for our global clients.

**What you bring to this Role:**

* You act as the “Integration and AI Translation” layer to our prospects to move beyond AI hype and into practical solutions that generate value
* Your expertise is a force multiplier where technology, business acumen and human-centric design intersect
* You naturally frame conversations around business outcomes and strategy
* You thrive in ambiguity and bring clarity to buying environments
* You demonstrate performance by leading by example
* You excel as a self-starter with experience working in a team based environment

Deal Partnership and Execution

* Develop, plan and deliver high-impact, custom demonstrations and Proof of Concepts of integrated solutions and AI that connect customer objectives to differentiated value in partnership with Solution Engineers
* + Configure and customize integration platforms and APIs for the demo orgs and for customer presentations.
  + Elevate our “Golden Demo” assets with impressive integrated use cases to strengthen demonstrations and provide reusable content for the SE team
* Influence buying teams across technical, operational, and executive stakeholders with our integration and AI strategy
* Translate customer complexity into clear, compelling solution narratives
* Own the technical win strategy for complex RFP/RFI responses, highlighting our integration and AI strategies to uniquely position Kantata as the best vendor to solve customers challenges and provide improved business outcomes
* Shape deal strategy in partnership with Account Executives, including: Business problem framing and Success criteria definition

Solution Design and Technical Expertise

* Collaborate with sales teams, product management, and engineering to understand customer requirements and develop comprehensive solution architectures
* Design and document integration blueprints, data flows, and system interactions
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate integration/AI technologies and platforms
* Ensure solutions align with industry best practices and security standards
* Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and integration best practices.
* Possess a deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise architecture principles.
* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., Refold, Workato, MuleSoft, Apigee, Dell Boomi)
* Deep understanding of the ‘Lead-to-cash’ lifecycle and how the ‘Middle Office’ (PSA) bridges the CRM and ERP ecosystems
* Experience architecting solutions using LLMs, Prompt Engineering or AI Agents to automate professional services workflows (e.g., Claude, Gemini, etc)
* + Awareness of AI governance and data privacy standards (e.g., EU AI Act, GDPR) as they relate to enterprise solution design
* Proficient in modern API design (REST, GraphQL) and familiar with legacy protocols (SOAP) in 3rd party applications
* Demonstrated knowledge of data integration and ETL processes

**Your Experience and Skills:**

* 5+ years of experience as a Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) or other technical role
* Proven track record of creating custom integrated solutions and leading proof of concepts in customer presentations to Enterprise organizations
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce and the Force.com platform
* Powerful executive presence leading value-driven presentations to executives and senior leaders
* Deep understanding of Software as a Service as well as common enterprise IT requirements
* Proven familiarity with the professional services industry; PSA; or ERP is a plus
* Proven ability to articulate the ROI of AI investments to non-technical Executives
* Fluency in German, French and/or Spanish will be a significant advantage for our EMEA expansion

**Location and Work Environment**

* Work Style: Remote

**Philsophy**

We know every company can be successful with the right technology and when people are at the core. We believe that we’re better together - that working hand-in-hand brings the best thoughts to the table and creates an environment of learning and growth. Here, you’ll enjoy:

* An intentionally engaging and collaborative culture - ditch the silo!
* Strong work-life balance that’s a true focus of the company
* The chance to learn from some of the best people in the business
* A vibrant, collaborative and devoted team, who still makes time for fun

At Kantata, we strive to create an inclusive workplace that upholds the dignity of all people. We value, respect and celebrate everyone’s unique strengths from all different walks of life. As we continue to cultivate diversity within the company, our product (and people!) innovation continues to flourish.

**Kantata is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

7757222e.title: Solution Architect, SAP Supply Chain Planning DMC
7757222e.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Job Title: Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
The
**Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving SAP-enabled digital manufacturing solutions. The role covers SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), SAP Manufacturing Execution (ME), and related SAP PP, EWM, QM, MM-IM, and PM capabilities.
  
  
Working closely with Manufacturing, Operations, and Plant IT, the role delivers reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions that provide real-time operational visibility, enable intelligent production planning, and connect shop-floor activities with enterprise processes. The position plays a key role in improving productivity, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead end-to-end SAP digital manufacturing initiatives from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement solutions across SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud, SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM-IM/PM, and SAP ECC/S4HANA/EWM integration points.
* Collaborate with production, quality, maintenance, and logistics teams to map business processes to SAP capabilities (e.g., production planning, order execution, batch management, quality inspection, asset management, stock transfer).
* Design and configure real-time shop-floor dashboards, KPIs, alerts, and analytics to enable data-driven decision making.
* Integrate SAP digital manufacturing solutions with MES, ERP, IoT platforms, and third-party systems (e.g., PLCs, historians, SCADA, and OT data sources).
* Lead data modelling efforts for master data, bill of materials, routings, work centres, and production orders to support manufacturing operations.
* Define and execute testing strategies (functional, integration, regression) and support user acceptance testing.
* Establish governance for change management, version control, security, access controls, and data quality within SAP solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to project teams, business analysts, and end-users.
* Prepare and manage project plans, budgets, risk registers, and status communications to stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and training materials for end users.
* Stay current with SAP product roadmaps, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, ISO) impacting manufacturing operations.

**Who You Are**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* At least 5+ years of experience implementing or sustaining SAP-based manufacturing solutions.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC) and/or SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII); knowledge of SAP ME and SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM-IM/PM is highly desirable.
* Strong integration experience between SAP ECC, S/4 Hana, EWM using SAP Clound connector with SAP DM and MES/OT systems, including API design, middleware, and data mapping.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (discrete, batch, process) and shop-floor realities.
* Experience with real-time analytics, dashboards, and KPI design for manufacturing operations.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance in manufacturing IT environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP certifications relevant to digital manufacturing (e.g., SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/PM, SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud).
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration patterns and SAP Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of OT/IT convergence, IIoT, OPC/UA, MQTT, and data historian architectures.
* Programming or scripting skills (e.g., SQL, ABAP, JavaScript) to support custom developments or data extraction.
* Experience in GMP/AML/ISO-compliant manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading change management, user adoption, training, and enablement activities.
* Certification or formal training in IoT, manufacturing analytics, data science, or a related discipline.

Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Strong stakeholder-management, facilitation, and communication abilities.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across business, IT, engineering, and operations teams in a global environment.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented, and committed to clear, accurate documentation.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple initiatives while maintaining delivery focus.
* Adaptability and willingness to continuously learn as SAP capabilities and manufacturing technologies evolve.

**Work Environment And Other Requirements**

* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required; typical travel is approximately 10–20%, depending on project needs.
* Ability to work periodically on-site at manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and support initiatives across multiple locations and time zones.

Opportunity and Impact the SAP Digital Manufacturing Professional enable smarter, more connected manufacturing with improved throughput, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance. This role is pivotal in transforming operational data into actionable insights and sustaining a competitive advantage through digital manufacturing excellence.
  
  
**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
