b619de8b.title: Engineering Delivery Manager I
b619de8b.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Delivery Manager**
Job Description | Product Engineering Organization
  
  
**Overview**
As a Delivery Manager, you hold program-level execution accountable on a day-to-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents.
  
  
Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent-driven development model with three concurrent layers — governance, execution, and learning — that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence-gated dashes, not sprints.
  
  
The activities that used to define this role — status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation — are increasingly AI-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence-gated delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Program-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted.
* Day-to-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs.
* Drive cost-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization.
* Operational integrity of the evidence-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Outcome-Driven Leadership: Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted — not at a sprint boundary.
* Delivery Leadership and Advocacy: Champion fit-for-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority.
* Craft Mastery: Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth — coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions.
* Communication: Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co-creation workshops.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross-skilling.
* Discovery & Delivery Proficiency: Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence-gate discipline — proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement.
* Customer-Centric Delivery: Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively.
* Operational Excellence: Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity.
* Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions.
* Domain Expertise: Rapidly acquire domain-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment.

**The Team**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results. We develop and deploy cutting-edge go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent-driven, evidence-gated delivery patterns.
* Experience working in a product-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve.
* Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data-driven delivery governance.

**Required Skills**

* Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other.
* Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening.
* Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates.
* AI-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually.
* Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them.
* Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish.

**How You Will Grow**
At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning.
  
  
**#pxe**
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

bb69eed9.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWSI HCLS
bb69eed9.description:
**Description**
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.
  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
  
  
Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
  
  
Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
  
  
Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
  
  
Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.
  
  
**About The Team**
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.
  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

5aec8edb.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.  
Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.  
Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.  
Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.  
Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.  
  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.  
  
About the team  
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.  
  
About AWS:  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. You'll tackle never-been-done-before problems involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly enable AWS's ability to scale and meet customer demand.
  
  
In this role, you'll leverage your program management expertise and technical depth to orchestrate complex supply chain initiatives across the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos). You'll work with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain. This is an opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while solving ambiguous problems that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team supply chain automation programs, defining scope, validating requirements, and driving execution with measurable success criteria
* Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate supply chain challenges into technical solutions, creating high-level designs and architectural approaches for the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos)

You start your day reviewing deployment metrics for a critical supply chain automation initiative, identifying a potential bottleneck in inventory forecasting. The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.
  
  
Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where perspectives from varied backgrounds drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while working on programs of critical importance to Amazon's success.

Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software/platform portfolio while collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Solid grounding in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and data platform technologies (data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, governance frameworks).

Familiarity with AI-assisted meeting intelligence (e.g., auto-transcription/summarization of Teams/Zoom calls) and using it to close the loop on decisions and action items faster.
  
  
Working understanding of how AI/ML and agentic systems get built and deployed (MLOps basics, model lifecycle, data quality dependencies) — enough to program-manage platform work that directly enables AI use cases.
  
  
Curiosity and judgment to identify where AI genuinely helps a program (signal, not noise) versus where it's a distraction.
  
  
Ability to build positive relationships with product managers, translating target personas and business needs into features/user stories engineers can act on.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex, ambiguous problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project tracking tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communicator — equally adept communicating upward, outward, and downward.
  
  
Deep hands-on familiarity with JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable, or equivalent program tooling.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**

2d56752b.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Senior Technical Program Manager

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering teams, platforms, and stakeholder organizations.
  
  
You will drive delivery from concept to production while managing dependencies, risks, schedules, operational readiness, and executive communications.
  
  
This role requires strong technical depth, exceptional program leadership, and the ability to influence across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and executive leadership teams.
  
  
**All About You**

5-9 years of overall career experience leading large-scale technical programs and has played a TPM role.
  
  
Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
  
  
Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and event-driven platforms.

Strong program planning, dependency management, and risk management skills.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across organizations.
  
  
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Knowledge of observability platforms, operational controls, and resiliency patterns.
  
  
Experience within financial services, payments, or highly regulated industries.
  
  
PMP, SAFe, Scrum, or equivalent certification is a plus.
  
  
Role
  
  
Drive end-to-end execution of large, complex technology programs.
  
  
Establish clear program plans, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
  
  
Lead planning, execution, release readiness, and production deployment activities.
  
  
Manage cross-functional delivery involving Engineering, Product, Architecture,
  
  
Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams.
  
  
Ensure predictable delivery outcomes through proactive risk management and
  
  
execution discipline.
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of platform architecture, technical dependencies, and operational requirements.
  
  
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies.
  
  
Drive technical readiness reviews, architecture reviews, migration programs, and operational preparedness activities.
  
  
Coordinate large-scale platform initiatives including cloud migration, resilience improvements, infrastructure modernization, and product launches.
  
  
Serve as the single point of accountability for program status, risks, decisions, and escalations.
  
  
Build alignment across senior engineering leaders, architects, TPMs, product managers, and business stakeholders.

2c5fa5b8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
2c5fa5b8.description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead complex, cross-team engineering programs built on Java. You will be an enabler for the engineering teams who own delivery — bringing structure, visibility and alignment from scoping through launch — while engaging deeply with engineers on architecture, dependencies and technical trade-offs.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of engineering and execution. You will be the person who turns ambiguous goals into a clear plan, keeps multiple teams moving in step, and gives leadership an honest, early view of risk.
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program enablement**

* Enable large, multi-quarter programs spanning several engineering teams, partnering with the engineering managers who own delivery from charter through launch and post-launch review.
* Build integrated program plans with milestones, critical path, dependencies and resourcing; keep them current as reality changes.
* Facilitate the program operating rhythm: planning, standups or syncs, status reporting, release readiness and retrospectives.
* Coach teams on Agile (Scrum/Kanban) practices and help adapt the delivery model to fit team size, risk and deadlines.

**Technical partnership**

* Engage with engineers on system design, Java/JVM service architecture, APIs and integration points well enough to challenge estimates and spot hidden dependencies.
* Partner with architects and tech leads on technical debt, scalability, performance and migration plans, and make the trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* Review design documents and help translate technical constraints into scope, timeline and risk decisions.
* Work with DevOps and QA on CI/CD, release management, environments and quality gates.

**Risk, governance and communication**

* Identify risks and blockers early, maintain a RAID log, and help owners drive mitigation, escalating when needed.
* Communicate program status, decisions and trade-offs clearly to engineering leaders, product, and senior executives.
* Define and track delivery metrics such as predictability, velocity, defect trends and milestone health.
* Facilitate scope-change decisions, track budgets, and keep cross-functional partners (Product, Security, Compliance, Operations) aligned.

**Process and people**

* Improve engineering and program management practices across the organization.
* Mentor junior TPMs
* Coordinate with vendors where programs depend on them.

**Experience**
**Required qualifications**

* 10+ years in software delivery, with at least 5 years as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager or equivalent.
* A track record of enabling large programs involving 3+ engineering teams and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical depth (Java)**

* Strong working knowledge of Java-based systems — core Java concepts, Spring / Spring Boot and the JVM — enough to engage credibly with engineers; hands-on coding is not required.
* Solid understanding of microservices, REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Able to review design documents, follow technical debates, and ask the questions that surface real risk.

**Project and program management**

* Deep command of the full project lifecycle: initiation, planning, estimation, scheduling, execution, monitoring and closure.
* Strong practice in Agile and hybrid delivery, including sprint planning, release planning and dependency management at scale.
* Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, diagramming tool such as Lucid Chart
* Proven skill in risk management, scope control, budget tracking and stakeholder management.

**Leadership and communication**

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level status reporting.
* Able to influence without authority and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring structure to it quickly.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a results-oriented mindset and a commitment to delivering value to customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe or Certified Scrum Master certification.
* Experience leading platform migrations, monolith-to-microservices transitions or cloud modernization programs.
* Domain experience in fintech, e-commerce, SaaS or another regulated, high-scale environment.
* Exposure to observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana)
* Experience managing distributed teams across time zones.
* A Master's degree or MBA.

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**

* You have enabled 1–2 critical programs to hit key milestones on or near plan.
* Leadership has a single, trusted view of program health, risks and dependencies.
* Engineering teams see you as a technical peer who removes blockers rather than adds process.

246b063c.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect, APAC
246b063c.description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems.
  
  
Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.
  
  
Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com or follow on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
**About The Role**
Skyflow's Solutions Engineering team is hiring a Solutions Architect based in India. This is a remote role open to candidates anywhere in India. You will lead technical engagements across India and the wider APAC region, and support EMEA customers as needed.
  
  
This is a global role: you will be the trusted technical advisor for enterprise customers wherever they are, helping them architect privacy-first solutions that integrate Skyflow's Data Privacy Vault into their platforms.
  
  
You will be hands-on across the full customer journey, from technical evaluations, tailored demos, and proofs-of-concept in pre-sales to architecture guidance and adoption support post-sales. Your focus is on driving results and making sure Skyflow's solutions meet and exceed customer expectations for privacy, security, and compliance.
  
  
**About You**
You are a self-driven Architect or Engineer with a passion for building privacy-first solutions. You thrive in fast-paced, customer-centric environments and enjoy working with enterprise technical and product teams in both pre-sales and post-sales settings.
  
  
You are comfortable working across regions and time zones, and you adapt easily to different customers, cultures, and business contexts. You keep learning, stay current with evolving technology, and enjoy mentoring others and building a collaborative team culture.
  
  
**You Will**
**Technical mastery and learning**

* Develop deep expertise in Skyflow's Data Privacy Vault and how it integrates into enterprise data architectures.
* Stay current with architectural trends, cloud technologies, and API best practices.
* Master data privacy and privacy-by-design principles, and become a go-to expert across industries and regions.

**Solutioning and Customer Engagement**

* Architect tailored solutions that show how the Skyflow Data Privacy Vault fits into customer environments and drives measurable business value.
* Lead technical evaluations, build customized demos, and deliver best-in-class POCs.
* Understand customer business challenges and proactively propose solutions that strengthen their privacy, security, and compliance posture.
* Advise customers on regional data residency and privacy requirements across APAC, India, and the US.

**Global coverage**

* Serve as the primary Solutions Architect for customers across India and the wider APAC region.
* Support US customer engagements when needed, providing global coverage for evaluations, POCs, and solution design.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success teams across regions to deliver a consistent customer experience.

**Leadership and internal collaboration**

* Work with Skyflow's product and engineering teams to turn customer needs into product features and improvements.
* Represent Skyflow externally at customer meetings, events, and industry forums.
* Mentor and guide junior team members, and share knowledge across regional teams.You Have

**You Have**

* Enterprise experience in pre-sales or technical customer-facing roles, with a focus on enterprise-level engagements.
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions with Product Managers, Developers, Engineers, and C-level stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
* Strong experience building and managing relationships in fast-paced technical organizations, in both pre-sales and post-sales environments.
* Expertise in cloud technologies (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and API-centric development (REST, GraphQL, microservices).
* In-depth knowledge of data architectures, including relational databases, NoSQL data stores, ETL, and integration workflows.
* Strong application security background, including Authentication (AuthN), Authorization (AuthZ), key management, and access control models (PBAC, ABAC, RBAC).
* Demonstrated ability to design privacy-first architectures using regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and privacy by design.
* Experience leading POCs and custom demos in high-stakes, fast-moving environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfort working across multiple time zones, including occasional late-evening IST calls to support US customers and teams.
* A strong listener and learner who stays current with industry trends and technologies.

**Benefits**

* Home office expense
* Health, vision, and dental coverage
* Unlimited PTO

0677024d.title: HyperCare Consultant - Hybrid Cloud & Systems Infrastructure Engineer
0677024d.description:
**About CrucialLogics Inc.**

**We secure your business using native Microsoft technologies you already own.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We apply our **Consulting with a Conscience****TM** approach in our security philosophy.

* Security should be simple, easy to manage and scalable
* Security does not require a large investment in various point solutions
* Security is easily achieved by properly configuring technologies you already are paying for
* Reduce your attack footprint by reducing overall infrastructure

You will never stop bad actors from targeting you. The goal in security is to put defences in place to detect the attempt before the breach.

**About the Role**

CrucialLogics is seeking a HyperCare Consultant for our remote team working out of India.

We are currently in the process of expanding our managed services offerings. The user base is split between Windows and Mac operating systems, and you will need familiarity with both.

We actively encourage our employees to pursue new and applicable industry certifications and provide assistance and guidance to do so.

CrucialLogics is an inclusive work environment, and we place a strong focus on our largest asset, our employees. As a part of our team, you will have a strong group of experienced IT professionals behind you to assist and guide you whenever needed.

As you progress in your role, you will be given the opportunity to get involved with various exciting deployment and migration projects related to the Microsoft stack and suite of services, expanding both your knowledge and experience level.

**Role Title:** HyperCare Consultant

Role Overview

We are seeking a versatile and proactive **Hybrid Cloud & Systems Infrastructure Engineer** to manage, govern, and secure our multi-platform enterprise infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on bridging on-premises and cloud environments using **Azure Arc**, driving cross-platform server patching (Windows and Linux) via **ManageEngine** and manual workflows, maintaining enterprise observability using **Azure Monitor** and third-party tools, and ensuring strict compliance through automated metrics and reporting matrices.

**Key Responsibilities by Tier**
--------------------------------

### **L1 – Operations & Support (Junior / Systems Analyst)**

* **Routine Patch Execution:** Execute scheduled patch deployments for Windows Server and Linux distributions using automated maintenance windows in **ManageEngine**.
* **Manual Patching & Remediation:** Perform manual patching and reboot cycles for isolated, legacy, or sensitive production servers that cannot be updated via automated schedulers.
* **Agent Health Maintenance:** Monitor and troubleshoot basic agent connectivity issues for Azure Arc Connected Machine agents, ManageEngine agents, and Azure Monitor agents.
* **Alert Triage:** Respond to Tier-1 infrastructure alerts from Azure Monitor and third-party observability tools; escalate complex performance bottlenecks or deployment failures to L2/L3.
* **Basic Compliance Checking:** Assist in generating weekly patching status reports and flagging servers that have missed regular update cycles.

### **L2 – Systems Administration & Automation (Intermediate Engineer)**

* **ManageEngine Administration:** Configure, maintain, and optimize **ManageEngine** (Patch Manager Plus / Endpoint Central), defining automated deployment policies, approval workflows, and testing groups.
* **Azure Arc Onboarding & Management:** Execute scale onboarding of on-premises and multi-cloud servers to **Azure Arc** using automated deployment scripts (PowerShell, Bash, Group Policy, or Ansible).
* **Cross-Platform Troubleshooting:** Conduct deep root-cause analysis for failed patch installations, dependency conflicts, and OS-level errors across Windows Server (Registry, Services, WMI) and Linux (YUM/DNF, APT, systemd).
* **Observability Integration:** Configure data collection rules (DCRs), custom alerting thresholds, and VM Insights within **Azure Monitor** and third-party tools (e.g., Datadog, Dynatrace, Zabbix).
* **Dashboard & Matrix Creation:** Design and maintain interactive patching matrices and compliance dashboards (using Azure Workbooks or PowerBI) to track patch coverage, failure rates, and pending reboots.

### **L3 – Architecture, Governance & Strategy (Senior / Lead Architect)**

* **Hybrid Cloud Governance:** Design the overarching enterprise governance framework using **Azure Arc**, including Azure Policy assignment, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and tagging strategies for hybrid resources.
* **Patching & SLA Strategy:** Define enterprise-wide vulnerability management SLAs, zero-day emergency patching workflows, and risk-mitigation strategies for mission-critical infrastructure.
* **Advanced Automation & Scripting:** Author read-only audit automation and self-healing scripts (PowerShell, Bash, Python) to proactively identify unmonitored assets, "zombie" resources, and compliance drift without disrupting production.
* **Telemetry Architectures:** Architect centralized logging and telemetry pipelines using **Log Analytics Workspaces (KQL)**, ensuring cost-optimized data ingestion and high-fidelity alerting across hybrid infrastructure.
* **Audit & Compliance Leadership:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact during security and compliance audits; present executive-level SLAs and patching metrics matrices to leadership and stakeholders.

**Technical Requirements & Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------

### **1. Hybrid Cloud & Governance (Azure Arc)**

* Deep understanding of **Azure Arc-enabled servers**, including agent deployment, networking prerequisites, and extension management.
* Experience enforcing compliance across on-premises and cloud servers using **Azure Policy** and Guest Configuration.

### **2. Cross-Platform Patch Management**

* Hands-on expertise with **ManageEngine** (Patch Manager Plus, Endpoint Central, or equivalent enterprise patch management suites).
* Thorough knowledge of native OS updating mechanisms:
* + **Windows:** Windows Update for Business, WSUS, servicing stacks, and troubleshooting CBS/Windows Update logs.
  + **Linux:** Repository management, kernel updates, dependency resolution via apt, yum, or dnf across RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS, or SUSE.
* Proven ability to safely execute manual patching on critical database or application servers requiring exact sequencing and pre/post-maintenance checks.

### **3. Monitoring & Observability**

* Proficiency in **Azure Monitor**, Log Analytics, Azure Alerting, and writing **KQL (Kusto Query Language)** queries for custom telemetry and log analysis.
* Experience integrating and managing third-party monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, SolarWinds, ManageEngine OpManager, Prometheus/Grafana, or Zabbix).

### **4. Patching Metrics & Reporting Matrix**

* Experience designing structured **Patching Matrices** that categorize servers by OS, environment (Dev/Test/Prod), patch severity (Critical, Security, Rollup), and current patch status.
* Ability to translate raw update logs into executive-ready SLA compliance dashboards detailing MTTR (Mean Time to Remediate) for vulnerabilities.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* **Microsoft:** AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-800/801 (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect).
* **Linux:** CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator), or LFCS.
* **General IT & Security:** ITIL v4 Foundation, CompTIA Security+.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**
----------------------------------------

* **99%+ Patch Compliance:** Achieving and sustaining enterprise patching SLAs across all Windows and Linux environments without unplanned downtime.
* **Unified Governance:** 100% of hybrid and on-premises server estates successfully onboarded, tagged, and governed under Azure Arc.
* **Zero Blind Spots:** Complete visibility into server health, performance metrics, and missing updates through real-time, automated reporting dashboards.

c224a892.title: Senior Architect
c224a892.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
Provide architecture leadership across multiple products, applications, and shared platforms. Own strategic solution architecture, align teams with enterprise roadmaps and standards, and drive modernization, security, resiliency, reuse, and engineering excellence.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end architecture for strategic initiatives spanning multiple products, applications, services, and platforms
* Translate business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient solutions
* Define current-state assessments, target-state architectures, modernization roadmaps, and strategies to address technical debt and lifecycle risk
* Partner with Product, Business, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, Engineering, Platform, Operations, and Support stakeholders to drive decisions and adoption
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, HLDs, LLDs, decision records, technical specifications, standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks, and technology guardrails
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, platforms, and patterns based on business value, strategic fit, security, scalability, operability, maintainability, and total cost
* Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, governance forums, and technical oversight throughout the SDLC, including design, deployment, and infrastructure reviews
* Define and validate estimates, assumptions, risks, dependencies, sequencing, and implementation approaches for major initiatives
* Drive cloud-native, microservices, container, Kubernetes, serverless, API, event-driven, streaming, integration, and data architecture strategies where appropriate
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to establish CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, automated controls, observability, release automation, and operational excellence
* Ensure secure-by-design, privacy, regulatory, production readiness, resilience, disaster recovery, capacity, and business continuity requirements are addressed
* Identify performance, scalability, reliability, and cost improvement opportunities; support root-cause analysis and platform stability improvements
* Lead POCs and responsible evaluation of emerging technologies, including AI/GenAI and agentic engineering capabilities
* Mentor architects, technical leads, and engineers while promoting consistent standards, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence across teams
* Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools across architecture, development, testing, documentation, and operations using AIDLC practices
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Copilot/Codex/Claude, prompt engineering, AI-enabled SDLC workflows, and validation and governance of AI-generated outputs
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 15+ years of overall IT and software engineering experience, including 8+ years in solution, application, technical architecture, or enterprise-scale platform engineering roles
* 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and modern web development; working knowledge of React, Redux, Node.js, JavaScript, and HTML
* 5+ years architecting cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, Infrastructure-as-Code, and multi-tenant patterns
* Experience with modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, lifecycle management, disaster recovery, and business continuity
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including MongoDB, data modelling, performance optimisation, and scalability patterns
* Experience with event streaming technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or equivalent
* Expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, high-performance distributed systems and defining architecture standards, roadmaps, patterns, and reference architectures
* Solid knowledge of application and cloud security, identity and access management, OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and compliance controls
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, design patterns, Domain-Driven Design, microservices, performance engineering, capacity planning, and observability
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture governance, technical workshops, and cross-team decisions while balancing business outcomes, security, cost, delivery, and sustainability
* Proven excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Proven architecture leadership across multiple products, applications, teams, or enterprise platforms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect - Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect
* Healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, payer, or other regulated-industry experience
* Experience with GraphQL, web components, test automation, API management, service mesh, zero-trust architecture, or cloud cost optimisation
* Experience responsibly applying AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

7cb961bb.title: Data Platform Architect
7cb961bb.description:
**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
Delivery and solution leadership role.
  
  
This role balances hands on architectural guidance with execution ownership, client leadership, and people development.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  
Proven experience as a Data Architect and Data Engineer leading enterprise-scale Lakehouse initiatives.
  
  
Expert-level understanding of modern Data & Analytics Architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Products, and Lakehouse Architecture.
  
  
Excellent programming and debugging skills in Python.
  
  
Strong experience with PySpark for building scalable and modular ETL/ELT pipelines.
  
  
Design and build complex pipelines using Delta Lake, Auto Loader, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and deployment using Asset Bundles.
  
  
Architect data ingestion and transformation using DLT Expectations, modular Databricks Functions, and reusable pipeline components.
  
  
Must have hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  
  
Lead implementation of Unity Catalog: create catalogs, schemas, role-based access policies, lineage visibility, and data classification tagging (PII, PHI, etc.).
  
  
Guide organization-wide governance via Unity Catalog setup: workspace linkage, SSO, audit logging, external locations, and Volume access.
  
  
Enable cross-platform data access using Lakehouse Federation, querying live from externally hosted databases.
  
  
Leverage and integrate Databricks Marketplace to consume high-quality third-party data and publish internal data assets securely.
  
  
Experience with cloud-based services relevant to data engineering, data storage, data processing, data warehousing, real-time streaming, and serverless computing.
  
  
Govern and manage Delta Sharing for securely sharing datasets with external partners or across tenants.
  
  
Design and maintain PII anonymization, tokenization, and masking strategies using DBX functions and Unity Catalog policies to meet GDPR/HIPAA compliance.
  
  
Architect Power BI, Tableau, and Looker integration with Databricks for live reporting and visualization over governed datasets.
  
  
Build Databricks SQL Dashboards to enable stakeholders with real-time insights, KPI tracking, and alerts.
  
  
Hands on Experience in applying Performance optimization techniques
  
  
Lead cross-functional initiatives across data science, analytics, and platform teams to deliver secure, scalable, and value-aligned data products.
  
  
Provide thought leadership on adopting advanced features like Mosaic AI, Vector Search, Model Serving, and Databricks Marketplace publishing.
  
  
Working knowledge of DBT (Data Build Tool) is a plus.
  
  
Strong background in data modeling and data warehousing concepts is required.
  
  
Good to Have:
  
  

* Certifications: Databricks Certified Professional or similar certifications.
* Machine Learning: Knowledge of machine learning concepts and experience with popular ML libraries.
* Knowledge of big data processing (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Kafka)
* Data Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in a cloud environment.
* Experience with ETL tools like Informatica, Talend, Matillion, or Fivetran.
* Familiarity with DBT (Data Build Tool)

Education Qualification:
  
  

* 15 years full-time education is required.

b9d2edd1.description:
**About The Opportunity**
Netrix Global is looking for a skilled
****ServiceNow Delivery Manager****
to lead and manage our ServiceNow support and development practice within Managed Services. This role is responsible for leading a team of four to five ServiceNow developers while overseeing platform support, enhancements, integrations, customer onboarding, escalations, governance, and project delivery.
  
  
A key objective of this position is to provide strong ServiceNow integration leadership across the organization. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations between ServiceNow and external platforms using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Scripted REST APIs, Integration Hub, ServiceNow Spokes, MID Server, middleware solutions, and third-party applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in ServiceNow ITSM and Customer Service Management (CSM), with experience integrating ServiceNow with platforms such as Utelogy, Freshdesk, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Teams, other ServiceNow instances, and various business applications. The successful candidate will work directly with customers and stakeholders to support onboarding, enhancements, support services, and project delivery while ensuring projects are completed on time and within budget.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of four to five ServiceNow developers, including hiring, coaching, performance reviews, and capacity planning.
* Gather and clarify requirements from stakeholders and translate them into technical tasks and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Build and deliver ServiceNow solutions while managing the development backlog, sprints, and releases.
* Own the integration roadmap and architecture for the Netrix ServiceNow instance and its connections to other systems and tools.
* Design, develop, and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Scripted REST APIs, Integration Hub, Spokes, Flow Designer, MID Server, and third-party integration tools.
* Support integrations with Utelogy, Freshdesk, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Teams, other ServiceNow instances, and customer-specific applications.
* Oversee ServiceNow platform support, administration, enhancement requests, and development activities across ITSM and CSM.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for ServiceNow ITSM and Customer Service Management (CSM).
* Establish and enforce development standards, code reviews, release management, automated testing practices, and governance controls.
* Support customer onboarding and act as an escalation point for customers, project teams, and support teams.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet customer expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement, governance, automation, operational excellence, and adoption of ServiceNow AI capabilities.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* 10+ years of ServiceNow experience with progressive technical and leadership responsibilities.
* 2+ years leading technical teams, developers, or support organizations.
* Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM and Customer Service Management (CSM).
* Proven experience designing, building, and supporting API-based integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems.
* Strong hands-on development skills including JavaScript, Glide Scripting, Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, write technical tasks and user stories, and deliver them through an Agile process.
* Experience managing platform enhancements, support operations, customer onboarding, and ServiceNow project delivery.
* Proven leadership experience managing, mentoring, and developing technical teams.
* Strong customer-facing consulting and relationship management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong active listening and requirements elicitation skills with the ability to understand business objectives and customer requirements.
* Ability to manage customer escalations and difficult conversations while maintaining positive relationships.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build consensus across customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to remain calm and effective in high-pressure situations.
* Strategic thinker with a continuous improvement mindset and customer-first focus.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Strongly Preferred.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) - Strongly Preferred.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM).
* Integration Hub and ServiceNow Integration Certifications are a plus.
* Now Assist or ServiceNow AI Certifications/Training are a plus.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certifications are preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* ServiceNow ITSM
* ServiceNow CSM
* Integration Hub
* REST and SOAP APIs
* Scripted REST APIs
* MID Server
* Authentication Patterns (OAuth, API Keys, Basic Auth)
* Import Sets and Transform Maps
* Flow Designer
* Integration Spokes
* JavaScript and Glide Scripting
* Business Rules, ACLs, Script Includes
* Automated Test Framework (ATF)
* Update Set and Release Management
* Microsoft Intune Integrations
* Microsoft Teams Integrations
* Ticketing Tool Integrations (JIRA, Freshdesk)
* Monitoring Tool Integrations (LogicMonitor, N-able, Sentinel, Utelogy, Meraki)
* ServiceNow-to-ServiceNow Integrations (Service Bridge)
* Third-Party Application Integrations
* Now Assist and ServiceNow AI (Preferred)

**About US**
At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.
  
  
We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!
  
  
Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.
  
  
We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators.
  
  
At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Us**
We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

ca39a48f.title: Principal Program Manager
ca39a48f.description:
**Description**
Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world’s most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
  
  
**Overview**
Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Competencies**
Job Duties
  
  

* Own end-to-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems

Competencies
  
  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team

**Qualifications (Requirements)**

* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required

*Belief in Diversity
  
  
Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**SurveyMonkey is the world’s most popular platform for surveys and forms, built for business—loved by users.**
We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.
  
  
Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
SurveyMonkey is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager II to drive complex, large-scale technical initiatives across the organization. In this role, you’ll work across Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Support, connecting teams and stakeholders to deliver critical programs from planning through launch. You’ll bring both the strategic perspective to communicate program health and progress to senior leadership and the hands-on experience to identify dependencies, resolve blockers, and keep engineering teams moving forward. You’ll also help improve the processes and delivery practices that enable teams to ship high-quality software predictably and at scale.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**

* Lead End-to-End Program Delivery: Drive complex, cross-functional technical programs from inception through launch, ensuring alignment, accountability, and execution across global R&D teams.
* Provide Data-Driven Insights: Build and maintain dashboards and reports using JQL, Google Sheets, and Tableau to provide visibility into program health, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and quality.
* Drive Technical Problem-Solving: Partner with Engineering Leads to identify technical dependencies, resource constraints, and delivery risks. Facilitate trade-off discussions and help teams determine paths forward.
* Manage Program Workstreams: Use Jira and Confluence to coordinate complex workstreams, maintain clear documentation, and establish reliable sources of truth for program status and decisions.
* Improve Delivery Practices: Evaluate and refine agile ceremonies, program management practices, and delivery frameworks to improve execution, predictability, and team effectiveness.

**We’d love to hear from people with**

* Experience: 8–12 years of technical program management experience, ideally within SaaS or software development environments, with a track record of delivering major product launches, platform initiatives, or migrations.
* Strategic Execution: Experience translating ambiguous business or product goals into actionable technical roadmaps, milestones, and execution plans.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Experience building alignment across senior leaders, Product, and Engineering teams, facilitating decisions, and driving progress without direct authority.
* Agile and Development Practices: Strong understanding of product and software development lifecycles (PDLC/SDLC) and agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, with the ability to adapt practices to the needs of each team.
* Program Analytics and Tooling: Advanced proficiency with Jira and the Atlassian suite, including using JQL and reporting tools to track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and proactively surface program risks.

SurveyMonkey believes in-person collaboration is valuable for building relationships, fostering community, and enhancing our speed and execution in problem-solving and decision-making.

*- Hybrid*

At SurveyMonkey, curiosity powers everything we do. We’re a global company where people from all backgrounds can make an impact, build meaningful connections, and grow their careers. We live our company values—like championing inclusion and making it happen—by embedding them into how we hire, collaborate, and grow. They help shape everything from our culture to our business decisions. Come join us and see where your curiosity can take you.
