ec3fe256.title: GenAI Solution Architect
ec3fe256.description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a talented GenAI Solution Architect with strong experience in RAG and MCP connectors. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing scalable web applications, integrating backend services, and ensuring seamless user experiences.

  

* **Role: GenAI Solution Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Owns end-to-end technical direction and client alignment for the agentic AI platform.
* Primary technical interface with the client, translating business requirements into architecture spanning RAG pipelines, MCP connectors, and hybrid orchestration across Appian, ERP, DealCloud, Backstop CRM, Snowflake, and Graph DB.
* Application development using Claude Code(environment)
* Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embedding, Pinecone indexing, retrieval
* Implement retrieval strategies including semantic search
* Build MCP connectors exposing system APIs as agent-callable tools (read and write)
* Contribute to agent orchestration: intent routing (RAG vs MCP vs workflow)
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Lead architecture across all AI layers: RAG, MCP connectors (action/data), agent orchestration
* Define integration strategy leveraging existing client APIs, minimising custom build
* Drive MCP connector design for Appian, ERP, DealCloud, Backstop, Snowflake, Graph DB
* Own RAG pipeline decisions: chunking strategy, embedding model, Pinecone retrieval, re-ranking
* Collaborate with client stakeholders (business + IT) to validate use cases guide the offshore team (AI/ML engineers, data engineers)
* 8 to 12 years software/data engineering
* 2+ years LLM/GenAI applications
* Strong Programming skills (Python); LlamaIndex and/or LangChain in production RAG systems
* Vector databases, Pinecone preferred
* MCP / tool-calling patterns; FASTMCP experience a significant plus
* Chunking strategies, overlap settings, metadata tagging
* Vibe coding and prompt engineering experience
* Knowledge of Git-CLI/Github
* Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes (AKS)containerization
* ReactJS experience is good to have
* Python FastAPI experience is also good to have.
* Python scripting for data processing, file parsing (PDFs, Office docs) good to have.
* ETL/ELT patterns and transformation tools good to have
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups

**Overview**

Do you want to help some of Microsoft’s largest global customers strengthen their cyber defenses and modernize security for the cloud and AI era? The International Customer Success Unit (iCSU) connects global customer strategy with execution in downstream locations outside customer headquarters. You will work across geographic and organizational boundaries to help customers realize measurable value from their Microsoft security investments.

As a Customer Solution Architect for Azure Security, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and accountable technical owner for priority security outcomes. You will lead architecture and adoption engagements across Azure security, cloud security posture management, security operations, threat protection, identity integration, and secure AI scenarios. You will combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership to remove blockers, guide solutions into production, and connect delivery progress to customer value, consumption, and long-term success.

This opportunity will allow you to deepen your Azure Security expertise, lead complex global engagements, strengthen your business and consulting acumen, and scale your impact through repeatable delivery, partners, and cross-Microsoft orchestration. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 40% from home, aligned to customer and business needs.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build trusted relationships with customer security leaders, enterprise architects, and technical decision makers; understand their security priorities, regulatory context, and technical landscape; and translate these into secure, pragmatic Azure roadmaps.

* Lead architecture design sessions, technical workshops, proof-of-concepts, and implementation guidance for Azure Security solutions, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, cloud workload protection, security posture management, network security, governance, and related identity and threat-protection integrations.

* Own end-to-end technical delivery outcomes for assigned engagements by defining success criteria, maintaining an integrated delivery plan, driving committed milestones to close, proactively escalating blockers, and ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and operationally ready.

* Help customers modernize security operations and secure their cloud and AI estate by applying Zero Trust, secure-by-design, Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected security guidance, and Microsoft reference architectures.

* Drive adoption, usage, and business impact by identifying next-best actions and follow-on opportunities from each engagement, supporting consumption and pipeline outcomes, aligning technical progress to customer business value.

* Orchestrate across CSAMs, account teams, Security Specialists, engineering, FastTrack, Global Delivery, Factory, services, partners, and cross-solution CSAs to deliver a connected One Microsoft customer experience.

* Act as the Voice of the Customer by capturing product feedback and technical blockers, contributing reusable assets and best practices, maintaining role-aligned readiness and certifications, and sharing expertise through customer and technical communities.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting; OR Master's Degree in a related field AND 3+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, product development, or related experience; OR equivalent experience.

* Experience leading customer-facing security architecture, technical consulting, or delivery engagements for enterprise cloud environments.

**Lead Network Solution Architect ( Jr. and Sr)**

**Location: Mumbai and Kolkata**

**Position :4 Nos.**

**Role Summary**

The Network Solution Architect will lead the assessment, design, and recommendation of a neutral, resilient, scalable, and regulatory-compliant network architecture for a large-scale financial services environment. The role is responsible for defining participant connectivity models, Point of Presence (POP) architecture, network path diversity, gateway placement, traffic segregation, and high-availability frameworks to ensure fair, secure, and consistent access across all participants.

The consultant will collaborate with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, data center providers and telecommunications partners to evaluate the existing network ecosystem, identify gaps and develop architecture options that support operational resilience, neutrality, security and future scalability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess the existing network architecture, connectivity framework, routing design, and participant access models to identify operational, scalability, and resilience gaps.
* Define the target-state neutral network architecture that ensures fairness, high availability, security, and future scalability.
* Evaluate and recommend optimal POP locations, connectivity models and redundancy strategies to improve accessibility and operational resilience.
* Analyze network paths, routing mechanisms, and carrier dependencies to eliminate single points of failure and improve path diversity.
* Design resilient gateway architectures, traffic management frameworks and access mechanisms to support secure and efficient connectivity.
* Establish service separation and network segmentation principles to ensure traffic isolation, security compliance, and consistent performance.
* Define high-availability, failover, and disaster recovery connectivity strategies to maintain uninterrupted service during outages and maintenance events.
* Review network security architecture, access controls, monitoring capabilities, and compliance requirements to identify risks and recommend improvements.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and technical discussions with internal teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Develop architecture blueprints, High-Level Design (HLD) documents, connectivity diagrams, assessment reports and executive recommendations.
* Present findings, architecture options, risk assessments and strategic recommendations to leadership and governance teams.
* Provide overall technical leadership for the workstream, ensuring successful delivery of architecture assessment, design recommendations, and network transformation objectives.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in Enterprise, Data Center, and Network Architecture domains, with proven leadership in large-scale infrastructure engagements.
* Strong expertise in Data Center and DR network architecture, network resilience, high availability, redundancy, and business continuity planning.
* Deep technical knowledge of Cisco Nexus/ACI, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, VPN, routing, switching and network segmentation technologies.
* Experience in designing and assessing neutral network architectures, POP strategy, gateway design, connectivity path diversity and multi-carrier network environments.
* Proven experience in mission-critical, high-performance and latency-sensitive environments, preferably within financial services, banking or regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of network security, service separation, capacity planning, performance optimization, and operational risk management.
* Experience in network transformation, technology migrations, resilience testing, DR exercises, and architecture governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, vendor coordination, technical consulting, and executive communication skills.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunications, Electronics & Communication or a related Engineering discipline.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP Enterprise / CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
* Cisco CCNP Data Center / CCIE Data Center
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Cloud Architecture Certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent) desired

3e486c38.description:
**About Smart Working**

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

**About the Role**

As a D365 Solution Architect, you will own the end-to-end architecture of our enterprise Dynamics 365 platform, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reliable and aligned with Microsoft's roadmap. You will play a key role in establishing architectural standards, reducing unnecessary complexity and maintaining long-term supportability and One Version readiness.

You will collaborate with Functional and Technical Consultants, Integration Engineers, Test Leads, Enterprise Architects, business stakeholders, Microsoft and external vendors to guide architectural decisions and ensure consistency across the platform.

Your expertise will help deliver a resilient, cost-effective enterprise platform capable of supporting high-volume, business-critical operations and peak business demands.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture across Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Azure.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, design principles and governance frameworks aligned with Microsoft's roadmap.
* Design scalable, reliable and secure enterprise solutions while minimising unnecessary customisation and technical debt.
* Ensure architectural decisions support Microsoft Dynamics 365 One Version readiness and long-term platform supportability.
* Govern D365 configurations, extensions, integrations and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) solutions.
* Evaluate the appropriate use of Dynamics 365, Power Platform and third-party technologies to meet business requirements.
* Design and oversee robust enterprise integrations, ensuring reliable data flows and support for high-volume, business-critical workloads.
* Provide architectural oversight across environments, releases, data migration and cutover processes.
* Establish architectural quality gates and conduct solution design reviews and impact assessments.
* Ensure the platform meets security, resilience, operational readiness and performance requirements.
* Guide technical and functional teams in making architectural decisions and resolving complex design challenges.
* Collaborate with delivery teams, Enterprise Architects, Microsoft and external vendors to maintain architectural consistency and programme alignment.
* Ensure solutions are cost-effective, operationally sustainable and capable of supporting peak business demands.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of professional experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), including enterprise-level solution design and implementation.
* 3+ years of experience in D365 Solution Architecture or an equivalent architectural role, with responsibility for end-to-end solution design across Finance & Operations, Supply Chain Management and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
* Strong hands-on experience designing enterprise integrations using Microsoft Azure services, including Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure Functions.
* Deep understanding of D365 architecture, Microsoft extensibility frameworks, data entities, dual-write, Common Data Service (CDS), Dataverse, APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Proven experience governing D365 configurations, customisations, extensions and ISV solutions while managing architectural complexity and technical debt.
* Experience working on complex, multi-vendor and multi-workstream ERP transformation programmes.
* Strong understanding of solution governance, architectural impact assessments, design reviews and quality gates.
* Experience supporting D365 release readiness, regression testing strategies, environment management and Microsoft One Version compliance.
* Understanding of enterprise security principles, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), identity patterns, compliance and operational security.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and explain complex technical concepts clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured, proactive and collaborative approach to solution design.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience evaluating Microsoft AppSource solutions and third-party applications.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform and its integration with Dynamics 365.
* Knowledge of DevOps pipelines, environment strategies and automated testing practices.
* Experience designing observable, traceable and monitorable enterprise solutions.
* Understanding of cloud cost optimisation and operational Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Experience producing detailed architectural documentation and solution diagrams.

d7dadcb1.description:
**Description**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

* Knowledge of cloud architecture

* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer III - Network, with deep core networking experience and practical infrastructure-as-code skills. You'll implement, and support secure, reliable network services across data center and public cloud environments. You'll work with engineering, architecture, security, product, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver network solutions. You'll troubleshoot complex issues, contribute to network design and standards, and use automation to make network operations more consistent and scalable.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure across data center and public cloud environments.

Apply core networking expertise in routing, switching, segmentation, connectivity, and traffic management.

Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using tools and languages such as Terraform, Ansible and Python.

Maintain CI/CD pipelines to test, validate, and deploy network configurations and infrastructure code.

Diagnose complex network issues using packet captures, protocol analyzers, logs, monitoring platforms, and other diagnostic tools.

Support network provisioning, break-fix, enhancements, migrations, and new initiatives.

Implement changes in accordance with change management, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Maintain accurate network diagrams, configurations, procedures, standards, and compliance documentation.

Collaborate with architects and partner teams to assess requirements, recommend solutions, and coordinate implementation.

Participate in an on-call rotation and support planned work outside normal business hours when required.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

5 to 8 years of professional network engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience with core networking and public cloud networking.

At least 3 years of hands-on infrastructure-as-code experience using tools and languages such as Terraform, Ansible, and Python.

Experience of maintaining CI/CD pipelines for testing, validating, or deploying infrastructure code or network configurations.

Strong knowledge of routing protocols and concepts, including BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, and first-hop redundancy protocols such as HSRP or VRRP.

Experience of implementing, and troubleshooting LAN and WAN networks, including VLANs,trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, and network segmentation.

Experience with public cloud networking in at least one major cloud platform: Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure. Google Cloud Platform experience is an advantage.

Experience supporting highly available production infrastructure and following formal change management practices.

Experience working in a distributed, multi-data-center or SaaS environment.

Experience with network configuration, troubleshooting, and operations using Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent technologies.

Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partner teams.

Willingness to participate in on-call support and planned after-hours work.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with Google Cloud networking, including routing, load balancing, NAT, firewalls, or hybrid connectivity.

Familiarity with consuming network automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python or Jinja2, including CI/CD workflows.

Experience with next-generation firewalls such as Fortinet or Palo Alto, and load balancers such as F5.

Knowledge of VPN and tunneling technologies, including IPsec, SSL VPN, or GRE.

Familiarity with SSL certificate lifecycle management, network monitoring, protocol analysis, or WAN and ISP connectivity.

Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, JNCIS, or a public cloud networking certification ; familiarity with infrastructure security, compliance, or Agile practices is also beneficial.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.

A self-directed approach and sound judgment.

A collaborative mindset and interest in sharing knowledge and improving team processes.

beb24a31.description:
Responsibilities:

**Delivery Lead - Engineering**
-------------------------------

Are you ready to take on a groundbreaking opportunity that allows you to lead and innovate within the realm of Information Technology? At Principal, we are looking for a Delivery Manager - Engineering to join our innovative team in Hyderabad. This role offers the chance to work on powerful projects, collaborate with world-class professionals, and make a real impact in the tech industry!

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Technical Leadership: Independently assess the exploitability and business impact of reported vulnerabilities. Provide technical expertise, abilities, and mentorship to guide analysts and testers through vulnerability identification and analysis, exploitability techniques, and severity determination.
* Service Delivery Ownership: Manage the complete delivery condition of Application Vulnerability Assessment (AVA), Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP), and Bug Bounty (BB) Programs. Ensure that all work meets quality, consistency, accuracy, and is completed on time.
* Reporting, Metrics & Operational Measurements: Define, maintain, and continuously improve service benchmarks, operational measurements, SLAs, and maturity metrics for both AVA and VDP/ BB Services. Develop reporting that enables leadership to assess service efficiency and risk reduction.
* Service Improvement, Maturity, and Continuous Improvement: Find opportunities to improve testing effectiveness, reporting quality, operational efficiency, automation, and collaborator experience. Build and complete service improvement roadmaps.
* Collaborator Management: Serve as the technical point of contact for AVA, VDP, and Bug Bounty teams regarding complex technical findings, exploitability discussions, severity disputes, and remediation strategies related to blocking issues. Ensure collaborators receive timely and accurate communication.
* Governance & Operational Excellence: Maintain oversight of service health, delivery commitments, compliance requirements, documentation, and process alignment. Establish accountability mechanisms to ensure commitments are delivered without excessive strategic direction.

Qualifications:

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Must have 10-12+ years of experience in Application Penetration Testing and Red Teaming. Candidates should hold certifications like OSCP/OSEP, GPEN/GWAPT, or AWS Certifications.
* Education: Graduate/Bachelor’s degree (preference in computer science, technology, engineering) or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrable Experience: Demonstrated strong hands-on experience in security testing on web applications, APIs hosted on both On-Prem and Cloud. Experience with OWASP Top-10, OWASP API Security, and AI/LLM Security Testing (preferred).
* Active Participation: Involvement in Bug Bounty programs, security research, or responsible disclosure activities.
* Technical Leadership Skills: Proficiency in independently analyzing the exploitability and business impact of reported vulnerabilities and delivering technical support.
* Service Delivery Skills: Proven track record in owning and managing service delivery, ensuring quality and consistency.

Additional Information:

At Principal, we provide an environment where your knowledge and enthusiasm for security can flourish. If you are prepared to become part of an energetic group dedicated to excellence and innovation, we want to connect with you!

**About the role**
------------------

We are BT. We are International. We are Customer Design. We are the BT International Customer Design Team.

With a focus on two core offerings — Global Fabric and Global Managed Voice—this role is central to designing and delivering BT International solutions for global enterprises.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a global, dynamic team at the forefront of technology, playing a pivotal role in delivering impactful outcomes for both our customers and BT International.

As a leader in this role, you will guide a team of skilled technology professionals, crafting end-to-end technical solutions that translate business needs into deliverable, high-quality outcomes. These solutions must meet customer expectations on cost, time, and quality—while also driving profitability and growth for BT International.

Reporting to a Senior Manager within Customer Design, you will collaborate closely with the leadership team of a Technology or Regional Practice. As a key member of this team, you will be responsible for inspiring, directing, and supporting a group of Technical Designers.

You’ll bring a strong background in technology, with proven experience in both design and delivery. You’ll lead across multiple customer engagements, ensuring excellence in every phase of the process.

Your focus will be on right-first-time delivery, ensuring an exceptional customer experience and delivering better outcomes.

You’ll represent BT International in customer engagements, backed by a team of technical experts committed to delivering the proposed solutions.

You’ll engage with customers and internal stakeholders at a senior level, instilling confidence in BT’s design and delivery capabilities.

A mindset of continuous learning, improving and business simplification is essential, helping to modernize our operations and shape a better future.

At the heart of everything we do is a simple goal: ensuring every customer and partner experiences that things just work… Better on BT.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

1. Supervises the capture of customer technical requirements and translation to detailed solution design in accordance with design methodology, through the customer solution design team.
  
2. Manages the execution of the strategy for the global customer solutions organisation, ensuring it is capable of delivering excellence in end-to-end technical solutions.
  
3. Contributes to the technical direction and in determining optimum solution design for customers.
  
4. Coordinates customer solution design engagement, facilitating statement of work creation, including any 3rd party deliverables.
  
5. Supports building strong customer relationships at the senior level through providing specialist service design expertise, and influencing the customer's service strategy and operational decisions.
  
6. Undertakes change management activities and coordinates customer transition/migration planning and implementation.
  
7. Undertakes the identification of potential risks and the implementation of controls and mitigations, ensuring compliance with relevant industry and company policies.
  
8. Coordinates reviews of solutions to ensure full integration across all aspects, ensuring consistency in architecture and technical processes.
  
9. Coordinates the prioritisation of design and delivery elements, and allocation of project workload to ensure delivery on time and within budget.
  
10. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in customer solution design.
  
11. Coaches talent, and manages others, to develop capabilities and ensure performance through upskilling, development and recruitment.
  
12. Implements ways to improve working processes within the area of customer solution design.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 18+ Years' technical and leadership experience.
* May hold a relevant industry recognised accreditation.

* Must be technically strong and understand the team's technical deliverables including High Level Design (HLD), Low Level Design (LLD), Bill of Material (BoM) etc.
* Keep themselves current in technology developments/trends and methods of deployment.
* Have a broad, technical knowledge of multiple technologies and products across: Digital Infrastructure including but not limited to LAN/WAN/SDWAN/Wireless Networking/AI/Network automation & programmability, cloud infra and Digital Workplace
* Be able to lead technical conversations with customers.
* Be able to complete peer reviews and assurance of delivery of the designs

  

**Leadership and Ownnership**

* Lead and inspire teams, driving change and building high-performing teams.
* Work closely with your team, understand what they are doing, help, coach & support them.
* Understands the role of teams working on deliveries, collaborating with those around them.
* Be solution oriented, own the outcomes, ensuring accountability and responsibility.
* Drive a continuous improvement mindset to raise the bar in how we work on a daily basis.
* Be visible & proactive, have an opinion, and lead by example.

Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
  
  
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
  
  
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
  
  
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

19ab78f6.title: AI Technical Program Manager
19ab78f6.description:
AI Technical Program Manager

**Description -**

  

**About the role**

  

HP Applied AI helps the enterprise use AI safely and at scale while improving performance, experience and cost. As an AI Technical Program Manager, you will be the primary Applied AI partner for one or more value streams, flexing across priorities as business demand evolves.

You will connect business leaders, Global Process Owners, product and platform teams, delivery managers, engineering, machine learning, data, operations and controls. You will translate business problems into buildable requirements, steer execution, challenge legacy ways of working and ensure solutions reach production with measurable outcomes.

  

**What you will do**

  

* **Own end-to-end program outcomes.** Lead AI and automation initiatives from intake and feasibility through planning, execution, testing, release, adoption, operational handover and benefits realization.

* **Plan and drive delivery.** Maintain integrated plans, milestones, capacity, estimates, budgets and release schedules using agile or hybrid approaches. Manage critical paths, dependencies, scope changes and recovery actions.

* **Lead sprint and backlog readiness.** Facilitate prioritization, backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, reviews and retrospectives. Remove impediments and ensure requirements are ready for engineering.

* **Translate business needs into buildable requirements.** Map current and future processes; define epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, data needs, exceptions, integrations and controls.

* **Prioritize for value.** Build business cases and ROI assumptions with value-stream leaders and Global Process Owners. Prioritize opportunities by value, feasibility, effort, cost, risk, dependencies and organizational readiness.

* **Manage risk and governance.** Maintain an actionable RAID log, stakeholder map, RACI, decision records and governance cadence. Escalate early, communicate trade-offs and secure accountable decisions.

* **Guide AI and enterprise technology delivery.** Lead the lifecycle from use-case definition and data readiness through AI evaluation, deployment and monitoring. Work with engineers on LLMs, agents, RPA, APIs, cloud services, environments, pipelines and the SDLC.

* **Safeguard quality and production readiness.** Align engineering, QA and business teams on test coverage, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, sign-offs and traceability. Coordinate functional, integration, regression, UAT, AI evaluation, performance and security testing as applicable.

* **Ensure controls and operational readiness.** Maintain required SOX/ITGC change evidence, release approvals, cutover and rollback plans, support readiness and explicit acceptance of residual risks.

* **Drive adoption and realized value.** Coordinate communications, training and support handover. Track adoption and benefits against agreed baselines, identify outcome gaps and drive corrective action.

* **Identify opportunities to Improve the process, not only the technology.** Perform root-cause analysis and operational data verification and validation to remove waste, reduce rework, reduce manual handoffs and control weaknesses before or alongside automation. Identify opportunities for process standardization, align with business process SMEs and execute process improvements.

  

**Education and Experience Required**

9d8c4254.title: Business Solutions & Application Portfolio Manager
9d8c4254.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

### **Your Role**

As a Business Solutions & Application Portfolio Manager, you will be responsible for governing the regional business application portfolio and managing relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams, and external service providers. You will oversee application lifecycle management, vendor performance, service enhancements, and technology transformation initiatives, including application archiving, decommissioning, migrations, and platform upgrades. Working closely with Finance, Platform IT, and regional stakeholders, you will ensure effective service delivery, cost transparency, operational continuity, and compliance with business and regulatory requirements. You will also drive service improvements, coordinate disaster recovery readiness, manage risks and dependencies, and support strategic decisions on application modernization and technology roadmaps.

  

### **What will you do:**

* Manage the regional business application portfolio, including archiving, migration, decommissioning, and lifecycle planning.
* Govern third-party vendors and managed service providers, monitoring service performance, risks, and improvement actions.
* Review enhancement requests, delivery estimates, upgrade proposals, costs, and business requirements.
* Coordinate application transformation, cloud migration, platform upgrades, and supplier transitions.
* Build relationships with Finance, IT, application owners, and regional stakeholders.
Oversee disaster recovery readiness, compliance requirements, risk escalation, and operational continuity.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others

### **Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

* Experience in enterprise application management, IT service delivery, or business relationship management.
* Hands-on experience in vendor governance, managed services, and service performance management.
* Knowledge of ERP, Finance platforms, application lifecycle management, and migration programmes.
* Experience reviewing enhancement requests, project estimates, upgrades, and delivery proposals.
* Understanding of disaster recovery, compliance, risk management, and application governance.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and cross-regional coordination skills.

### **Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Exposure to cloud migration, data-centre exit, and legacy application rationalization.
* Knowledge of application archiving, data retention, and restoration strategies.
* Experience with ServiceNow, AMS governance, and IT service management frameworks.
* Understanding of SOX controls, disaster recovery frameworks, and audit requirements.
Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively with senior leadership.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

b2d36042.description:
**Description**
Come build the next generation of technology and driver experiences for Amazon’s Last Mile delivery business. We build services and apps that drivers use to deliver most Amazon customer packages, with a reach of millions of customers and packages. The Driver Experience team is responsible for how drivers know where to go, what packages to deliver, where and how to pickup packages, and how to communicate with customers. This TPM role not only helps define the driver experience, it also defines the technology platform used to build Amazon's delivery app.
  
  
We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to manage large, cross functional programs and projects that support Last Mile delivery. In this role you will be responsible for delivering complex projects end-to-end keeping Amazon’s scale and quality in mind. You will help deliver mobile apps on multiple platforms, and the backend services needed to provide delivery and task guidance to on-road drivers. Amazon Last Mile is a large, service-oriented architecture with thousands of components that work together to provide a single app experience. As a Senior TPM, you will drive the scalable architecture of our next-generation platform, design for technical operational excellence and package delivery operational cost efficiency. You will also optimize for driver productivity and quality. You will anticipate project bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. There are very few opportunities to design a system that operates at Amazon scale and throughput, so this is a highly visible position that will have a material impact on Amazon transportation for decades to come.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon's Last Mile Transporter Experience team is directly responsible for the driver experience. We work with technologies ranging from mobile devices, to in-dash screens, to backend supporting services, to hardware devices in warehouse pickup points, to enable deliveries worldwide and scale, with region-specific support. We think not only about mobile apps, we also think about driver safety, how drivers get paid, how delivery partners support their drivers, and more. We regularly partner with Amazon business teams to deliver end to end business programs that surface to drivers through the driver experience screens and systems. We also define and deliver the technical platform for building driver experiences, ranging from data architectures to mobile frameworks.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope technical requirements and prioritize tasks

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. 3c01d699.title: Program Manager 4
3c01d699.description:
**Job Description**
This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**

* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

**KPI Definition and Governance**

* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. bf82b4a5.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and the implementation of GenAI-driven moderation frameworks to enhance operational scalability.
* Proven track record in planning, organizing, and risk management for high-stakes, cross-functional programs.
* Ability to utilize data analysis tools and drive focused insights and performance improvements.
* Strong capability to influence without authority across peer PgMs, Engineering leads, and executive leadership.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and build operational solutions using Generative AI to enhance moderation, scalability and efficiency. Design and set up assertion based expert workflows for newer FMR vectors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for global regulatory workflows, ensuring compliance with mandates like the DSA and CMA.
* Oversee end-to-end project life cycles from concept to launch, coordinating closely with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams.
* Monitor program metrics and risks, communicating progress and performance effectively to executive leadership.
* Establish and manage in-house and extended workforce project execution teams while leveraging internal Google products and tools to drive automation and enhance operational efficiency.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 57d64fe9.title: Senior Public Transportation Architect
57d64fe9.description:
**Overall Summary**

  

The Senior Public Transportation Architect serves as a senior technical delivery professional responsible for the planning, design, and multidisciplinary coordination of complex transit infrastructure and public transportation facility projects. The role is intended for an experienced engineer-architect who can lead technical workstreams, coordinate across disciplines, support client and stakeholder discussions, and deliver practical, sustainable, and operationally effective transit facilities.

  

The role supports projects such as transit stations, bus rapid transit facilities, multimodal transportation hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, park-and-ride facilities, passenger transfer facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure. The position is focused on technical excellence, project delivery, design integration, quality, and mentoring within multidisciplinary transit infrastructure teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead planning, programming, architectural design, and construction support for transit stations, multimodal hubs, maintenance facilities, BRT facilities, operations centers, and other transportation infrastructure projects.
* Serve as Lead Architect, Design Lead, or Discipline Lead for complex transit infrastructure assignments, ensuring that architectural deliverables are coordinated, technically sound, and aligned with project requirements.
* Coordinate and integrate architectural solutions with civil, structural, geotechnical, MEP, rail systems, communications, traction power, transportation planning, operations, safety, security, sustainability, and digital delivery disciplines.
* Develop facility concepts that balance passenger experience, operational efficiency, accessibility, safety, maintainability, resiliency, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and future expansion needs.
* Prepare, review, and coordinate design criteria, reports, technical memoranda, drawings, specifications, BIM models, and contract documents across project phases.
* Support project managers with scope management, schedule coordination, budget awareness, resource planning, risk reviews, and quality assurance for architectural and facility-related tasks.
* Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering sessions, and technical quality reviews to improve project outcomes.
* Interface with client teams to present design concepts, resolve technical issues, and support approvals.
* Support construction-phase services including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating design clarifications.
* Promote BIM coordination, digital delivery workflows, and innovative approaches to improve quality, coordination, and delivery efficiency.
* Mentor architects, engineers, designers, and BIM/modeling staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelors degree in Architecture or related engineering field from an accredited institution.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in architecture, transportation facilities, transit infrastructure, or complex public infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience delivering rail, metro, BRT, bus, or multimodal transportation facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and coordinating with civil, structural, MEP, systems, operations, safety, and sustainability disciplines.
* Experience supporting project delivery through multiple phases, including planning, feasibility, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement support, and construction support.
* Strong working knowledge of accessibility requirements, sustainable design principles, and public infrastructure design requirements.
* Strong communication, coordination, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Masters degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Experience with transit stations, rail/metro facilities, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and storage facilities, operations centers, passenger facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure.
* Experience integrating architecture with rail systems, transit operations, maintenance requirements, transportation engineering, and public realm design.
